We study this reward-driven misalignment, including reward hacking, through verifiable reward--context conflicts, where compliant task completion remains feasible while some executable shortcuts earn more reward than every compliant strategy. Encoding these conflicts in task dynamics lets us generate diverse interactive environments at scale and derive compliance feedback from execution histories. In resource and reporting workflows, task optimization increases real productivity through unauthorized resource use or raises reported scores while actual work declines. Controlled changes in the training distribution show that minority conflict exposure can still lead to widespread shortcut acquisition, reaching 97.9\% certified profitable violations on an API task under a 25\% conflict mixture after 128 updates. The same contextual checks supply a simple binary penalty that supports joint capability and compliance gains and partially mitigates acquired violations. Learned safety adapts to expanded authorization and transfers across mechanisms into workflows with evolving evidence and approval requirements. On 32 unseen changing-evidence tasks, resource-trained safety increases safe completion from 53.1\% to 89.1\% relative to task-only training, while both policies achieve full real work. These results connect a verifiable account of reward-driven misalignment with scalable task construction and safety learning that remains useful under changing execution requirements.
title_cn: 捷径与边界：可验证的 RL 错位与上下文安全学习
abstract_cn: 强化学习（RL）可以在提升智能体任务能力的同时强化违反上下文执行要求的行为。我们研究这种奖励驱动的错位（包括奖励破解），经由可验证的奖励-上下文冲突：合规完成任务仍然可行，而某些可执行的捷径比任何合规策略挣得更多奖励。把这些冲突编码进任务动态使我们能规模化生成多样的交互环境，并从执行历史导出合规反馈。在资源与报告工作流中，任务优化经由未授权资源使用提升真实生产率，或提升报告分数而实际工作下降。训练分布的受控变化显示少数冲突暴露仍可导致广泛的捷径习得：在 25% 冲突混合、128 次更新后，API 任务上达到 97.9% 的认证盈利违规。同样的上下文检查提供一个简单的二元惩罚，支持能力与合规的联合增益并部分缓解习得的违规。习得的安全能适应扩大的授权并跨机制迁移到证据与审批要求演化的工作流。在 32 个未见的变化证据任务上，资源训练的安全使安全完成从 53.1% 提升到 89.1%（相对仅任务训练），同时两个策略都实现全部真实工作。这些结果把奖励驱动错位的可验证刻画与规模化任务构造及在变化执行要求下保持有用的安全学习连接起来。
summary_cn: 以可验证奖励-上下文冲突研究 RL 错位：25% 冲突混合即致 97.9% 认证违规；二元上下文惩罚使安全完成 53.1%→89.1% 且真实工作不受损。
objective_summary: 构造可验证的奖励-上下文冲突环境研究 RL 捷径习得，量化少数冲突暴露的扩散效应并评估二元合规惩罚的安全-能力联合训练。
evidence_note: 受控环境族的量化结果（97.9% 认证盈利违规、32 未见任务 53.1%→89.1%）+ 分布混合的受控变化实验；环境为自建仿真，无真实部署。
novelty_note: 把奖励-上下文冲突编码进任务动力学以可验证地生成错位环境是规模化研究 RL 错位的新路径；安全迁移到未见变化任务的结果有价值。
scope: 资源与报告类工作流的 RL 训练；自建环境族与认证违规定义之内。
limitations: 二元惩罚是粗粒度信号
自建环境与真实工作流差距
更复杂冲突结构的未覆盖

title: TUTTI: Parallel CKKS Bootstrapping in under 3 ms on CPU
abstract: This paper introduces TUTTI, a new CKKS bootstrapping procedure that outperforms previous low-latency solutions in multi-threaded latency for any number of messages and, most notably, has a lower latency than TFHE when bootstrapping a single one. Our bootstrapping builds upon SPRU (CK, TCHES 2027), improving it with new methods for exploiting parallelism and increasing the number of messages, as well as with a refined security analysis, of independent interest, of the block-binary secret keys of LMSS (AsiaCCS 2023). TUTTI bootstraps 4096 real-number messages in 46 to 83.4 ms on 192 threads to restore 1 to 9 multiplicative levels, outperforming SHIP (CHKS, Eurocrypt 2025) by a factor of up to 3 on the same machine. Unlike SHIP, TUTTI gains immediately from bootstrapping fewer messages, with a 256-message bootstrapping taking just 15 to 34 ms on 32 threads. For a single message, TUTTI takes 4.6 ms on 32 threads, whereas TFHE-rs needs 7.3 ms for a 4-bit bootstrapping on the same machine and thread count. We show that this advantage persists across different architectures: on an Apple M5 Pro laptop (ARM), TUTTI takes 2.4 ms on 14 threads, against 4.5 ms for TFHE-rs. Differences between CKKS and lightweight schemes such as TFHE remain on several fronts, from functionality to key sizes and security assumptions, but our work shows that multi-threaded latency is no longer one of them, closing a long-standing gap in the practical FHE literature.
title_cn: TUTTI：CPU 上低于 3 毫秒的并行 CKKS 自举
abstract_cn: 本文提出 TUTTI，一种新的 CKKS 自举程序：对任意消息数都优于先前低延迟方案的多线程延迟，最显著的是在自举单条消息时延迟低于 TFHE。我们的自举构建于 SPRU（CK，TCHES 2027）之上，以利用并行性与增加消息数的新方法改进它，并以对 LMSS（AsiaCCS 2023）块二进制密钥的精化安全分析为独立贡献。TUTTI 在 192 线程上 46 至 83.4 毫秒自举 4096 个实数消息以恢复 1 到 9 个乘法层级，在同一机器上较 SHIP（CHKS，Eurocrypt 2025）最多快 3 倍。与 SHIP 不同，TUTTI 在自举更少消息时立即获益：256 条消息的自举在 32 线程上只需 15 至 34 毫秒。对单条消息，TUTTI 在 32 线程上用 4.6 毫秒，而 TFHE-rs 在同一机器与线程数下对 4 比特自举需 7.3 毫秒。我们展示该优势跨架构保持：在 Apple M5 Pro 笔记本（ARM）上，TUTTI 在 14 线程用 2.4 毫秒，TFHE-rs 为 4.5 毫秒。CKKS 与 TFHE 等轻量方案在功能、密钥尺寸与安全假设等多方面仍有差异，但我们的工作表明多线程延迟不再是其中之一，弥合了实践 FHE 文献中的长期缺口。
summary_cn: TUTTI 并行 CKKS 自举：4096 消息 46–83.4 ms（较 SHIP 快至 3×），单消息 4.6 ms 低于 TFHE-rs 的 7.3 ms，Apple M5 上 2.4 vs 4.5 ms——多线程延迟差距被弥合。
objective_summary: 提出并行化 CKKS 自举 TUTTI：基于 SPRU 改进并行与消息批量，附块二进制密钥的精化安全分析，在多架构上量化延迟优势。
evidence_note: 多机器（192 线程服务器与 Apple M5 Pro）的具体延迟数字、与 SHIP/TFHE-rs 的同机对照、恢复 1–9 层级的功能范围及精化安全分析。
novelty_note: 把 CKKS 自举的单消息多线程延迟压到低于 TFHE，弥合长期存在的实践缺口；消息数可伸缩性设计与安全分析精化为实质贡献。
scope: CKKS 自举的延迟优化；块二进制密钥安全模型与所测硬件之内。
limitations: 通信与密钥尺寸仍大于 TFHE（作者自陈差异尚存）
仅多线程 CPU，GPU 未覆盖
并行度受线程数限制

title: Suppression Is Not Erasure: Mechanistic Analysis and Reactivation Boundaries of Subspace Projection for LoRA Backdoor Defense
abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is the standard paradigm for customizing large language models, yet third-party LoRA adapters pose a supply-chain risk: modifying less than 1% of model parameters suffices to implant stealthy backdoors. Recent defenses project adapter weights onto estimated backdoor subspaces, reporting near-zero static Attack Success Rates (ASR). We audit subspace-projection defenses across four model scales (Qwen2.5-0.5B/1.5B/3B/7B) and three architectures (Qwen2.5, InternLM2.5, Spark). Constructively, module-wise rank-1 trigger-difference projection (k=1, alpha=1) reduces ASR from 60.4% to 0.0% on standard benchmarks and from 70.3% to 0.0% on a 1,000-sample uncontaminated suite (p = 3.055e-299, instruction-level p = 9.49e-16) in under 5 seconds end-to-end, and we prove via a spectral-gap bound why trigger-free calibration with benign polite suffixes aligns with u1(B) (median cosine 0.9048) and achieves 0.0% ASR without prior trigger knowledge. Our main contribution is a negative finding: static ASR reduction does not imply parameter erasure. Under 5-sample few-shot reactivation, every evaluated weight-editing defense rebounds (91.7%-100.0% ASR in 1 epoch for standard projections, Fine-Pruning, ANP, SVD truncation and Li & Kim's dual-end projection; 48.7% for our single-round dual variant), all reaching 100.0% by Epoch 2, with first-epoch loss up to 5.7x lower than training from scratch. Using an exact spectrum-preserving Haar orthogonal rotation control (Frobenius norm 10.0928 preserved to 1.70e-6) and N=1..6 cumulative Gram-Schmidt basis ablation, we decompose reactivation into residual trigger-difference coupling energy at Epoch 1 (Spearman rho = 0.986), base-model learnability at Epoch 2 (100%), and benign semantic direction conflict (41.7%).
title_cn: 抑制不是擦除：LoRA 后门防御中子空间投影的机理分析与再激活边界
abstract_cn: 低秩适配（LoRA）是定制大语言模型的标准范式，但第三方 LoRA 适配器构成供应链风险：修改不到 1% 的模型参数即可植入隐蔽后门。近期防御把适配器权重投影到估计的后门子空间上，报告接近零的静态攻击成功率（ASR）。我们跨四个模型规模（Qwen2.5-0.5B/1.5B/3B/7B）与三个架构（Qwen2.5、InternLM2.5、Spark）审计子空间投影防御。建设性方面：模块级 rank-1 触发差分投影（k=1, α=1）在标准基准上把 ASR 从 60.4% 降到 0.0%，在 1,000 样本无污染套件上从 70.3% 降到 0.0%（p=3.055e-299，指令级 p=9.49e-16），端到端不到 5 秒；我们经谱隙界证明为何用良性礼貌后缀做免触发校准能与 u1(B) 对齐（中位余弦 0.9048）并在无触发先验知识下达到 0.0% ASR。我们的主要贡献是负面发现：静态 ASR 下降不意味着参数擦除。在 5 样本少样本再激活下，每个被评估的权重编辑防御都反弹（标准投影、Fine-Pruning、ANP、SVD 截断与 Li & Kim 双端投影在 1 个 epoch 内达 91.7–100.0% ASR；我们的单轮双变体为 48.7%），全部在第 2 个 epoch 达 100.0%，首 epoch 损失比从头训练低至多 5.7 倍。用精确保谱的 Haar 正交旋转对照（Frobenius 范数 10.0928 保持到 1.70e-6）与 N=1..6 累积 Gram-Schmidt 基消融，我们把再激活分解为 Epoch 1 的残余触发差分耦合能量（Spearman ρ=0.986）、Epoch 2 的基座可学习性（100%）与良性语义方向冲突（41.7%）。
summary_cn: 审计 LoRA 后镜子空间投影防御：rank-1 投影 5 秒内 ASR 归零（p≈3e-299），但 5 样本再激活使所有权重编辑防御 1–2 epoch 反弹至 100%——静态抑制不等于参数擦除。
objective_summary: 跨四规模三架构审计 LoRA 后门子空间投影防御：量化其静态效果并以少样本再激活实验与谱保持对照分解反弹成因。
evidence_note: 四规模 × 三架构的审计 + 显著性检验（p=3.055e-299）+ 谱隙界证明 + Haar 旋转对照（范数保持到 1.70e-6）+ N=1..6 消融的机理分解（ρ=0.986）。
novelty_note: 负面发现「静态 ASR 归零 ≠ 参数擦除」对整条后门防御路线有纠偏价值；再激活三因素分解与免触发校准的谱解释是实质性机理贡献。
scope: LoRA 适配器的权重编辑类后门防御；四规模三架构与 5 样本少样本再激活设定之内。
limitations: 再激活攻击需对模型训练访问
防御修复方案未提出
非 LoRA 的后门注入形态未覆盖

title: DeepChronos: Temporal Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning for Multi-Step Attack Detection
abstract: Modern cyber threats commonly unfold as multi-step attacks comprising temporally and causally related phases. Current defenses commonly follow a detect first and correlate later paradigm. Intrusion detection systems classify events independently, while downstream systems reconstruct attack progression from the resulting alerts or audit records. In this context, learning-based detectors learn attack-step dependencies implicitly as statistical regularities in the data and cannot guarantee that their predictions follow the real attack progression. Conversely, correlation systems represent attack relationships explicitly, but apply this knowledge only after the underlying attack observations have been detected. We present DEEPCHRONOS, a neuro-symbolic network intrusion detection system that shifts the paradigm from detect first and correlate later to detection through logical progression. DEEPCHRONOS combines learned flow-level evidence with explicit attack-phase rules, temporal prerequisites, and previously inferred phases, allowing the evolving attack history to inform and constrain each detection decision. Evaluations on DARPA 2000 and AIT-LDS V2 show that DEEPCHRONOS improves macro F1 over purely neural baselines by up to 11.3%, eliminates causal violations under strict temporal constraints, and maintains millisecond-scale inference latency. These results demonstrate that integrating explicit attack progression knowledge into detection produces more accurate and temporally coherent multi-step attack predictions.
title_cn: DeepChronos：面向多步攻击检测的时序神经符号推理
abstract_cn: 现代网络威胁通常表现为由时间与因果相关阶段组成的多步攻击。当前防御普遍遵循「先检测、后关联」范式：入侵检测系统独立分类事件，下游系统从产生的告警或审计记录重建攻击进程。在此背景下，基于学习的检测器把攻击步骤依赖隐式地当作数据中的统计规律学习，无法保证其预测遵循真实攻击进程；而关联系统显式表示攻击关系，但只在底层攻击观测被检出之后才应用这些知识。我们提出 DEEPCHRONOS，一个神经符号网络入侵检测系统，把范式从「先检测、后关联」转向「经逻辑进程检测」：DEEPCHRONOS 把学习到的流级证据与显式攻击阶段规则、时序前提及此前推断的阶段结合，让演化的攻击历史通知并约束每个检测决策。在 DARPA 2000 与 AIT-LDS V2 上的评估显示，DEEPCHRONOS 较纯神经基线把宏 F1 提升至多 11.3%，在严格时序约束下消除因果违反，并保持毫秒级推理延迟。这些结果表明把显式攻击进程知识整合进检测能产生更准确、时序更连贯的多步攻击预测。
summary_cn: DeepChronos 神经符号 IDS 转向「经逻辑进程检测」：DARPA 2000 与 AIT-LDS V2 上宏 F1 提升至多 11.3%，零因果违反、毫秒级推理。
objective_summary: 提出以显式攻击阶段规则与时序前提约束检测决策的神经符号入侵检测系统，在两个多步攻击数据集上量化改进。
evidence_note: DARPA 2000 与 AIT-LDS V2 上的宏 F1 提升与因果违反消除、毫秒延迟；数据集较老且规模小、无统计检验。
novelty_note: 「检测时即用攻击进程知识约束决策」相对先检测后关联是范式层面的调整；规则编码与学习融合的工程组合。
scope: 流级网络入侵的多步攻击检测；两个基准数据集与所编码攻击场景之内。
limitations: 数据集老旧，现代流量形态覆盖未知
攻击场景规则需人工编码
对未见攻击链的泛化未验证

title: Checking DER Commands Against Grid Context Catches Credentialed Attacks Static Checks Miss
abstract: Authorization of distributed energy resource (DER) commands judges a command by who sent it and whether its value has been seen before. An attacker holding a legitimate credential who writes ordinary values passes both tests. We add a check that judges each DER write against the grid's operating context: the bus voltages around the target, the hour, the day- ahead price, system load, and irradiance, compared with what operators wrote under similar conditions in the feeder's own benign history. We evaluate it live on the IEEE 123-bus and 8500-node feeders, driven by a measured 2024 year of price, load, and irradiance, against nine attack scenarios. A lookup trained on the same history catches none of the writes of the four scenarios that send values already familiar on the targeted device; the context check refuses 91.7% of insider-abuse writes and 64.4% of DER-aggregation writes while denying 1.28% of benign writes. In an offline test that replays recorded moments with curtailment setpoints drawn from the benign range, issued at a positive price, it refuses 47.3% and 50.5% on the two feeders, against 18.5% and 16.0% for the same check without context; live, the few setpoints tested were mostly shallow and were mostly allowed. The context check complements the lookup.
title_cn: 对照电网上下文检查 DER 命令可捕获静态检查漏掉的凭据攻击
abstract_cn: 分布式能源资源（DER）命令的授权按「谁发送」与「该值是否见过」判定。持有合法凭据、写入普通值的攻击者能通过这两项检查。我们增加一项检查：对照电网运行上下文判定每条 DER 写入——目标周边母线电压、时段、日前价格、系统负荷与辐照，与运营商在同一馈线自身良性历史中类似条件下写入的值比较。我们在 IEEE 123-bus 与 8500-node 馈线上以实测的 2024 年价格、负荷与辐照驱动做实时评估，对照九个攻击场景。在同一历史训练的查找表无法捕获四类向目标设备发送已熟悉值场景的任何写入；上下文检查拒绝 91.7% 的内部滥用写入与 64.4% 的 DER 聚合写入，仅拒绝 1.28% 的良性写入。在重放记录时刻、削减设定点取自良性范围且在正价格下发出的离线测试中，它在两个馈线上分别拒绝 47.3% 与 50.5%，而无上下文的同一检查为 18.5% 与 16.0%；实时测试中受测的少数设定点多较浅且大多被放行。上下文检查是对查找表的补充。
summary_cn: 以电网运行上下文（电压/时段/价格/负荷/辐照 vs 本馈线历史）检查 DER 写命令：拒绝 91.7% 内部滥用写、仅 1.28% 误拒，补上凭据+前值检查的盲区。
objective_summary: 提出对照馈线良性历史的运行上下文检查 DER 写命令的授权机制，在 IEEE 馈线实时与离线评估其拦截率与误拒率。
evidence_note: IEEE 123-bus/8500-node 馈线 + 实测 2024 年价格/负荷/辐照数据的实时与离线评估、九场景对照与量化拒绝率（91.7%/64.4%/1.28%）。
novelty_note: 把电网物理上下文引入 DER 命令授权是新的检查维度；诚实报告实时场景下浅设定点多被放行的局限。
scope: 配网 DER 写命令授权；所用馈线与 2024 实测数据分布之内。
limitations: 上下文统计的历史依赖
实时深设定点场景覆盖不足
对协同欺骗上下文的对手未建模

title: Maurer-Inspired Two-Way Physical-Layer Authentication Against Multi-Antenna Impersonation Attacks
abstract: In this work, we investigate Maurer-inspired two-way physical-layer authentication. Alice seeks authentication by Bob in the presence of a multi-antenna impersonator, Trudy. Trudy may replace the challenge to Alice, the response to Bob, or both. To create an information advantage, Bob adds artificial noise (AN) to his challenge, and Alice adds spatial AN while forwarding the received mixture. Bob predicts the response from trusted preparation, whereas Trudy observes only a noisy version of the challenge, and Alice's AN interferes with Trudy's preparation reception. Impersonation thus requires matching Bob's fresh randomness beyond the channel consistency checked by public-pilot one-way authentication. For quasi-static Gaussian multiple-input multiple-output channels with time-division duplex (TDD) reciprocity, we derive missed-detection bounds for attacks that replace the authentication challenge, the response, or both. These bounds assume attack-free initial training and preparation and account for estimation error and AN leakage. With equal antenna numbers at all nodes, we show scenarios where the proposed scheme has lower worst-case missed detection than specified one-way tests with/without AN.
comment: 18 pages, 1 figure. Submitted to IEEE ICC 2027
title_cn: Maurer 式双向物理层认证对抗多天线冒充攻击
abstract_cn: 本研究考察 Maurer 式双向物理层认证。Alice 在多天线冒充者 Trudy 在场时向 Bob 寻求认证。Trudy 可以替换发给 Alice 的挑战、发给 Bob 的应答、或两者。为创造信息优势，Bob 在其挑战中加入人工噪声（AN），Alice 在转发接收混合信号时加入空间 AN。Bob 从可信准备预测应答，而 Trudy 只观察到带噪的挑战版本，且 Alice 的 AN 干扰 Trudy 的准备接收。因此冒充需要匹配 Bob 的新鲜随机性，超出单向公开导频认证所检查的信道一致性。对具有 TDD 互易性的准静态高斯 MIMO 信道，我们为替换认证挑战、应答或两者的攻击推导漏检界。这些界假设初始训练与准备无攻击，并计入估计误差与 AN 泄漏。在各节点天线数相等时，我们展示所提方案的最坏情况漏检低于带/不带 AN 的指定单向测试的情形。投稿 IEEE ICC 2027。
summary_cn: Maurer 式双向物理层认证对抗多天线冒充：双向人工噪声制造信息优势，TDD MIMO 下推导替换挑战/应答/两者的漏检界，等天线场景优于单向测试。
objective_summary: 设计双向人工噪声辅助的物理层认证方案并推导多天线冒充攻击（替换挑战/应答/两者）下的漏检概率界。
evidence_note: 准静态 TDD MIMO 信道模型的解析漏检界（计入估计误差与 AN 泄漏）+ 情形对比；理论分析、无实测；投稿 ICC 2027（在审）。
novelty_note: 把 Maurer 双向认证与空间 AN 组合对抗多天线冒充并给出三类攻击的漏检界；双向物理层认证方向已有工作，贡献为场景化扩展与解析界。
scope: TDD 互易准静态 MIMO 信道；无攻击初始训练假设。
limitations: 准静态信道假设
无硬件实验验证
Trudy 多天线联合波束成形优化未穷尽

title: BioBind: Binding Biometric Deduplication to Zero-Knowledge Authentication
abstract: Biometric identity systems for decentralized applications need credentials that resist repeated enrollment and support private, publicly verifiable authentication. Capture and large-scale private deduplication run off chain while smart contracts authorize issuance and use; these stages span distinct trust domains, and a correct verdict covers only the checked inputs and gallery snapshot. Without binding and state checks, concurrent enrollments can issue duplicate credentials from correct verdicts, while substituted inputs can authorize unrelated credentials. We present BioBind, a protocol whose four backend interface conditions bind the deduplication query, gallery insertion and issued commitment to one captured vector, authenticate gallery transitions, and require a sound uniqueness verdict valid at finalization. Its encrypted instance uses bound requests, stale-session rejection and committee-confirmed migration. Capture-bound zero-knowledge authentication links credential use to the enrolled template and a fresh device-originated probe bound to the challenge. We give a conditional multi-session composition argument under explicit capture, backend and cryptographic assumptions. A prototype using LFW face features rejects the tested composition attacks; its unlinkable authentication circuit uses 31,445 constraints and about 305,000 gas. An equal-public-field baseline quantifies the cost of verifiable matching: witness-plus-proving medians are 1.989 s versus 1.119 s with device-trusted matching. Separate tests of encrypted enrollment complete three histories of 16,384 registrations without decoding errors at the tested checkpoints. Biometric accuracy bounds person-level uniqueness: on the Bosphorus database, cooperative subjects who change appearance evade deduplication in 1.8% of re-enrollment attempts at the operating threshold. Full backend integration remains open.
comment: 29 pages, 7 figures, 19 tables. Supplementary material included as Appendices A-H. Code and artifact: this https URL
title_cn: BioBind：把生物识别去重绑定到零知识认证
abstract_cn: 去中心化应用的生物识别身份系统需要能抵抗重复注册并支持私有、公开可验证认证的凭据。采集与大规模私有去重在链下运行，智能合约授权签发与使用；这些阶段跨越不同信任域，且正确判定只覆盖被检查的输入与画廊快照。没有绑定与状态检查，并发注册可以从正确判定签发重复凭据，被替换的输入可以授权无关凭据。我们提出 BioBind 协议：其四个后端接口条件把去重查询、画廊插入与签发承诺绑定到同一采集向量，认证画廊转换，并要求在最终化时有效的可靠唯一性判定。其加密实例使用绑定请求、过期会话拒绝与委员会确认迁移。采集绑定的零知识认证把凭据使用链接到已注册模板与绑定到挑战的新鲜设备源探针。我们在显式的采集、后端与密码假设下给出条件性多会话组合论证。使用 LFW 人脸特征的原型拒绝所测试的组合攻击；其不可链接认证电路使用 31,445 个约束与约 305,000 gas。等公开字段基线量化了可验证匹配的代价：见证加证明中位数为 1.989 秒，对照设备信任匹配的 1.119 秒。加密注册的单独测试在受测检查点完成三个 16,384 注册的历史且无解码错误。生物识别精度约束人的唯一性：在 Bosphorus 数据库上，改变外貌的合作受试者在工作阈值下有 1.8% 的再注册尝试逃逸去重。完整后端集成仍待完成。代码与工件公开。
summary_cn: BioBind 以四接口条件把生物去重-签发-认证绑定为不可替换整体：LFW 原型拒绝组合攻击，ZK 电路 31,445 约束/305k gas，16,384×3 注册零解码错误，改貌逃逸仅 1.8%。
objective_summary: 提出绑定去重、画廊状态与零知识认证的生物识别凭据协议 BioBind，给出条件性组合论证与原型量化评估。
evidence_note: LFW 原型的组合攻击拒绝测试、电路规模与 gas 量化、3×16,384 注册的加密注册测试、Bosphorus 上 1.8% 逃逸率的精度边界分析；条件性安全论证显式列假设。
novelty_note: 把「判定只覆盖被查输入」这一信任域断裂形式化为绑定条件集是新视角；采集绑定 ZK 认证为有用组合，组件各有来源。
scope: 去中心化生物识别凭据的签发与使用；LFW/Bosphorus 人脸特征与所选后端之内。
limitations: 完整后端集成未完成
人脸模板的安全存储假设
活体检测与呈现攻击未在威胁模型内

title: How Far Does Second-Order Linear Response Predict Quantization Mismatch? Pre-Registered Measurements on Five Language Models
abstract: Serving systems choose a weight format for each model and deployment. A low-cost screen predicts the resulting KL divergence from the unquantized model's Fisher information using $\tfrac12\Delta^\top F\Delta$, the expansion underlying Hessian-aware and second-order post-training quantizers. We assess the reliability of this screen in GPU batches with channel-wise int8, per-tensor fp8 and group-wise int4 on Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-4B, OLMo-2-7B, Qwen3-32B and Qwen3-30B-A3B. Relative predictions hold across a 16-fold range of perturbation scales, int4 group sizes and rounding modes, while absolute predictions are heavy-tailed. A trimmed average brings 10 of 12 cells on Qwen3-4B and OLMo-2 within 15% of measured KL. The MoE model exhibits nonquadratic response at small perturbations, with int8 KL scaling as $\alpha^{0.63}$. Computing per-sequence gradients in bf16 can cause fourfold prediction errors. We trace these errors to arithmetic in the lower half of the backward pass and eliminate them by using fp32 there. Batch-invariant kernels run at 0.55 times the throughput, while changes in reduction order introduce a floor of 0.17-0.22 nats per sequence. We build a screener with one streamed fp32 Fisher pass, trimmed tensor-block predictions with a band, a flag for aligned tensors and per-layer format allocation. On the unseen Mistral-7B-v0.3 family, all six predictions fall within the band, all three KL budgets are met, and vLLM throughput is predicted within 0.4%.
title_cn: 二阶线性响应能在多大程度上预测量化失配？五个语言模型的预注册测量
abstract_cn: 服务系统为每个模型与部署选择权重格式。低成本筛子用未量化模型的 Fisher 信息预测由此产生的 KL 散度：½ΔᵀFΔ，即 Hessian 感知与二阶训练后量化器所依赖的展开。我们评估该筛子的可靠性：在 Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-4B、OLMo-2-7B、Qwen3-32B 与 Qwen3-30B-A3B 上以 GPU 批次测试通道 int8、逐张量 fp8 与分组 int4。相对预测在 16 倍扰动尺度、int4 分组大小与舍入模式范围内成立，而绝对预测呈重尾。截断均值使 Qwen3-4B 与 OLMo-2 的 12 格中 10 格落在实测 KL 的 15% 以内。MoE 模型在小扰动下表现出非二次响应，int8 KL 按 α^0.63 缩放。以 bf16 计算逐序列梯度可造成四倍预测误差；我们把误差追溯到反向传播下半部分的算术并用 fp32 消除。批不变内核以 0.55 倍吞吐运行，而归约顺序变化引入每序列 0.17–0.22 nats 的底噪。我们构建一个筛子：单次流式 fp32 Fisher 遍历、带区间的截断张量块预测、对齐张量标志与逐层格式分配。在未见过的 Mistral-7B-v0.3 家族上，全部六个预测落在区间内、全部三个 KL 预算满足、vLLM 吞吐预测误差在 0.4% 内。
summary_cn: 预注册测量评估 Fisher 二阶量化筛：相对预测跨 16 倍尺度成立但 MoE 呈非二次响应（KL∝α^0.63）；fp32 反向修复 4× 误差，未见 Mistral-7B 族预测全落带。
objective_summary: 以预注册测量系统评估二阶 Fisher 展开对量化失配的预测可靠性，定位失效模式（MoE 非二次、bf16 反向误差）并构建改进筛子。
evidence_note: 五模型 × 三格式的预注册测量 + 未见模型族的预测验证（六预测落带、吞吐 0.4% 内）+ 误差源追踪（bf16 反向、归约顺序底噪 0.17–0.22 nats）。
novelty_note: 对二阶筛可靠性边界的系统刻画（MoE 非二次响应、算术误差源）有诊断价值；方法为测量与工程修正的组合。
scope: 语言模型权重量化的 KL 失配预测；所选模型家族与三种量化格式之内。
limitations: KL 为失配的代理指标
MoE 非二次性的理论解释不完整
其他量化范式（如 GPTQ 类）未覆盖

title: Reconfiguring System-Level Protection Through Bounded Delegation in RISC-V MCUs
abstract: MCU-based embedded and cyber-physical systems increasingly require protection policies to change at runtime as resources, software, and system composition evolve. Yet widely used COTS MCU protection mechanisms are still largely designed around statically established policies. While they can restrict which domains modify protection primitives, they generally do not constrain what policy an authorized domain may create. As a result, domains may expand protection rules beyond their intended scope or interfere with boundaries established by other domains. We identify bounded configuration authority as a missing primitive for secure dynamic policy evolution and introduce an ownership-aware model in which explicit ownership and rule containment bound both configuration authority and recursive delegation. Changes to active protection-rule ranges are validated before commit, preserving protection boundaries without extending the normal access-checking datapath. We implement the model in an open-source RISC-V World Checker integrated into a CVA6-based SoC. Our FPGA evaluation shows no degradation in access latency or operating frequency, with 7.1% LUT and 1.2% FF overhead for eight rules. In an OTA update case study, direct reconfiguration under delegated authority reduces policy-transition latency by 89.5% over hypervisor mediation and 94.6% over trusted firmware mediation, while preserving established authority boundaries. All artifacts will be open-sourced to support the evolution of RISC-V specifications and system-level protection designs.
title_cn: 经 RISC-V MCU 有界委托重构系统级保护
abstract_cn: 基于 MCU 的嵌入式与网络-物理系统日益要求保护策略随资源、软件与系统组成演化而在运行时变更。然而广泛使用的 COTS MCU 保护机制仍主要围绕静态建立的策略设计：它们可以限制哪些域修改保护原语，但一般不约束被授权域可以创建什么策略。结果域可能把保护规则扩展到超出其预期范围，或干扰其他域建立的边界。我们识别出「有界配置权威」是安全动态策略演化的缺失原语，并引入一个所有权感知模型：显式所有权与规则包含同时约束配置权威与递归委托。对活动保护规则范围的变更在提交前被验证，在不扩展正常访问检查数据通路的情况下保持保护边界。我们在集成到基于 CVA6 的 SoC 的开源 RISC-V World Checker 中实现该模型。FPGA 评估显示访问延迟或工作频率无退化，八条规则仅 7.1% LUT 与 1.2% FF 开销。在 OTA 更新案例研究中，委托权威下的直接重配置相比 hypervisor 中介把策略转换延迟降低 89.5%、相比可信固件中介降低 94.6%，同时保持既定权威边界。全部工件将开源以支持 RISC-V 规范与系统级保护设计的演化。
summary_cn: RISC-V MCU 的有界配置权威原语：所有权感知模型约束策略创建与递归委托，FPGA 上零延迟退化（8 规则 7.1% LUT），OTA 策略切换较 hypervisor 快 89.5%。
objective_summary: 提出 MCU 动态保护策略的有界配置权威模型：显式所有权与规则包含约束委派，提交前验证，并在 CVA6 SoC 上实现评估。
evidence_note: CVA6 SoC + FPGA 的量化评估（延迟/频率无退化、7.1% LUT/1.2% FF）+ OTA 案例的延迟对比（89.5%/94.6%）；单一 SoC 平台。
novelty_note: 识别「有界配置权威」缺失原语并给出所有权感知的形式化模型是实质性架构贡献；实现与开源工件增强可信度。
scope: RISC-V MCU/SoC 的系统级保护策略演化；World Checker 类架构之内。
limitations: 八条规则的小规模评估
委托链深度与冲突情形的测试有限
对 COTS MCU（非 RISC-V）的适配需另行设计

title: Double Blind Evals: Resolving the Dual Confidentiality Dilemma in AI Safety Auditing
abstract: AI safety evaluations often involve sensitive prompts and proprietary models. Evaluators want to keep their evaluation prompts secret from model owners to prevent purposeful or incidental data leakage, ensuring longer usefulness of their benchmark. Model owners in turn wish to keep their proprietary model weights and inference code within their own secure infrastructure to protect their IP. We present a way forward for "double-blind evals", which provide cryptographic guarantees that an evaluator's prompts are not shared with the model owner, while simultaneously maintaining the confidentiality of the model weights and inference code. To accomplish this, we use secure enclaves that encrypt data in RAM at the hardware level. In a world-first pilot, we test this approach by evaluating a proprietary Google DeepMind model (Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite) against a selection of the private AILuminate benchmark corpus, using an NVIDIA H100 secure enclave on Google Cloud Platform, and using OpenMined's PySyft to maintain data and model privacy. We believe this effort marks the first use of this technology to provide mutual secrecy for one organization's frontier-class proprietary model weights and another organization's closed benchmark.
title_cn: 双盲评估：化解 AI 安全审计中的双重机密困境
abstract_cn: AI 安全评估常涉及敏感提示与专有模型。评估方希望其评估提示对模型所有者保密，以防蓄意或附带的数据泄露、延长基准的有效期；模型所有者则希望其专有模型权重与推理代码留在自己的安全基础设施内以保护知识产权。我们为「双盲评估」指出一条路径：提供密码学保证，使评估方的提示不与模型所有者共享，同时保持模型权重与推理代码的机密性。为此我们使用在硬件层加密 RAM 数据的安全 enclave。在全球首次试点中，我们以该方法在 Google Cloud Platform 的 NVIDIA H100 安全 enclave 上、使用 OpenMined 的 PySyft 维护数据与模型隐私，对专有 Google DeepMind 模型（Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite）评测私有 AILuminate 基准语料的选段。我们相信这一努力标志着首次用该技术为一个组织的前沿专有模型权重与另一组织的封闭基准提供相互保密。
summary_cn: 双盲评估基础设施：H100 安全 enclave + PySyft 使评估提示与专有模型权重互相保密，全球首次试点（Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite × 私有 AILuminate 语料）。
objective_summary: 提出基于硬件安全 enclave 的双盲 AI 评估方案，使评估方提示与模型方权重/推理代码互相保密，并以世界首次试点验证可行性。
evidence_note: 真实试点（GCP H100 enclave、专有模型 × 私有基准、PySyft）证明工程可行性；单次试点、无系统性能与对抗分析。
novelty_note: 以安全 enclave 同时保证评估方与模型方双向机密是评估基础设施的新范式；首次真实试点具先行价值。
scope: AI 安全评估的双向机密场景；所选 enclave 平台与基准类型之内。
limitations: 单次试点规模
enclave 侧信道残余风险未讨论
评分可复现性与审计流程未详述

title: Covert System Identification Under Timing Constraints: A Static Linear Model and Its Detectability Implications
abstract: This paper studies covert system identification in cyber-physical systems, where an attacker infers plant dynamics while attempting to remain stealthy. We introduce a lightweight static linear model in which the time to execute a setpoint change is proportional to the commanded speed difference. On a Siemens PROFINET testbed this gain captures the drive's ramp response accurately but not its terminal overshoot. That omitted transient becomes the attacker's main exposure: on real traces, the residual left by the linear masking procedure is detected by two anomaly monitors, Process-Aware Stealthy-Attack Detection (PASAD) and the CUSUM change detector. Across the cascade identification and staircase attack strategies defined in the paper, the stealth boundary relates to the plant's own settling transients, a structural limit for this class of models under the adopted detector-calibration regime. Comparison against dynamic models obtained by N4SID, trained at multiple excitation amplitudes, shows that the evaluated N4SID models do not improve stealth over the structure-informed ramp model. Since per-cycle computation is negligible for both procedures, the binding trade-off is not inference cost but whether the attacker can acquire and refresh a model without injecting detectable perturbations.
comment: Presented at the 27th International Symposium on Measurement and Control in Robotics (ISMCR 2026), Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. Proceedings forthcoming in Springer's Mechanisms and Machine Science series
title_cn: 时序约束下的隐蔽系统辨识：静态线性模型及其可检测性含义
abstract_cn: 本文研究网络-物理系统中的隐蔽系统辨识：攻击者推断被控对象动态的同时试图保持隐蔽。我们引入一个轻量的静态线性模型：执行设定值变更的时间与指令速度差成正比。在 Siemens PROFINET 测试床上，该增益准确捕捉驱动的斜坡响应但不能捕捉其终端过冲。被省略的瞬态成为攻击者的主要暴露：在真实轨迹上，线性掩码程序留下的残差被两个异常监控器——过程感知隐蔽攻击检测（PASAD）与 CUSUM 变化检测器——检出。跨文中定义的级联辨识与阶梯攻击策略，隐蔽边界与被控对象自身的整定瞬态相关，是该类模型在所采用的检测器校准体制下的结构极限。与在多激励幅度下训练的 N4SID 动态模型比较显示，被评估的 N4SID 模型并不比结构感知的斜坡模型更隐蔽。由于两个过程的每周期计算都可忽略，约束性权衡不是推断成本，而是攻击者能否在不注入可检测扰动的情况下获取并刷新模型。ISMCR 2026 报告，Springer 文集 forthcoming。
summary_cn: PROFINET 测试床上的隐蔽系统辨识研究：静态线性模型的斜坡增益准确但终端过冲残差被 PASAD/CUSUM 检出，隐蔽边界受被控对象整定瞬态约束。
objective_summary: 以 Siemens PROFINET 测试床评估隐蔽系统辨识模型的暴露点，量化线性掩码残差在 PASAD/CUSUM 下的可检测性并与 N4SID 动态模型比较。
evidence_note: 真实 PROFINET 测试床轨迹 + PASAD/CUSUM 双监控器评估 + N4SID 多激励幅度对照；单测试床、无统计检验。
novelty_note: 把隐蔽辨识的可检测性与被控对象固有整定瞬态联系为结构极限是有诊断价值的结论；「约束是模型获取而非推断成本」的观察清晰。
scope: 运动控制类 CPS 的设定值操纵场景；所采用的检测器校准体制之内。
limitations: 单一 PROFINET 测试床
检测器校准体制影响结论
攻击策略空间限于两类

title: Text2NGAC: a multi-LLM pipeline for NGAC policy extraction with mutation-based verification
abstract: Access-control policies are written in natural language but enforced as formal models, and translating them into NIST Next Generation Access Control (NGAC) graphs remains unsolved: prior systems cover only subsets of the NGAC model, and none verify the graphs they extract. We present Text2NGAC, a pipeline of cooperating large language models that disambiguates each sentence before extraction, escalates uncertain sentences to a multi-model ensemble, and checks the resulting graph with a five-strategy verifier whose own effectiveness is measured by controlled mutation testing. To our knowledge it is the first system to extract all four NGAC relationship types - associations, prohibitions, event-response obligations, and assignments - from real-world policy documents. Three results anchor the evaluation. The verifier detects 99.7% of 918 injected mutants and every structural fail-open fault, and the fault classes it misses are characterized and weighted by security consequence rather than left unexamined. The extracted graphs are enforceable: one corpus's graph loads unmodified into the NIST reference implementation, which reproduces all 55 access decisions the graph entails and fires an extracted obligation end-to-end. Extraction reaches 97.3-99.6% exact-tuple-match accuracy on the 714 scored sentences of four real corpora, far above three reproduced baselines on matched metrics, and paraphrase probes with semantic re-scoring bound the pipeline's sensitivity to rewording. Reported accuracy is wording- and benchmark-specific, adversarial input is outside the verifier's guarantees, and the intended deployment is extraction plus structural verification feeding expert review. A complete two-tier reproducibility artifact accompanies the paper.
comment: 33 pages, 6 figures. Under review at Cybersecurity (SpringerOpen)
title_cn: Text2NGAC：带变异验证的多 LLM NGAC 策略抽取流水线
abstract_cn: 访问控制策略以自然语言书写却以形式模型执行，把它们翻译成 NIST 下一代访问控制（NGAC）图仍未解决：先前系统只覆盖 NGAC 模型的子集，且无一验证其抽取的图。我们提出 Text2NGAC，一个协作大语言模型流水线：抽取前消歧每个句子、把不确定句子升级到多模型集成，并用五策略验证器检查所得图——验证器自身的有效性由受控变异测试测量。据我们所知，它是首个从真实策略文档抽取全部四类 NGAC 关系（关联、禁止、事件-响应义务与分配）的系统。三个结果锚定评估：验证器检出 918 个注入突变中的 99.7% 与全部结构性 fail-open 故障，且其漏检故障类被刻画并按安全后果加权而非搁置；抽取的图可执行——一个语料的图不加修改载入 NIST 参考实现，复现图所蕴含的全部 55 个访问决策并端到端触发一条抽取的义务；抽取在四个真实语料的 714 个计分句上达到 97.3–99.6% 精确元组匹配准确率，远高于三个在相同指标下复现的基线，且带语义重评分的改写探针界定了流水线对措辞的敏感度。报告的准确率是措辞与基准特定的，对抗输入在验证器保证之外，预期部署是抽取加结构验证再交专家评审。完整的两层可复现工件随论文提供。在审 Cybersecurity（SpringerOpen）。
summary_cn: Text2NGAC 首个抽取全部四类 NGAC 关系的多 LLM 流水线：变异测试检出 99.7% 突变，图直接载入 NIST 参考实现复现全部 55 个决策，714 句精确匹配 97.3–99.6%。
objective_summary: 构建多 LLM 协作的自然语言到 NGAC 图抽取流水线，以五策略验证器与受控变异测试保证结构正确性并在 NIST 参考实现中验证可执行性。
evidence_note: 918 突变 99.7% 检出 + 全部 fail-open 故障、NIST 参考实现的端到端执行验证（55 决策 + 义务触发）、714 句量化抽取与三基线对照、完整可复现工件。
novelty_note: 首个覆盖全部四类 NGAC 关系并以变异测试自我校验验证器的抽取系统；验证器有效性度量方法本身有方法学价值。
scope: 自然语言策略文档到 NGAC 图的抽取；措辞与基准特定的准确率声明（作者自陈）；对抗输入不在保证内。
limitations: LLM 抽取对措辞敏感
义务类关系的语义完备性依赖文档质量
对抗性策略文档可绕过验证器保证

title: Hidden in Plain Sight: Privacy-Enhanced Computing Through Register Renaming
abstract: Privacy-Enhanced Computing (PEC) is a mechanism to hide program secrets from the outside world without paying the cost of fully-homomorphic encryption. Previous work has developed hardware mechanisms to achieve this goal but they require a dedicated processor enclave where all computations are done, requiring duplicate ALU resources and limiting the performance of PEC-utilizing applications due to not being able to access the full compute resources of the processor (e.g., multiple execution units and vector units), or not being able to execute PEC instructions in parallel and out-of-order. In this work, we introduce HPS-PEC (Hidden in Plain Sight PEC), a novel method of utilizing existing infrastructure in the CPU to achieve PEC with minor modifications to the architecture. We show that, across 25 VIP-Bench benchmarks and with a 7-cycle QARMA-64 cipher, HPS-PEC runs encrypted code at 3.41x the execution time of unprotected native code (geometric mean), of which 1.03x is the cost of data-oblivious code itself, and is 1.26x faster than a Sequestered Encryption (SE) unit while utilizing under a third of its dedicated area. Our method keeps plaintext out of reach of every instruction, as an enclave does given a correctly functioning renamer and register file, which every program already depends on.
title_cn: 藏于众目睽睽之下：经寄存器重命名的隐私增强计算
abstract_cn: 隐私增强计算（PEC）是在不支付全同态加密代价的情况下向外部世界隐藏程序秘密的机制。先前工作开发了实现该目标的硬件机制，但它们要求一个完成全部计算的专用处理器 enclave：需要重复的 ALU 资源，并因无法访问处理器的完整计算资源（如多执行单元与向量单元）或无法并行、乱序执行 PEC 指令而限制 PEC 应用的性能。本工作提出 HPS-PEC（Hidden in Plain Sight PEC），一种利用 CPU 中既有基础设施、仅需少量架构修改实现 PEC 的新方法。我们展示：跨 25 个 VIP-Bench 基准与 7 周期 QARMA-64 密码，HPS-PEC 以 3.41 倍非保护原生代码的执行时间（几何均值）运行加密代码，其中 1.03 倍是数据无关代码本身的代价；同时比隔离加密（Sequestered Encryption）单元快 1.26 倍且仅用其三分之一以下的专用面积。该方法使明文对每条指令都不可达——正如一个重命名器与寄存器文件正确工作的 enclave 所保证的那样，而每个程序本已依赖这一点。
summary_cn: HPS-PEC 借寄存器重命名等既有 CPU 机制实现隐私增强计算：25 基准几何均值 3.41× 原生执行时间，较专用 SE 单元快 1.26× 且面积不足三分之一。
objective_summary: 提出以寄存器重命名基础设施实现隐私增强计算的 HPS-PEC：无需专用 enclave 即可保证明文对指令不可达，并量化性能与面积开销。
evidence_note: 25 个 VIP-Bench + QARMA-64 的量化评估（3.41× 几何均值、1.03× 数据无关代价、1.26× 于 SE 单元、面积 <1/3）；微架构仿真评估。
novelty_note: 把 PEC 所需的机密性寄生于每程序本已依赖的寄存器重命名/寄存器堆正确性是新颖的架构视角；免去专用 enclave 的复制资源与并行性损失。
scope: 支持寄存器重命名的乱序/标量处理器；数据无关代码转换的适用范围。
limitations: 需编译器/二进制转换配合
对微架构侧信道（时序）之外的物理攻击未覆盖
重命名器故障模式的威胁分析为假设性

title: ML Models Are Not Ciphers: Power Analysis for Weight Extraction Is Harder Than You Think
abstract: Can power-analysis techniques reveal secret weights of machine-learning models? Multiple recent works demonstrate proof-of-concept attacks that can partially recover such weights. To that end, these works build on techniques from cryptographic engineering, treating the model as a ``cipher'' and its secret weights as keys. We question the basic assumption behind such straightforward adaptations of cryptographic attacks and highlight the challenges arising when applying past techniques to fully recover all layers of deep neural networks. Unlike past works, which extract only a few weights, typically from shallow layers, we investigate the recovery of complete networks. Moreover, we target fully trained and functional models, rather than untrained, randomly initialized networks. To focus on fundamental challenges, we assume an unrealistically strong side-channel adversary that can directly observe the output of the leakage model without any added noise. With this adversary, we show that machine-learning models differ significantly from cryptographic implementations, giving rise to unique challenges that have not been observed in the prior art. We observe two main differences between machine-learning models and ciphers. First, in contrast to the high-diffusion nonlinear integer arithmetic prevalent in cryptographic schemes, machine-learning models tend to use limited-precision floating-point arithmetic and low-diffusion linear operations. We show that these operations introduce difficulties in weight recovery, often requiring an unexpectedly large number of traces, even under ideal channel conditions. Second, we observe that, unlike ciphers, which aim to increase the data entropy, machine-learning models aim to reduce it. This reduces data variability as the algorithm progresses, hampering weight recovery in deep layers of the model. (details can be found in the paper)
title_cn: ML 模型不是密码：权重提取的功耗分析比你想象的更难
abstract_cn: 功耗分析技术能揭示机器学习模型的秘密权重吗？多个近期工作展示了可部分恢复此类权重的概念验证攻击。为此这些工作借用密码工程技术，把模型当作「密码」、其秘密权重当作密钥。我们质疑这种对密码攻击直接适配背后的基本假设，并突出把过去技术应用于完整恢复深度神经网络所有层时出现的挑战。与过去只提取浅层少量权重的工作不同，我们研究完整网络的恢复，且目标是完全训练、可用的模型而非未训练的随机初始化网络。为聚焦根本挑战，我们假设一个不现实地强的侧信道对手：能直接观察泄漏模型的输出而无任何附加噪声。在这一对手下，我们展示机器学习模型与密码实现显著不同，产生先前未观察到的独特挑战。我们观察到 ML 模型与密码的两大差异：第一，与密码方案中高扩散的非线性整数算术相反，ML 模型倾向使用有限精度浮点算术与低扩散线性运算——我们展示这些运算给权重恢复带来困难，常需要出乎意料多的轨迹，即使在理想信道条件下；第二，与旨在提高数据熵的密码不同，ML 模型旨在降低熵。这使算法推进中数据变异性降低，阻碍模型深层的权重恢复（细节见论文）。
summary_cn: 质疑把功耗分析从密码移植到 ML 权重提取的适配假设：低扩散浮点线性运算 + 模型降熵使深层恢复需异常多轨迹——即便在无噪声理想信道下。
objective_summary: 在理想化强对手假设下实验分析对完整训练后神经网络做功耗权重提取的根本困难，识别与密码实现的两类结构性差异。
evidence_note: 理想化无噪声对手的受控实验设计（聚焦根本挑战）+ 与密码实现的系统性对比分析；「细节见论文」提示摘要层面数字有限。
novelty_note: 对「模型即密码」适配假设的质疑与两类结构性障碍（低扩散线性运算、熵递减）的刻画是对模型提取攻击可行性的重要修正。
scope: 深度神经网络的物理侧信道权重提取；理想化泄漏观测假设之内。
limitations: 理想化对手不含真实测量噪声
结论针对完整网络恢复而非部分提取
对防御设计的直接含义有限

title: Brief introduction to post-quantum cryptography in industrial applications
abstract: The development of Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) is directly motivated by the necessity to secure information in the face of the quantum threat. This paper provides an overview of recent developments relevant to PQC adoption across several industrial applications, including IoT, healthcare, civil and infrastructure engineering, and defense. We present a brief, self-contained overview of PQC and its market positioning. We perform implementation experiments on selected quantum-safe methods and quantify several aspects, such as the quantum resources required to break common cryptographic schemes, as well as the performance of the most well-known PQC algorithms. We also discuss the resistance of different PQC classes to quantum attacks and the status of PQC implementations in different programming languages. Finally, we present benchmark results on KEMs and signature algorithms to help select the appropriate algorithm for a specific application based on criteria such as algorithm performance, data lifetime, and level of data sensitivity.
title_cn: 工业应用后量子密码简介
abstract_cn: 后量子密码（PQC）的发展直接源于面对量子威胁保护信息的必要性。本文概述与 PQC 在若干工业应用中采纳相关的近期发展，包括物联网、医疗、土木与基础设施工程及国防。我们对 PQC 及其市场定位给出简明的自足概述。我们对选定的量子安全方法进行实现实验，并量化多个方面：破解常见密码方案所需的量子资源、最知名 PQC 算法的性能等。我们还讨论不同 PQC 类对量子攻击的抵抗及 PQC 在不同编程语言中实现的状态。最后给出 KEM 与签名算法的基准结果，帮助基于算法性能、数据寿命与数据敏感度等标准为特定应用选择合适算法。
summary_cn: 工业 PQC 采纳概述：IoT/医疗/土木/国防场景的实现实验与 KEM/签名基准，按性能、数据寿命与敏感度给出算法选择指引。
objective_summary: 概述 PQC 在工业应用的采纳状况，附实现实验、量子资源量化与 KEM/签名基准结果及选择指引。
evidence_note: 自述含实现实验与基准结果；但为概述性简介，方法学与实验设置细节有限（摘要无具体数字）。
novelty_note: PQC 概述与基准已有大量文献；面向特定工业场景的整理与选择指引是主要增量。
scope: 工业应用（IoT/医疗/土木/国防）的 PQC 采纳概述。
limitations: 简介性质，深度有限
基准平台与参数未在摘要说明
标准演化的时效性风险

title: Say Shibboleth: Fingerprinting the LLMs and Harnesses Behind Agentic Attacks
abstract: We study the fingerprinting of agentic cyberattacks. Our objective is to reliably infer information about the attacker's configuration, such as LLM version and harness, from telemetry. To achieve this, we introduce a technique we call shibboleth traps: modular honeypot services designed to elicit discriminative behaviors from agentic attackers. The traps make informative interactions a condition for obtaining resources the agent seeks, eliciting model declarations and characteristic writing without requiring a successful prompt injection. To achieve harness fingerprinting, we introduce general mechanisms to indirectly probe peculiar execution behaviors of harnesses. These probes reveal how a harness masks secrets in tool output, enforces command time limits, and schedules tool calls, using only the effects visible in subsequent requests. We show that combined declarative and behavioral inference distinguishes among 15 candidate models with an average 90% top-1 accuracy, with behavioral classifiers evaluated on held-out harnesses or task families. In a separate experiment across four harnesses, fixed probe rules identify the correct harness with 92% accuracy. When instructed to conceal their identity, agents still leave useful behavioral evidence even as their declarations become uninformative.
title_cn: 说出暗语：对智能体攻击背后的 LLM 与 Harness 指纹识别
abstract_cn: 我们研究智能体网络攻击的指纹识别。目标是从遥测可靠推断攻击者配置的信息，如 LLM 版本与 harness。为此我们引入称为暗语陷阱（shibboleth traps）的技术：模块化蜜罐服务，设计用来从智能体攻击者引出判别性行为。陷阱把信息性交互设为获取智能体所求资源的条件，引出模型声明与特征性写作，而不需要成功的提示注入。为实现 harness 指纹识别，我们引入间接探测 harness 特异执行行为的通用机制。这些探针揭示 harness 如何在工具输出中掩蔽秘密、如何强制命令时限、如何调度工具调用——仅使用后续请求中可见的效应。我们展示声明式与行为式推断的组合能区分 15 个候选模型，平均 90% 的 top-1 准确率，行为分类器在留出的 harness 或任务族上评估。在跨四个 harness 的单独实验中，固定探针规则以 92% 准确率识别正确的 harness。当被指示隐藏身份时，智能体在其声明变得无信息的同时仍留下有用的行为证据。
summary_cn: 暗语陷阱：以资源获取为条件引出判别行为的蜜罐指纹识别——15 候选模型平均 90% top-1、四 harness 固定探针 92%，隐藏指令下声明失效但行为证据仍存。
objective_summary: 提出经模块化蜜罐陷阱指纹识别攻击智能体 LLM 与 harness 的技术：声明式+行为式推断，并间接探测 harness 的执行特异行为。
evidence_note: 15 候选模型平均 90% top-1（行为分类器留出评估）、四 harness 92%、隐藏身份条件实验；攻击者由合成智能体代表，真实威胁覆盖未知。
novelty_note: 「暗语陷阱」——把资源获取设计为引出判别行为的条件——是对智能体攻击者归因的新能力；间接探测 harness 执行特异行为（秘密掩蔽/时限/调度）是新颖机制。
scope: 蜜罐可达的智能体攻击场景；15 模型与 4 harness 候选集之内。
limitations: 模型/候选集会随生态演化过期
合成攻击者与真实攻击者的行为分布差距
单轮交互之外的强对抗未测

title: Detecting Shadow AI: Unsanctioned LLM Agents on Enterprise Endpoints: A Taxonomy, an Open Detector and a Controlled Evaluation
abstract: Shadow IT, the use of technology that the IT organisation has not approved, is a long-standing governance problem. We argue that autonomous AI agents can make it grow much faster: agents make building tools nearly free, act with their user's privileges, and leave behind scripts, automations and MCP servers that are themselves unsanctioned. A simple compounding model shows that, under its assumptions, shadow IT grows exponentially once agentic artifacts reproduce faster than the organisation retires them; retiring them starts with detecting them. We then ask whether unsanctioned agents can be detected on Windows endpoints. We propose a taxonomy of nine classes of agents and six layers of endpoint footprint, and argue that rules based only on the structure of processes and connections cannot separate an agent from its behavioural twin, the same program talking to a non-AI service. We present Agent Detector, an open-source Windows detector that anchors behaviour to the identity of the remote service and correlates it with configuration, installation and execution history, using a catalog of 39 tools and 184 LLM endpoint entries; it informs users through a notice they must acknowledge instead of blocking. On a controlled bench of 12 synthetic agents, 3 AI components and 9 benign workloads, repeated 5 times on one workstation, two behavioural rules flagged every behavioural twin, while Agent Detector flagged none and detected every agent in the majority of runs. Its limits are temporal: a connection to a provider behind a shared content-delivery network is attributable only while the DNS cache holds the provider's name, one to five minutes, and an intermittent agent was seen by about one scan in three. A scan costs about 154 ms. The bench is too small to rank detectors; it maps what each kind of evidence can see: unsanctioned agents can be partly detected, and not by behaviour alone.
comment: 55 pages, 13 figures, 14 tables. Code, catalog and evaluation bench: this https URL
title_cn: 检测影子 AI：企业终端上的未授权 LLM 智能体——分类法、开源检测器与受控评估
abstract_cn: 影子 IT——使用 IT 组织未批准的技术——是长期治理问题。我们论证自主 AI 智能体能使它增长得更快：智能体使构建工具近乎免费、以其用户权限行动，并留下脚本、自动化与 MCP 服务器这些本身未被授权的工件。一个简单的复合模型显示，在其假设下，一旦智能体工件的繁殖快于组织的退役速度，影子 IT 即指数增长；退役始于检测。我们随后追问：未授权智能体能否在 Windows 终端上被检测。我们提出九类智能体与六层终端足迹的分类法，并论证仅基于进程与连接结构的规则无法把智能体与其行为孪生——同一程序与非 AI 服务通信——分开。我们提出 Agent Detector，一个开源 Windows 检测器：把行为锚定到远程服务身份并与配置、安装与执行历史关联，使用含 39 个工具与 184 个 LLM 端点条目的目录；它通过用户必须确认的通知而非阻断来告知。在 12 个合成智能体、3 个 AI 组件与 9 个良性负载、单工作站重复 5 次的受控台架上，两条行为规则标记了每个行为孪生，而 Agent Detector 无一误报并在多数运行中检出全部智能体。其局限是时间性的：到共享内容分发网络后面提供商的连接只在 DNS 缓存持有提供商名称的期间（一到五分钟）可归因，间歇性智能体约每三次扫描被看到一次。单次扫描约 154 毫秒。台架太小无法给检测器排序；它映射了每类证据能看到什么：未授权智能体可以被部分检测，且不能仅靠行为。
summary_cn: Windows 影子 AI 智能体检测：九类×六层足迹分类 + 服务身份锚定检测器（39 工具/184 端点目录），单工作站台架零误报且多数运行全检出，DNS 缓存窗口为关键时限。
objective_summary: 构建未授权 LLM 智能体的终端检测分类法与开源检测器 Agent Detector，以行为孪生对照评估检测能力与时间性局限。
evidence_note: 单工作站、12 合成智能体 × 5 次重复的受控台架；行为孪生对照设计巧妙但作者明示台架太小无法排序检测器；局限（DNS 缓存 1–5 分钟）量化。
novelty_note: 「行为孪生不可分、需服务身份锚定」的核心论点与九类×六层分类法是新的检测视角；开源工具填补治理空白。
scope: Windows 终端上 LLM 智能体的未授权使用检测；合成台架与目录覆盖之内。
limitations: 单工作站小规模台架
间歇性智能体约 1/3 检出
真实企业流量的假阳性率未测

title: An Agile Homomorphic Encryption and ML-KEM Scheme for Privacy-Preserving Health Data Processing
abstract: The storage and processing of health data raise serious privacy concerns; therefore, the data must be encrypted. Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) allows computations on encrypted data, which makes it a very promising technology in this context. However, although the efficiency of FHE algorithms has improved in recent years, they remain very complex. The security of several prominent FHE schemes is based on variants of the Learning With Errors (LWE) problem, which is also the basis of Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism (ML-KEM), the new post-quantum standard for asymmetric encryption. In this paper, we propose an agile cryptographic scheme -combining ML-KEM and BGV -that allows efficient implementations in an embedded use case. We describe the parameter selection for the proposed scheme and show its feasibility with a proof-of-concept implementation.
title_cn: 面向隐私保护健康数据处理的敏捷同态加密与 ML-KEM 方案
abstract_cn: 健康数据的存储与处理引发严重隐私关切，因此数据必须加密。全同态加密（FHE）允许在加密数据上计算，使其在该情境中非常有前景。然而尽管 FHE 算法效率近年已有提升，它们仍然非常复杂。多个著名 FHE 方案的安全性基于学习_WITH_错误（LWE）问题的变体——这也是基于模格的密钥封装机制（ML-KEM，非对称加密的新后量子标准）的基础。本文提出一个敏捷的密码方案——结合 ML-KEM 与 BGV——允许在嵌入式用例中高效实现。我们描述所提方案的参数选择，并以概念验证实现展示其可行性。
summary_cn: 结合 ML-KEM 与 BGV 的敏捷密码方案面向嵌入式健康数据处理：给出参数选择并以概念验证实现展示可行性。
objective_summary: 设计 ML-KEM 密钥封装与 BGV 同态加密共享格参数的敏捷组合方案，面向嵌入式场景并给出参数选择与概念验证实现。
evidence_note: 概念验证实现与参数选择论证；无系统性能基准或与既有组合方案的对照。
novelty_note: ML-KEM 与 BGV 共享格难题的参数协同属工程化组合；敏捷性设计思路常规。
scope: 嵌入式健康数据处理场景；BGV 与 ML-KEM 的参数空间之内。
limitations: 仅概念验证规模
性能与资源占用未系统量化
健康数据合规要求的端到端方案未覆盖

title: An Explicit Below Half Threshold Bound for the Local Leakage Resilience of Shamir's Secret Sharing Scheme
abstract: As a fundamental cryptographic primitive, secret sharing distributes a secret among multiple parties and allows certain authorized parties to recover the secret while preventing unauthorized parties from knowing the secret. However, local leakage from each party member allows an adversary to learn partial information from each share, which is not guaranteed by traditional security. In this paper, we study bounds on the reconstruction threshold of Shamir's secret sharing scheme over prime fields against arbitrary 1-bit local leakage. We show that, for all sufficiently large $n$ and every prime $p>n$, the $(n,t)$-Shamir's scheme is $\exp(-\Omega(n))$-resilient whenever $t/n\geq 0.489$, for any choice of distinct nonzero evaluation points. Our proof refines the dual-code list recovery analysis and combines complementary Fourier estimates according to the support sizes and biases of the leakage functions, yielding an improved explicit reconstruction threshold bound.
title_cn: Shamir 秘密分享方案局部泄漏弹性的半阈值以下的显式界
abstract_cn: 作为基础密码原语，秘密分享把秘密分布给多方，允许特定授权方恢复秘密、同时防止未授权方知晓秘密。然而来自每个成员的局部泄漏允许对手从每份份额学习部分信息，这是传统安全性不保证的。本文研究素域上 Shamir 秘密分享方案在任意 1 比特局部泄漏下重构阈值的界。我们证明：对所有充分大的 n 与每个素数 p>n，当 t/n≥0.489 时，(n,t)-Shamir 方案具有 exp(−Ω(n)) 的弹性，对任意互异非零求值点选择成立。我们的证明精化了对偶码列表恢复分析，并按泄漏函数的支撑大小与偏置组合互补的傅里叶估计，得到改进的显式重构阈值界。
summary_cn: 证明素域上 (n,t)-Shamir 在任意 1 比特局部泄漏下 t/n≥0.489 即有 exp(−Ω(n)) 弹性：精化对偶码列表恢复 + 按支撑/偏置组合傅里叶估计，改进显式阈值。
objective_summary: 研究 Shamir 秘密分享对任意 1 比特局部泄漏的重构阈值，给出低于半阈值（0.489）的显式弹性界与证明技术。
evidence_note: 显式常数阈值（0.489）的完整证明；对任意互异非零求值点成立；证明技术（对偶码列表恢复 + 傅里叶估计组合）具体。
novelty_note: 把局部泄漏弹性阈值推到半阈值以下的显式界，改进该研究线的已知结果；属既定问题（泄漏弹性 Shamir）的实质推进而非新方向。
scope: 素域上 Shamir 秘密分享与 1 比特局部泄漏模型；充分大 n 的渐近设定。
limitations: 限于 1 比特泄漏
渐近（充分大 n）非小参数
泄漏函数有界偏置假设

title: Public, Identifiable, and Effectively Immutable: Ethical Lessons from Research on arXiv
abstract: Ethical decision-making is central to safe cybersecurity research. Recent studies, one of which is our own, analyzing the source files of arXiv papers bring this challenge to light - arXiv publicly distributes the source files, to the surprise of many authors. Unique aspects reveal ethical challenges and dilemmas that extend beyond established ethical frameworks, institutional processes, and community best practices. In this work, we examine this case and provide insights for similar research on other public live resources, such as Zenodo or the Wayback Machine. While such empirical studies are particularly realistic, they must account for personally identifiable information, leaked secrets, and other sensitive details that could expose, shame, or otherwise negatively affect individuals, possibly leading to both reputational and practical harm. sDrawing on our collective experience and discussions among researchers, affected authors, and readers, we make three contributions: First, we define the ethical setting and highlight that even intentionally-public data with deliberate real-name attribution can raise ethical concerns when repurposed for empirical analysis. Second, we discuss the ethical issues surrounding the use of arXiv data and derive four higher-level dilemmas that researchers may face when working with similar data. Third, we derive practical guidance for ethically navigating such settings and, in doing so, distill four lessons for research on arXiv and similar public, live datasets: public availability should serve as the starting point of ethical reasoning; research should minimize the amplification it induces on exposed information; disclosure should be calibrated to the harm, confidence, and actionability of a finding; and effective immutability must be accounted for. Together, these contribute to community resources for ethically-sound cybersecurity experiments.
comment: 11 pages, accepted at the 19th Workshop on Cyber Security Experimentation and Test (CSET 26), co-located with the 42nd Annual Computer Security Applications Conference (ACSAC 26)
title_cn: 公开、可识别且事实上不可变：arXiv 研究的伦理教训
abstract_cn: 伦理决策是安全网络安全研究的核心。近期研究——包括我们自己的——分析了 arXiv 论文的源文件，凸显了这一挑战：arXiv 公开分发源文件，这让许多作者感到意外。独特方面揭示了超出既有伦理框架、机构流程与社区最佳实践的伦理挑战与困境。在本工作中我们考察该案例，并为对其他公开活性资源（如 Zenodo 或 Wayback Machine）的类似研究提供洞见。虽然此类实证研究特别贴近现实，但它们必须处理可能暴露、羞辱或以其他方式负面影响的个人信息、泄露密钥与其他敏感细节，可能造成声誉与实际伤害。借鉴我们与研究者、受影响作者及读者讨论的集体经验，我们做出三个贡献：第一，定义伦理情境，指出即使是带刻意实名署名的有意公开数据，在被转用于实证分析时也可能引发伦理关切；第二，讨论围绕 arXiv 数据使用的伦理问题并推导研究者可能面临的四个更高层困境；第三，推导在此类情境中合乎伦理行事的实用指导，并为此提炼针对 arXiv 及类似公开活性数据集研究的四条教训：公开可得性应作为伦理推理的起点；研究应最小化其对已暴露信息的放大；披露应按发现的危害、置信度与可行动性校准；必须考虑有效不可变性。CSET@ACSAC 2026 录用。
summary_cn: 基于 arXiv 源文件研究经验的安全研究伦理反思：四条教训（公开性是伦理起点、最小化放大、校准披露、考虑有效不可变性），CSET@ACSAC 2026。
objective_summary: 以 arXiv 源文件实证研究的伦理经验为案例，推导公开活性数据集研究的四条伦理教训与四个研究困境。
evidence_note: 基于自身研究与多方讨论的经验性反思；无新实验数据；CSET@ACSAC 2026 研讨会录用。
novelty_note: 「有效不可变性」「最小化放大」等提法对公开数据安全研究有实用指引；总体属经验教训整理而非新方法。
scope: 以 arXiv 为代表的公开活性数据集上的安全实证研究伦理。
limitations: 经验基础限于作者团队案例
四条教训的可操作性依赖具体情境
无机构伦理流程的对接建议细节

title: Lessons Not Learned: Why Cross-Chain Bridges Keep Losing Billions the Same Way
abstract: Bridge hacks have cost billions, often without exploiting a code bug. In the cross-chain bridge hacks we catalogue from 2021 to 2026, failures of security posture, meaning how a bridge's people, code, controls and off-chain infrastructure are set up, account for 88% of reported losses since 2023, and nearly all repeat earlier failures. Code audits cannot catch these failures, so we propose a bridge security assessment rubric. It scores each bridge deployment from on-chain evidence, and a hard cap drops the score to the lowest value when a fatal risk is present. A token is only as safe as its weakest deployment if all its deployments share one backing. For attacks nobody anticipated, we show that rate limits and an emergency stop still bound the loss. We build an analyzer that applies the rubric to deployed bridges and monitors them for changes, and an agentic analyzer that runs the same checks on any bridge. Operators learn what to fix, and users can compare bridges. Our rubric's controls cut bridge hack losses 105-fold, from \$3.52B to \$33M.
title_cn: 未吸取的教训：跨链桥为何总以同样方式损失数十亿
abstract_cn: 桥接攻击已造成数十亿美元损失，且往往不利用代码漏洞。在我们编目的 2021 至 2026 年跨链桥攻击中，安全姿态的失败——即桥的人员、代码、控制与链下基础设施如何设置——占 2023 年以来报告损失的 88%，且几乎全部重复早先的失败。代码审计无法捕获这些失败，因此我们提出桥接安全评估量规：从链上证据对每个桥部署打分，并在存在致命风险时用硬顶把分数降到最低值。若一个代币的所有部署共享同一背书，代币的安全性取决于其最弱部署。对无人预料的攻击，我们证明速率限制与紧急停止仍能约束损失。我们构建把量规应用到已部署桥并监控其变化的分析器，以及对任意桥执行相同检查的智能体分析器。运营者知道要修什么，用户可以比较桥。我们量规的控制能把桥接攻击损失削减 105 倍：从 35.2 亿美元到 3,300 万美元。
summary_cn: 跨链桥攻击目录（2021–2026）：2023 以来 88% 损失源于安全姿态而非代码；提出链上证据评估量规 + 最弱部署原则，估算可把损失从 35.2 亿降到 3,300 万美元。
objective_summary: 编目分析跨链桥攻击的失败归因，提出基于链上证据的桥安全评估量规与速率限制/紧急停止的损失上界论证，并构建监控与智能体分析器。
evidence_note: 2021–2026 攻击目录与归因统计（88% 姿态失败）；105× 损失削减为基于历史案例的估算而非实验；量规评分的构造透明。
novelty_note: 把桥安全从代码审计转向姿态评估并给出可操作量规与硬顶规则是新的评估框架；「最弱部署决定代币安全」是有用的原则化结论。
scope: EVM 类跨链桥的公开攻击记录与部署证据；2021–2026 目录之内。
limitations: 依赖公开披露的损失数据
105× 估算的反事实性质
量规对新型攻击形态的前瞻性有限

title: SNAPRAG: Cost-Efficient Knowledge Extraction Attack on RAG Systems via Adversarial Perturbations
abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems improve Large Language Model (LLM) responses by incorporating information from external knowledge bases. However, recent studies have shown that attackers can extract substantial portions of private knowledge bases from RAG systems through repeated querying. Yet, state-of-the-art extraction attacks either rely heavily on external LLMs to generate adversarial queries or require a large number of queries. In this paper, we propose SNAPRAG, a novel and cost-efficient attack for extracting RAG knowledge bases through adversarial perturbations. Our approach algorithmically generates adversarial queries without relying on external LLMs and allows for a strictly configurable query budget. In particular, SNAPRAG uses a discrete token-mutation algorithm to generate novel queries in a strict black-box setting. Our adaptive dissimilarity threshold calibration systematically forces queries into unexplored semantic regions of the target database, enabling extraction with fewer queries. Specifically, to extract half of the target knowledge base, our method requires up to 6.77$\times$ fewer queries than existing approaches. Furthermore, within a fixed query budget, our method recovers up to 96.9%, outperforming the closest approach by 7.7-19.9%. We further evaluate SNAPRAG against active defenses, where it remains the leading attack on four of five defended targets, achieving 50.7-96.3% extraction rate.
title_cn: SNAPRAG：经对抗扰动对 RAG 系统的高性价比知识提取攻击
abstract_cn: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统通过纳入外部知识库信息改进大语言模型（LLM）响应。然而近期研究表明攻击者可通过重复查询从 RAG 系统提取大量私有知识库内容。但最先进的提取攻击要么严重依赖外部 LLM 生成对抗查询，要么需要大量查询。本文提出 SNAPRAG，一种新颖且高性价比的经对抗扰动提取 RAG 知识库的攻击。我们的方法算法化生成对抗查询、不依赖外部 LLM，并允许严格可配置的查询预算。特别地，SNAPRAG 用离散 token 变异算法在严格黑盒设定下生成新查询；其自适应不相似度阈值校准系统性地把查询推进目标数据库未探索的语义区域，从而以更少查询完成提取。具体而言，提取目标知识库的一半，本方法比现有方法最多少用 6.77 倍查询；在固定查询预算内最多恢复 96.9%，超最近方法 7.7–19.9%。我们进一步对主动防御评估 SNAPRAG：在五个受防御目标中的四个上它仍是领先攻击，提取率达 50.7–96.3%。
summary_cn: SNAPRAG 免外部 LLM 的黑盒 RAG 提取攻击：提取半库最高省 6.77× 查询、固定预算恢复至 96.9%（超最近方法 7.7–19.9%），五防御目标中四处仍领先。
objective_summary: 提出以离散 token 变异与自适应不相似度阈值校准驱动的黑盒 RAG 知识提取攻击，实现预算可控、免外部 LLM 的高效提取。
evidence_note: 与既有方法的查询效率对比（6.77×、96.9%、7.7–19.9%）及主动防御下五目标的系统评估；多数据集/多目标的量化结果。
novelty_note: 把提取攻击的依赖从外部 LLM 转向算法化 token 变异并以阈值校准控制语义探索，是效率层面的实质改进；攻击范式（重复查询提取）已有先例。
scope: RAG 系统的黑盒知识提取；重复查询可观测的部署形态。
limitations: 依赖查询侧无速率限制/异常检测
对向量库分片隔离等结构性防御未测
提取内容质量（片段可用性）未详述

title: GPU-Accelerated Non-Interactive Encrypted Neural Network Training with Batched Diagonal Packing
abstract: Training a neural network under homomorphic encryption requires transposes, batch reductions, optimizer updates, and repeated refreshes in addition to forward matrix products. We combine rectangular diagonal packing, feature-major SIMD mini-batch lanes, baby-step giant-step evaluation, and compact optimizer state in an MIT-licensed Rust CKKS implementation. Its CUDA path keeps training and bootstrap ciphertext arithmetic on the GPU, while retaining host key generation and client operations. In a matched 100-update experiment on the main non-interactive MNIST model, device-resident bootstrapping reduces training time from 14,268.295 to 293.075 seconds, a $48.68\times$ ratio against our CPU implementation, with exactly equal decoded parameters and predictions. Including setup and final evaluation gives a $40.67\times$ ratio. A separate GPU run completes ten passes over 4,800 images in 2,967.095 seconds and achieves 90.35% test accuracy versus 90.41% for its plaintext twin. These are single-initialization results; exact CPU/GPU parameter agreement is verified at 100 updates, not for the full 1,000-update run. Earlier completed CPU runs support a larger-batch key-switch advantage and baseline-batch accuracy within the registered tolerance, but the baseline-batch normalized key-switch target is missed. The released ReBoot baseline does not meet the common security-estimator threshold, and its full-setting CPU time is unmeasured. We therefore distinguish measured acceleration of our implementation from conditional layout comparisons and do not claim unconditional superiority over ReBoot.
comment: 12 pages. Research preprint. Code and evidence: this https URL
title_cn: GPU 加速的批量对角打包非交互式加密神经网络训练
abstract_cn: 在同态加密下训练神经网络除前向矩阵乘积外还需要转置、批量归约、优化器更新与反复刷新。我们在 MIT 许可的 Rust CKKS 实现中结合矩形对角打包、特征主 SIMD 小批量通道、大步小步（BSG）求值与紧凑优化器状态。其 CUDA 路径把训练与自举密文运算保持在 GPU 上，同时保留主机端密钥生成与客户端操作。在主非交互 MNIST 模型的匹配 100 更新实验中，设备驻留自举把训练时间从 14,268.295 秒降到 293.075 秒——相对我们的 CPU 实现 48.68 倍，解码参数与预测精确相等；含安装与最终评估则为 40.67 倍。另一次 GPU 运行在 2,967.095 秒内完成对 4,800 张图像的十轮训练，测试准确率 90.35%，明文孪生为 90.41%。这些是单初始化结果；精确的 CPU/GPU 参数一致性在 100 更新处验证，未对完整 1,000 更新运行验证。较早完成的 CPU 运行支持更大批量的密钥切换优势与基线批量精度在注册容差内，但基线批量的归一化密钥切换目标未达成。已发布的 ReBoot 基线未达到通用安全估计器阈值，其完整设定的 CPU 时间未测量。因此我们区分本实现的实测加速与条件性布局比较，不声称对 ReBoot 的无条件优越性。代码与证据公开。
summary_cn: GPU 驻留 CKKS 训练栈（对角打包+SIMD 通道+BSG）：匹配 100 更新实验 48.68×（参数精确相等），单初始化限定与 ReBoot 条件比较均如实声明，代码证据公开。
objective_summary: 构建 GPU 驻留的 CKKS 神经网络训练实现（矩形对角打包、SIMD 小批量、BSG、紧凑优化器），以匹配更新实验量化加速并诚实标注验证边界。
evidence_note: 匹配 100 更新的 48.68× 加速与参数逐位一致校验；单初始化、1,000 更新未验证、对 ReBoot 仅条件性比较——作者全部如实声明；代码证据公开。
novelty_note: 把自举与训练全部驻留 GPU 的完整 Rust CKKS 训练栈是工程层面的系统贡献；打包与算子组合为已有技术的有效集成。
scope: MNIST 规模的非交互加密训练；单初始化验证；Rust/CUDA 实现。
limitations: 仅 MNIST 规模
单次初始化，跨初始化方差未知
与 ReBoot 的比较为条件性

title: StealthyPoison: Manipulating LLM Agent Behavior through Procedural Poisoning of Third-Party Skills
abstract: LLM agents increasingly retrieve third-party skills from public registries and follow their procedures to complete user tasks. This reliance allows attackers to manipulate agent behavior by poisoning the skills. However, overtly malicious instructions can provide explicit signals for detection. We present StealthyPoison, a stealthy procedural poisoning attack that corrupts a skill's decision-critical rules to induce incorrect task outcomes while preserving its advertised functionality and normal execution. Unlike prior knowledge corruption attacks that craft poisoned content for known target question-answer pairs, StealthyPoison constructs reusable poisoned procedures from a publicly available third-party skill, without access to actual user requests or their ground-truth answers. To make the poisoned procedure generalize to unseen requests, it first synthesizes requests from the target skill and executes its clean version using a surrogate agent to obtain pseudo-references. These references and surrogate execution feedback guide the iterative refinement of payloads that alter decision-critical rules. To increase the likelihood that the poisoned skill is retrieved and selected over benign alternatives, the attack augments the poisoned skill's retrieval metadata with independently generated request descriptions. We evaluate StealthyPoison on 566 eligible target skills and 5,244 requests against more than 26,000 registry entries. It improves top-1 poisoned-skill placement by 13.6% relative to both HotFlip and GCG. Constructed using feedback from a single surrogate model, the procedural poisoning payloads transfer effectively and without modification to three held-out victim models and achieve end-to-end attack success in a Claude Code workflow powered by Opus 4.8. The defense evaluation further shows that most of these payloads evade detection by both SkillSpector and GPT-5.4-mini.
title_cn: StealthyPoison：经第三方技能的程序性投毒操纵 LLM 智能体行为
abstract_cn: LLM 智能体日益从公开注册表检索第三方技能并遵循其程序完成用户任务。这种依赖使攻击者能通过投毒技能操纵智能体行为。然而公然恶意的指令会提供显式检测信号。我们提出 StealthyPoison，一种隐蔽的程序性投毒攻击：腐蚀技能的决策关键规则以诱发错误任务结果，同时保留其宣称的功能与正常执行。与先前为已知目标问答对构造投毒内容的知识腐蚀攻击不同，StealthyPoison 从公开可得的第三方技能构造可复用的投毒程序，无需访问真实用户请求或其真值答案。为使投毒程序泛化到未见请求，它先从目标技能合成请求并用代理智能体执行其干净版本以获得伪参考；这些参考与代理执行反馈指导迭代精化改变决策关键规则的载荷。为提高投毒技能相对良性替代被检索与选中的概率，攻击用独立生成的请求描述增强投毒技能的检索元数据。我们在 566 个合格目标技能与 5,244 个请求、对照超过 26,000 条注册表条目上评估。相对 HotFlip 与 GCG，它把投毒技能的 top-1 放置率提高 13.6%。由单一代理模型反馈构造的程序性投毒载荷无需修改即可有效迁移到三个留出受害模型，并在由 Opus 4.8 驱动的 Claude Code 工作流中实现端到端攻击成功。防御评估进一步表明这些载荷大多能绕过 SkillSpector 与 GPT-5.4-mini 的检测。
summary_cn: StealthyPoison 程序性投毒第三方技能：腐蚀决策关键规则而保留宣称功能，566 技能/5,244 请求上较 HotFlip/GCG 提升 13.6% 放置率，迁移三留出模型并绕过 SkillSpector 与 GPT-5.4-mini。
objective_summary: 提出对智能体技能注册表的程序性投毒攻击：以代理执行伪参考迭代精化决策规则载荷并增强检索元数据，实现隐蔽且可迁移的操纵。
evidence_note: 566 目标技能 × 5,244 请求、对照 26,000+ 注册表条目的大规模评估；跨三个留出受害模型的迁移与 Opus 4.8 Claude Code 端到端成功；对两种检测器的绕过评估。
novelty_note: 从「为已知问答对投毒」推进到「免目标访问的可复用程序性投毒」，检索元数据协同增强是新的攻击面组合；隐蔽性设计有明确差异化。
scope: 公开技能注册表生态（如 Claude Code 类工作流）；代理模型可执行目标技能的设定。
limitations: 依赖注册表缺乏技能来源验证
对具备来源签名/隔离执行的生态失效
代理模型与受害模型的分布差异可能限制泛化

title: FALC: An Artifact-Centric Life Cycle Model and Research Agenda for AI Forensics
abstract: AI systems increasingly appear in criminal investigations as tools, targets, and sources of evidence, yet AI forensics lacks a systematic account of the artifacts they produce: investigators often do not know which traces to look for, and for many traces they do find, no established analysis technique exists. In this paper we first developed the Forensic AI Life Cycle (FALC) that unlike other life cycle models shifts the focus onto the forensic artifacts created during the life cycle of an AI system. Through FALC we derived a reference list of artifacts that might serve an investigation. Second, we collected examples for crimes with AI involvement throughout FALC and questions likely to be asked when investigating these crimes. Third, we propose a taxonomy of forensic fields of expertise with a focus on the current possibility to analyze AI forensic artifacts using established techniques. For investigators, the model provides a systematic basis for identifying which artifacts to look for when an AI system is relevant to a case. For researchers, the classification shows where existing forensic methods already suffice and where new techniques are most urgently needed.
title_cn: FALC：AI 取证的以工件为中心生命周期模型与研究议程
abstract_cn: AI 系统日益作为工具、目标与证据来源出现在刑事调查中，但 AI 取证缺乏对其产生工件的系统梳理：调查者往往不知道该寻找哪些痕迹，且对找到的许多痕迹不存在既定分析技术。本文首先构建取证 AI 生命周期（FALC），与其他生命周期模型不同，它把焦点转移到 AI 系统生命周期中产生的取证工件。经由 FALC 我们推导出可能服务于调查的工件参考清单。其次，我们收集贯穿 FALC 的 AI 涉罪案例及调查此类犯罪时可能被问及的问题。第三，我们提出取证专业领域的分类，聚焦以既定技术分析 AI 取证工件的当前可能性。对调查者，该模型提供识别 AI 系统相关案件中应寻找哪些工件的系统基础；对研究者，该分类显示哪些地方既有取证方法已经足够、哪些地方最迫切需要新技术。
summary_cn: FALC：首个以取证工件为中心的 AI 生命周期模型，附工件参考清单、AI 涉罪案例与取证技术就绪度分类，指明方法缺口。
objective_summary: 构建以取证工件为中心的 AI 生命周期模型 FALC，整理工件参考清单、涉罪案例问题与取证技术就绪度分类。
evidence_note: 模型与分类为概念性构建，辅以案例收集；无经验验证或技术评估。
novelty_note: 把取证视角从「AI 系统如何工作」转为「AI 系统留下什么工件」是新的框架化；对调查实践与研究议程的直接指引价值明确。
scope: 刑事调查语境下的 AI 相关取证；概念模型与案例整理之内。
limitations: 工件清单的完备性未经实战检验
案例收集存在公开偏差
技术就绪度评估为主观分类

title: A Privacy-Preserving UAV-Assisted Secure Wireless Communication and Computing System Based on Fully Homomorphic Encryption
abstract: With the advancement of beyond-5G networks, privacy-preserving communication and secure computation face critical challenges due to the openness of wireless channels. Existing security mechanisms protect data transmission but fail to secure the computation process itself. In this paper, we propose a UAV-assisted secure computing framework that integrates Cheon Kim Kim Song (CKKS) fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) with multi-party secure computation (MPC). Leveraging UAV flexibility, our framework decouples key distribution from encrypted computation, enabling secure encrypted weighted aggregation (EWA), encrypted matrix multiplication (EMM), and encrypted decision tree (EDT) inference. Experimental results show that our framework outperforms existing schemes: for EDT, it supports floating-point operations and achieves better time efficiency than Brakerski-Fan-Vercauteren (BFV); for EMM, it demonstrates superior time and space efficiency compared to Brakerski-Gentry-Vaikuntanathan (BGV) and Somewhat Homo- morphic Encryption (SHE); while for EWA, it ensures high numerical precision and robustness across varying data length.
title_cn: 基于全同态加密的隐私保护 UAV 辅助安全无线通信与计算系统
abstract_cn: 随着超 5G 网络的发展，无线信道的开放性使隐私保护通信与安全计算面临关键挑战。现有安全机制保护数据传输，但未能保护计算过程本身。本文提出一个无人机（UAV）辅助的安全计算框架，集成 Cheon-Kim-Kim-Song（CKKS）全同态加密（FHE）与多方安全计算（MPC）。借助 UAV 的灵活性，框架把密钥分发与加密计算解耦，支持安全的加密加权聚合（EWA）、加密矩阵乘法（EMM）与加密决策树（EDT）推理。实验结果表明框架优于现有方案：EDT 支持浮点运算且时间效率优于 Brakerski-Fan-Vercauteren（BFV）；EMM 相比 Brakerski-Gentry-Vaikuntanathan（BGV）与部分同态加密（SHE）展现更优的时空效率；EWA 在不同数据长度下保持高数值精度与鲁棒性。
summary_cn: UAV 辅助的 CKKS+MPC 安全计算框架：密钥分发与加密计算解耦，支持加密加权聚合/矩阵乘法/决策树，实验中 EDT 与 EMM 优于 BFV/BGV/SHE。
objective_summary: 提出 UAV 辅助的 FHE+MPC 框架：解耦密钥分发与加密计算，实现加密加权聚合、矩阵乘法与决策树推理并做性能对比。
evidence_note: 与 BFV/BGV/SHE 的实验对比（时间/空间/精度）；UAV 场景为仿真设定，无实飞或现网验证。
novelty_note: CKKS+MPC 与 UAV 中继的组合属应用层集成；核心计算组件（CKKS 算子、聚合协议）为已有技术。
scope: UAV 中继的无线安全计算场景；CKKS/MPC 组件假设之内。
limitations: UAV 移动性与失效模型未建模
通信带宽与能耗开销未量化
威胁模型未覆盖 UAV 自身被劫持

title: Harness Matters: Measuring and Dissecting Security Resilience in Web Agents
abstract: Web agents extend LLMs from text generation to real-world web interaction by relying on execution harnesses that interpret user goals, perceive webpages, plan actions, and ground model decisions into browser operations. While prior work has recognized that agent security depends on more than the backend model alone, how harness design quantitatively shapes web-agent security remains insufficiently measured. To systematically study web-agent harness security, we first characterize web-agent harnesses as a four-stage execution workflow covering goal interpretation, webpage perception, reasoning and planning, and action execution. Based on this abstraction, we build WebTrap Farm, a systematic and extensible evaluation framework covering three representative attack categories: malicious user prompts, malicious prompt injection, and deceptive web design. To avoid conflating security with task capability, we use paired usability calibration tasks to separate genuine defensive behavior from capability limitations. Our evaluation shows that existing web-agent harnesses remain vulnerable to typical attacks, with some unsafe behaviors occurring even without explicit attack content, revealing harness-intrinsic security failures (RQ1). Statistical analysis further shows that both harness and backend model significantly affect security outcomes, indicating that deployed-agent security is jointly shaped by the harness and backend model (RQ2). Finally, we localize where defensive behavior emerges across workflow stages and identify more secure design mechanisms, providing actionable guidance for building more robust web agents (RQ3). These findings highlight the web-agent harness as an important security boundary and motivate moving beyond model-centric defenses toward harness-level security design.
title_cn: Harness 至关重要：测量与剖析 Web 智能体的安全韧性
abstract_cn: Web 智能体把 LLM 从文本生成扩展到真实网页交互，依赖解释用户目标、感知网页、规划动作并把模型决策落地为浏览器操作的执行 harness。尽管先前工作已认识到智能体安全不只取决于后端模型，harness 设计在多大程度上定量塑造 web 智能体安全仍缺乏测量。为系统研究 web 智能体 harness 安全，我们首先把 web 智能体 harness 刻画为覆盖目标解释、网页感知、推理规划与动作执行的四阶段执行工作流。基于该抽象，我们构建 WebTrap Farm——覆盖恶意用户提示、恶意提示注入与欺骗性网页设计三类代表性攻击的系统化可扩展评估框架。为避免把安全与任务能力混淆，我们用配对的可用性校准任务区分真正的防御行为与能力限制。评估显示现有 web 智能体 harness 对典型攻击仍然脆弱，部分不安全行为甚至在没有显式攻击内容时发生，揭示 harness 固有的安全失效（RQ1）。统计分析进一步显示 harness 与后端模型都显著影响安全结果，表明部署智能体的安全由两者共同塑造（RQ2）。最后我们定位防御行为在工作流各阶段的涌现位置并识别更安全的设计机制，为构建更鲁棒的 web 智能体提供可操作指导（RQ3）。这些发现凸显 web 智能体 harness 是重要的安全边界，并推动超越模型中心防御走向 harness 级安全设计。
summary_cn: WebTrap Farm 系统测量 web 智能体 harness 安全：四阶段工作流抽象 + 三攻击类 + 配对可用性校准；发现无攻击内容也出现的不安全行为，harness 与模型共同决定安全。
objective_summary: 把 web 智能体 harness 抽象为四阶段工作流并系统测量 harness 设计对安全结果的定量影响，分离防御行为与能力限制。
evidence_note: 系统化框架（四阶段 + 三攻击类）+ 配对可用性校准任务分离能力与防御 + 统计显著性分析；具体数字摘要未给。
novelty_note: 首次把 harness 量化为 web 智能体的安全边界并识别 harness 固有失效（无攻击内容也出现不安全行为），指向 harness 级安全设计。
scope: web 交互智能体的 harness 层安全；所测 harness/模型集合与三类攻击之内。
limitations: 仿真网页环境与真实 Web 的差距
harness 集合的代表性
防御机制建议的有效性验证有限

title: Spectral Unlearning: Transformer Structure-Preserving Updates for Language Models
abstract: Machine unlearning in large language models (LLMs) aims to remove specific learned knowledge, capabilities, or behaviors while preserving model utility. Existing methods have mostly focused on the design of unlearning objectives, while largely overlooking the intrinsic matrix structure of transformer weights. In particular, standard optimizers operate on independent scalar coordinates, thereby ignoring this matrix structure. We propose spectral unlearning, an update framework that combines standard unlearning objectives with matrix-structured optimization. We show that the spectral update corresponds to the steepest-descent direction for transformers composed of linear layers with normalized inputs and outputs. Our approach is applied on top of existing unlearning methods and evaluated across complementary axes of memorization, privacy, and utility, summarized via their harmonic mean. Spectral unlearning consistently outperforms a broad range of baselines and closes most of the gap to a retain-trained reference. Code is available at https://github.com/unlearn-ml/spectral-unlearning/.
title_cn: 谱遗忘：面向语言模型的保持结构 Transformer 更新
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）中的机器遗忘旨在移除特定的已学知识、能力或行为，同时保持模型效用。现有方法大多聚焦遗忘目标的设计，而在很大程度上忽视 transformer 权重的内在矩阵结构。特别是标准优化器在独立标量坐标上操作，忽视该结构。我们提出谱遗忘（spectral unlearning），一个把标准遗忘目标与矩阵结构化优化结合的更新框架。我们证明谱更新对应于由归一化输入输出的线性层组成的 transformer 的最速下降方向。该方法应用于现有遗忘方法之上，并在记忆、隐私与效用三个互补轴上评估（以其调和均值汇总）。谱遗忘一致优于广泛基线，并基本追平到 retain 训练参照的差距。代码见 github.com/unlearn-ml/spectral-unlearning。NeurIPS 2026 录用。
summary_cn: 谱遗忘把矩阵结构纳入遗忘更新：谱方向即归一化线性层 transformer 的最速下降，三轴调和均值上一致优于基线并基本追平 retain 参照，NeurIPS 2026。
objective_summary: 提出结合遗忘目标与权重矩阵结构的谱更新框架，证明其为归一化线性层 transformer 的最速下降方向并系统评估。
evidence_note: NeurIPS 2026 录用；记忆/隐私/效用三轴调和均值的一致改进与理论对应（最速下降方向）；基线广泛。
novelty_note: 把权重矩阵结构引入遗忘优化的视角较新且有理论支撑（最速下降方向等价性）；属遗忘目标之上的正交改进框架。
scope: LLM 机器遗忘；线性层 + 归一化输入输出的 transformer 结构假设之内。
limitations: 理论对应依赖线性层假设
对非 LoRA 全参数场景的开销未述
遗忘边界的法律/语义度量未涉及

title: Scaling Adaptive Prompt Injection Attacks with Agent Swarms
abstract: Prompt injections have emerged as one of the top security risks faced by AI agents today. Early work in prompt injection attacks looked at simple tool-call agents and static attack payloads, and were saturated since mid-2025. As of Fall 2026, human red-teaming may be nearing saturation, especially on the Gemini family of models. In this work, we argue that despite this apparent plateau, prompt injection attacks are still possible and continued effort into prompt injection defense is needed. We design a new synthetic evaluation dataset which uses random non-malicious actions as adversarial goals. Such dataset design helps us to evaluate prompt injection robustness as a model ability to respect instruction hierarchy, and disentangle this ability from model knowledge of security practices. We show that an agentic attacker of increased capabilities can reliably trick model to follow instructions in tool output in our evaluation, even for models previously considered robust on public prompt injection benchmarks such as GraySwan Arena. This shows that current frontier defenses may require proactive, automated red-teaming to remain resilient to increasingly capable adversaries.
title_cn: 以智能体群体扩展自适应提示注入攻击
abstract_cn: 提示注入已成为当今 AI 智能体面临的首要安全风险之一。早期提示注入攻击研究考察简单工具调用智能体与静态攻击载荷，且自 2025 年年中起已趋饱和。截至 2026 年秋，人类红队测试可能正接近饱和，尤其在 Gemini 系模型上。本工作中我们论证：尽管表面趋于平稳，提示注入攻击仍然可行，且对提示注入防御的持续投入是必要的。我们设计一个新的合成评测数据集：使用随机的非恶意动作作为对抗目标。这种数据集设计帮助我们把提示注入鲁棒性评估为模型尊重指令层级的能力，并把这一能力与模型的安全实践知识解耦。我们展示能力增强的智能体攻击者能在评测中可靠地诱使模型遵循工具输出中的指令——即使对在 GraySwan Arena 等公开提示注入基准上此前被认为鲁棒的模型。这表明当前前沿防御可能需要主动的、自动化的红队测试，以保持对日益强能力的对手的弹性。
summary_cn: 智能体群攻击者使提示注入重新可行：以随机非恶意动作为目标的新数据集解耦指令层级能力，对 GraySwan Arena 上曾判定鲁棒的模型也能可靠攻击。
objective_summary: 设计以随机良性动作为对抗目标的合成评测，量化能力增强的智能体攻击者对前沿模型指令层级遵从的突破。
evidence_note: 新合成数据集的设计动机明确（解耦安全知识与指令层级能力），对公开基准（GraySwan Arena）上鲁棒模型的再评估；具体成功率数字摘要未给。
novelty_note: 「人红队饱和但智能体群攻击仍未饱和」的论证 + 以良性目标度量指令层级遵从的评测再设计，是对当前防御评估实践的重要修正。
scope: 工具调用智能体的提示注入鲁棒性评测；随机良性目标范式与所测模型之内。
limitations: 良性目标范式与真实恶意目标的差异
攻击成本与规模未量化
防御建议停留在方向层面

title: Doubly-Efficient Private Information Retrieval from Modular Forms
abstract: We present new information-theoretic protocols for $s$-server, doubly-efficient private information retrieval (PIR) in sublinear server time and one extra bit of space on the servers, for every constant $s \geq 2$. On an $n$-bit database, each of the $s$ PIR servers first builds and stores a preprocessing data structure consisting of $n+1$ bits (which is unique to each server, and after which the server may discard the original database). Then, each server answers a PIR query in time $T_s(n)$, by reading at most $T_s$ bits of its data structure and sending them to the user. In the two server setting ($s=2$), our PIR protocols achieve $T_2 = n^{0.82}$, matching the server time of the state-of-the-art schemes of Henzinger and Ragavan (EUROCRYPT 2026) while shrinking their storage from $O(n\sqrt{\log n})$ to $n+1$ bits. With $s \geq 3$ servers, our PIR protocols retain the $n+1$ bits of storage and additionally improve on the server time of all prior information-theoretic $s$-server schemes with $n^{1+o(1)}$ storage: for example, achieving $T_3 = n^{0.74}$ and $T_{10} = n^{0.61}$ (previously $n^{0.79}$ and $n^{0.75}$). Asymptotically, as the server count $s$ grows, we shrink the number of servers required to achieve a given server-work exponent from $s^{3.9}$ to $s$. Our results draw inspiration from matching-vector techniques (Efremenko, STOC 2009), which we generalize to handle degree-two computations in the exponent. Using this generalization, we build doubly-efficient PIR from the new intermediate abstraction of Fourier-sparse cone-delta functions. Then, we construct such Fourier-sparse cone-delta functions via a connection to modular forms and complex analysis: if a Fourier-sparse cone-delta function does not exist, then there exists a modular form which has too many roots, contradicting the valence formula.
title_cn: 源自模形式的倍效私有信息检索
abstract_cn: 我们为 s 服务器、倍效私有信息检索（PIR）给出新的信息论协议：服务器时间亚线性、服务器端仅多一比特空间，对每个常数 s≥2 成立。在 n 比特数据库上，s 个 PIR 服务器各自先构建并存储一个由 n+1 比特组成的预处理数据结构（对每个服务器唯一，此后服务器可丢弃原始数据库）。然后每个服务器至多读取其数据结构的 T_s 比特即回答 PIR 查询并发送给用户。在两服务器情形（s=2），协议达到 T₂=n^0.82，匹配 Henzinger 与 Ragavan（EUROCRYPT 2026）最先进方案的服务器时间，同时把存储从 O(n√log n) 缩到 n+1 比特。当 s≥3 时，协议保持 n+1 比特存储，并在所有具有 n^{1+o(1)} 存储的先前信息论 s 服务器方案上改进服务器时间：例如达到 T₃=n^0.74 与 T₁₀=n^0.61（此前为 n^0.79 与 n^0.75）。渐近地，随服务器数 s 增长，我们把达到给定服务器工作量指数所需服务器数从 s^3.9 缩减到 s。结果受匹配向量技术（Efremenko，STOC 2009）启发，我们将其推广以处理指数上的二次计算；利用该推广，我们从「傅里叶稀疏锥-δ 函数」这一新中间抽象构建倍效 PIR；再经由与模形式及复分析的联系构造此类函数——若傅里叶稀疏锥-δ 函数不存在，则存在一个根过多的模形式，与价公式矛盾。
summary_cn: 倍效 PIR 新协议：s≥2 服务器亚线性时间 + 仅 n+1 比特存储；T₂=n^0.82 匹配 SOTA 且存储更小，T₃=n^0.74/T₁₀=n^0.61 全面改进，经模形式价公式构造核心抽象。
objective_summary: 构建信息论倍效 PIR 协议：匹配向量技术推广到指数二次计算，以傅里叶稀疏锥-δ 函数为新抽象并经模形式价公式证明其存在。
evidence_note: 完整的构造与存在性证明（价公式矛盾论证）；与 SOTA（EUROCRYPT 2026）的时间/存储逐项对比；多服务器渐近改进（s^3.9→s）。
novelty_note: 傅里叶稀疏锥-δ 函数抽象与模形式联系是新的理论工具；多服务器 PIR 时间-存储前沿的实质性推进。
scope: 信息论 PIR（无计算假设）；常数服务器数与亚线性时间设定之内。
limitations: 渐近结果，实用常数未评估
预处理仅一比特冗余的空间权衡已极简但查询通信未详
单数据库比特模型

title: VeilTune: Secure Fine-Tuning of Private LoRA Adapters on Public Pretrained Language Models
abstract: Fine-tuning public pretrained language models with lightweight adapters such as LoRA has become the mainstream way to adapt them to downstream tasks. A service provider often trains its adapter on a data owner's samples, so two assets need protection: the data owner's samples and the provider's adapter. Existing secure fine-tuning protocols protect the samples but reveal to the data owner intermediate results of every training step, such as the hidden representations or logits of its inputs. We show that a single step suffices to copy the adapter: from the hidden representations of one mini-batch of 32 samples, the data owner fits an adapter that agrees with the provider's on 99.2% of test inputs, and logits alone yield about 94%. Protecting both assets therefore requires that no value that depends on the adapter be revealed throughout training. We present VeilTune, to the best of our knowledge the first protocol that fine-tunes a pretrained language model with backpropagation entirely in secure multi-party computation (MPC). VeilTune computes only what the loss depends on, replaces generic MPC operators with training-aware nonlinear operators that stay accurate on the values that training produces, and obliviously skips the steps corrupted by truncation failures. On four few-shot tasks with RoBERTa-large, VeilTune nearly matches plaintext training and is 5.3 points more accurate on average than SecP-Tuning, the state-of-the-art secure fine-tuning protocol. On SST-2, it achieves a 3.5x end-to-end speedup and a 3.6x reduction in communication over SecP-Tuning, and 26x and 17x over full fine-tuning in MPC.
title_cn: VeilTune：在公开预训练语言模型上私有 LoRA 适配器的安全微调
abstract_cn: 用 LoRA 等轻量适配器微调公开预训练语言模型已成为适配下游任务的主流方式。服务商常在数据所有者的样本上训练其适配器，因此需要保护两项资产：数据所有者的样本与服务商的适配器。现有安全微调协议保护样本，却向数据所有者泄露每个训练步骤的中间结果（如其输入的隐藏表示或 logits）。我们证明单步即可复制适配器：从一个小批量 32 样本的隐藏表示，数据所有者能拟合出与服务商适配器在 99.2% 测试输入上一致的适配器；仅 logits 也能达约 94%。因此保护双资产要求训练全程不泄露任何依赖适配器的值。我们提出 VeilTune，据我们所知首个在安全多方计算（MPC）中全程以反向传播微调预训练语言模型的协议。VeilTune 只计算损失所依赖的内容，用训练感知的非线性算子替代通用 MPC 算子（在训练产生的值上保持准确），并遗忘式跳过被截断失败破坏的步骤。在 RoBERTa-large 的四个少样本任务上，VeilTune 几乎匹配明文训练，平均比最先进安全微调协议 SecP-Tuning 高 5.3 分；在 SST-2 上相比 SecP-Tuning 实现端到端 3.5 倍加速与 3.6 倍通信缩减，相比 MPC 中全量微调则为 26 倍与 17 倍。
summary_cn: VeilTune 首个全程 MPC 反向传播微调协议（同时保护样本与适配器）：先证明单步中间结果即可复制适配器（99.2% 一致），RoBERTa 四任务超 SecP-Tuning 5.3 分、SST-2 提速 3.5×。
objective_summary: 证明单步训练中间结果足以复制 LoRA 适配器，进而提出全程 MPC 微调协议 VeilTune，以训练感知算子与截断失败遗忘跳过兼顾精度与效率。
evidence_note: 适配器复制攻击的量化演示（32 样本隐表示→99.2% 一致）+ RoBERTa-large 四任务精度对比与 SST-2 端到端加速/通信量化（3.5×/3.6×）。
novelty_note: 识别「服务商适配器泄露」这一被忽视的双资产问题并给出首个全程 MPC 反向传播微调协议；训练感知算子设计是实质技术贡献。
scope: LoRA 式安全微调；MPC 参与方为数据所有者与服务商的两方设定；RoBERTa 级模型。
limitations: MPC 开销仍显著（相对明文）
更大模型与解码器架构未验证
两方设定之外的威胁（如服务商合谋第三方）未覆盖

title: Ultrasound-Assisted Biometric Watermarking Against Face Video Deepfakes
abstract: Currently, artificial intelligence-generated content (AIGC) poses a severe threat to facial video deepfakes, and many AIGC companies employ video watermarking to mitigate unauthorized fake video usage, but its effectiveness is limited due to watermark tampering and private-model forgery. Additionally, some schemes actively add watermarks to user videos. However, current approaches focus primarily on the quality of watermark embedding in offline scenarios, and no existing work offers a solution for protecting human facial videos in real-time online applications. To fill this gap, we propose, to the best of our knowledge, a novel biometric video watermarking method, UltraGuard, for the first time. It uses the smartphone's built-in speaker and microphone to emit ultrasonic signals and capture biometric features, which are then fused with spatio-temporal dynamic features derived from the video content.
