The fused features are encoded as watermarks and embedded into videos in real time, enabling dynamic, content-aware watermarking throughout transmission and propagation. Extensive experimental validation demonstrates that UltraGuard can effectively defend against malicious attacks such as forgery and editing, both at the source and during propagation, proving the system's efficacy. In the future, it can be deployed on users' mobile devices to provide real-time protection for users' facial videos, thereby preventing security and privacy breaches caused by various malicious attacks.
comment: Submitted to Proceedings of the ACM on Interactive, Mobile, Wearable and Ubiquitous Technologies (IMWUT)
title_cn: 超声辅助的生物特征水印对抗人脸视频深伪
abstract_cn: 当前 AI 生成内容（AIGC）对人脸视频深伪构成严重威胁，许多 AIGC 公司采用视频水印来缓解未授权的伪造视频使用，但其有效性受水印篡改与私有模型伪造限制。另一些方案主动向用户视频添加水印。然而现有方法主要关注离线场景中水印嵌入的质量，尚无工作为实时在线应用中的人脸视频提供保护方案。为填补这一空白，我们提出（据我们所知）首个新型生物特征视频水印方法 UltraGuard：利用智能手机内置扬声器与麦克风发射超声信号并采集生物特征，将其与源自视频内容的时空动态特征融合；融合特征被编码为水印并实时嵌入视频，在传输与传播全程实现动态的、内容感知的水印。大量实验验证表明 UltraGuard 能有效抵御伪造与编辑等恶意攻击——无论是在源头还是传播过程中——证明系统效能。未来可部署在用户移动设备上为用户人脸视频提供实时保护，防范各类恶意攻击造成的安全与隐私泄露。投 ACM IMWUT。
summary_cn: UltraGuard 用手机扬声器/麦克风发射超声采集生物特征并与时空特征融合实时嵌入水印：首个实时在线人脸视频生物水印，抗伪造与编辑攻击。
objective_summary: 提出实时生物特征视频水印 UltraGuard：超声采集生物特征与视频时空特征融合编码为水印，在源端与传播中对抗伪造和编辑。
evidence_note: 大量实验验证源端与传播中的抗伪造/编辑能力；摘要未给量化指标；投 IMWUT（评审状态未知）。
novelty_note: 以消费级手机超声收发采集活体生物特征并融合视频时空特征是新的水印来源组合；把人脸视频水印从离线推向实时在线场景是定位贡献。
scope: 智能手机端实时人脸视频保护；超声采集对设备与环境有要求。
limitations: 超声采集在噪声环境与异构设备上的稳定性未述
计算开销与功耗未量化
对自适应去除水印攻击的鲁棒性未知

title: Advantage Distillation in Paired-State Quantum Key Distribution
abstract: We investigate advantage distillation for paired-state Loop-Back quantum key distribution, with a fixed optical station serving a lightweight portable terminal. Alice prepares two polarization-encoded pulses, Bob selects and applies a polarization filter to each pulse, and Alice infers his selections from the returned detection pattern. The proposed advantage-distillation step selects consistent blocks of three two-bit records using two independent public parity checks on a minimal connected graph. The closing edge of a parity polygon is shown to be redundant: any spanning tree of the same vertices has the same acceptance set. We derive exact acceptance probabilities, residual-error laws, and retention rates. Under independent bit errors, the three-record filter reduces the leading error term from e to e^2, while its cost in discarded records and public information is accounted for explicitly. A modular security theorem bounds the additional guessing advantage available to an adversary after syndrome disclosure and block acceptance, including arbitrary quantum side information. We also evaluate a specified single-photon passive-tap optical channel, obtaining a positive conditional entropy bound and exact accepted-block security quantities. This parity-based advantage-distillation step detects discrepancies by postselection; it does not correct individual errors and is intended to precede conventional reconciliation. The architecture suggests two further directions: hybrid filtering and reconciliation, and key establishment between portable users accessing a shared quantum station.
title_cn: 配对状态量子密钥分发中的优势蒸馏
abstract_cn: 我们研究配对状态回环量子密钥分发（QKD）中的优势蒸馏，其中固定光站服务轻便的便携终端。Alice 制备两个偏振编码脉冲，Bob 选择并对每个脉冲施加偏振滤波，Alice 从返回的探测模式推断其选择。所提出的优势蒸馏步骤使用最小连通图上的两个独立公开奇偶校验来选择由三个两比特记录组成的一致块。我们证明奇偶多边形的闭合边是冗余的：同顶点的任意生成树具有相同的接受集合。我们推导精确的接受概率、残余错误律与保留率。在独立比特错误下，三记录过滤器把主导错误项从 e 降到 e²，同时显式计算其在丢弃记录与公开信息上的代价。模块化安全定理约束了在综合征披露与块接受之后对手可获得的额外猜测优势，包括任意量子侧信息。我们还评估一个指定的单光子被动窃听光信道，得到正的条件熵界与精确的接受块安全量。这一基于奇偶的优势蒸馏步骤通过后选择检测差异；它不纠正单个错误，旨在先于常规纠错执行。该架构提示两个进一步方向：混合过滤与纠错，以及访问共享量子站的便携用户间密钥建立。
summary_cn: 配对状态回环 QKD 的奇偶式优势蒸馏：三记录一致块把主导错误项 e 降到 e²，推导精确接受/保留率与含量子侧信息的安全定理，单光子被动窃听信道下条件熵为正。
objective_summary: 为配对状态回环 QKD 设计基于最小连通图奇偶校验的优势蒸馏步骤，推导精确接受概率、错误律与模块化安全界并评估被动窃听信道。
evidence_note: 精确的接受概率/残余错误律/保留率推导 + 模块化安全定理 + 单光子被动窃听信道的定量评估；理论完整但无实验光路数据。
novelty_note: 把优势蒸馏适配到回环配对状态 QKD 这一特定架构并证明闭合边冗余性（任意生成树同接受集）；属既定 QKD 技术线的场景化贡献。
scope: 配对状态回环 QKD 架构；独立比特错误与被动窃听信道模型之内。
limitations: 无光学实验验证
只检测差异不纠错，需配合常规纠错
信道模型理想化（单光子被动窃听）

title: ShadowBench-MCP: Measuring Shadow Invocations in MCP-Style Tool Routing
abstract: LLM agents increasingly act as routers for tools, APIs, and software-supply-chain workflows, making an execution path - rather than generated text alone - a security-relevant model output. We study shadow invocation: a task-preserving request variant that causes an LLM router to select a riskier execution path, potentially skipping validation, provenance, staging, redaction, or audit controls even though the request does not ask for a malicious action. We introduce ShadowBench-MCP, a benchmark and metric suite that separates task preservation (TPSS), operational pressure (OPSS), and route-geometric drift (RGAS), and combines them in the pre-execution SODS score. In a focused policy-ablation study using a Groq-hosted qwen/qwen3-32b router, 120 routing decisions yield 96 original-versus-variant comparisons across six security-sensitive workflows. Efficiency-first routing produces a 29.2% shadow-invocation rate and 26.7% safety-tool skip rate. Policy-aware routing reduces these to 4.2% and 1.7%, respectively, corresponding to an 85.7% relative reduction in shadow invocations. Pre-execution signals distinguish shadow routes with ROC AUC up to 0.94. These results are early, single-router evidence of a policy-dependent routing-layer security effect, not a claim of universal vulnerability.
comment: Presented at the 35th USENIX Security Symposium (USENIX Security 2026)
title_cn: ShadowBench-MCP：测量 MCP 式工具路由中的影子调用
abstract_cn: LLM 智能体日益充当工具、API 与软件供应链工作流的路由器，使执行路径——而非仅生成文本——成为与安全相关的模型输出。我们研究影子调用（shadow invocation）：一种保持任务的请求变体，它使 LLM 路由器选择更危险的执行路径，可能跳过验证、来源、预发、脱敏或审计控制，即使请求并未要求恶意动作。我们提出 ShadowBench-MCP，一个把任务保持（TPSS）、操作压力（OPSS）与路由几何漂移（RGAS）分离并在预执行 SODS 分数中组合的基准与指标套件。在一项使用 Groq 托管 qwen/qwen3-32b 路由器的聚焦策略消融研究中，120 个路由决策产生跨六个安全敏感工作流的 96 组原版-变体比较。效率优先路由产生 29.2% 的影子调用率与 26.7% 的安全工具跳过率；策略感知路由把它们降到 4.2% 与 1.7%，对应影子调用相对减少 85.7%。预执行信号区分影子路由的 ROC AUC 最高达 0.94。这些结果是策略依赖的路由层安全效应的早期单路由器证据，不是普遍脆弱性的声明。USENIX Security 2026 报告。
summary_cn: ShadowBench-MCP 定义「影子调用」（保任务但选更危险路径）：单路由器 96 组对比中效率优先路由影子调用率 29.2%，策略感知降至 4.2%（−85.7%），预执行信号 AUC 至 0.94。
objective_summary: 提出影子调用概念与 ShadowBench-MCP 基准（TPSS/OPSS/RGAS/SODS 指标），以策略消融量化路由层的安全效应。
evidence_note: 单路由器 120 决策/96 对比较的聚焦消融 + 明确的策略对照（29.2%→4.2%）；作者明示为早期单路由器证据；USENIX Security 2026 报告。
novelty_note: 「影子调用」是新概念：无害请求变体经路由层选择危险执行路径；把执行路径作为安全相关输出的视角新颖。
scope: MCP 式工具路由场景；单一路由器模型与六个工作流之内。
limitations: 单路由器证据（作者自陈）
工作流集合有限
策略感知路由的设计细节与普适性未验证

title: Using the Planted Clique Conjecture for Cryptography: Public-Key Encryption from Planted Clique and Noisy $k$-$\mathsf{LIN}$ Over Expanders
abstract: We give a public key encryption scheme that is provably secure against poly-size adversaries, assuming $n^{\log^\alpha n}$ hardness of the standard planted clique conjecture, for any $\alpha \in (0,1)$, and a relatively mild hardness conjecture about noisy $k\mbox{-}\mathsf{LIN}$ over expanders that is not known to imply public-key encryption on its own. Both of our conjectures correspond to natural average-case variants of NP-complete problems and have been studied for multiple decades, with unconditional lower bounds supporting them in a variety of restricted models of computation. Our encryption scheme answers an open question in a seminal work by Applebaum, Barak, and Wigderson [STOC'10].
title_cn: 把种团猜想用于密码学：基于种团与展宽器上噪声 k-LIN 的公钥加密
abstract_cn: 我们给出一个对多项式规模对手可证明安全的公钥加密方案，其安全性基于标准种团（planted clique）猜想的 n^{log^α n} 困难性（α 为任意 (0,1) 中常数），以及一个关于展宽器上噪声 k-LIN 的相对温和的困难性猜想——后者本身不被知道能推出公钥加密。两个猜想都对应 NP 完全问题的自然平均情形变体，已被研究数十年，并在多种受限计算模型中有无条件下界支持。我们的加密方案回答了 Applebaum、Barak 与 Wigderson [STOC 2010] 重要工作中的开放问题。
summary_cn: 基于种团猜想 n^{log^α n} 困难性与展宽器上噪声 k-LIN 的可证明安全公钥加密，回答 Applebaum–Barak–Wigderson [STOC'10] 开放问题。
objective_summary: 构造以种团猜想与展宽器上噪声 k-LIN 联合困难性为安全基础的公钥加密方案，并给出可证明安全性归约。
evidence_note: 可证明安全性归约完整；猜想基础有数十年研究史与受限模型无条件下界支持；回答 STOC 2010 开放问题。
novelty_note: 首个基于种团猜想的公钥加密：把「不含公钥密码的温和猜想」与种团结合产生 PKE 是理论突破点。
scope: 渐近安全（多项式规模对手）；依赖两个平均情形猜想为真。
limitations: 安全依赖未证猜想
方案效率未与实用 PKE 比较
指数 n^{log^α n} 对手的保守性

title: Attack Injection to Vehicle Reactions: Extensible Closed-Loop Adversarial Evaluation Framework
abstract: Autonomous vehicles can use information exchanged with other vehicles and roadside infrastructure to support driving decisions. However, applications that rely on this information can make unsafe decisions when it is falsified. Studying the resulting traffic effects requires following received information through application decisions, vehicle reactions, and subsequent interactions. We present an extensible closed-loop adversarial evaluation framework built on VaN3Twin, a platform for traffic and wireless network simulation, with a diverse attack library and a labelled dataset covering benign and attack conditions. A key advantage of the framework is that it can be extended with additional attacks, message paths, receiving applications, and logging fields. The added library contains 76 configurable attack profiles adapted to message formats defined by the European Telecommunications Standards Institute. These profiles are organized into nine groups of related attacks, referred to as suites. The framework connects live attack injection and simulated network delivery to receiving applications, whose selected commands update vehicle movement. The resulting state feeds subsequent message generation, closing the loop. The dataset links physical vehicle states and message exchanges to attack labels, application decisions, selected commands, and traffic outcomes. Evaluation with individual and combined attack suites confirmed execution of all profiles, and every suite produced requests linked to attacked messages. A recorded sequence also showed a vehicle reacting to an attacked message and subsequently influencing another vehicle through an unmodified message describing its updated movement. These findings demonstrate how live injection and vehicle feedback support the study of direct and indirect effects as traffic evolves.
title_cn: 攻击注入到车辆反应：可扩展的闭环对抗评估框架
abstract_cn: 自动驾驶车辆可利用与其他车辆及路侧基础设施交换的信息支持驾驶决策。然而依赖这些信息的应用在信息被伪造时可能做出不安全决策。研究由此产生的交通效应需要把接收的信息一路追踪到应用决策、车辆反应与后续交互。我们提出一个构建在 VaN3Twin——交通与无线网络仿真平台——之上的可扩展闭环对抗评估框架，附带多样的攻击库与覆盖良性及攻击条件的标注数据集。该框架的关键优势是可扩展：可加入更多攻击、消息路径、接收应用与日志字段。新增攻击库包含 76 个适配欧洲电信标准协会（ETSI）定义消息格式的可配置攻击配置，组织为九个相关攻击组（套件）。框架把实时攻击注入与仿真网络投递连接到接收应用，其选定命令更新车辆运动；产生的状态又馈入后续消息生成，形成闭环。数据集把物理车辆状态与消息交换关联到攻击标签、应用决策、选定命令与交通结果。用单个与组合攻击套件的评估确认了所有配置的执行，且每个套件都产生了与被攻击消息关联的请求。一段录制序列还显示车辆对被攻击消息做出反应、并通过描述其更新运动的未修改消息进而影响另一辆车。这些发现展示了实时注入与车辆反馈如何支持研究交通演化中的直接与间接效应。
summary_cn: 基于 VaN3Twin 的闭环车辆攻击评估框架：76 个 ETSI 攻击配置/9 套件全部执行，标注数据集串联攻击-决策-反应-交通效应，支持间接效应研究。
objective_summary: 构建车联网闭环对抗评估框架：实时注入攻击消息、追踪应用决策与车辆反应的反馈回路，并发布标注数据集。
evidence_note: 76 攻击配置全部执行的可行性验证 + 闭环间接效应的录制案例；仿真环境、无实车验证与统计检验。
novelty_note: 「注入→决策→反应→再传播」的闭环设计是评估间接交通效应的新框架；攻击库适配 ETSI 消息格式具实用价值。
scope: V2X 仿真环境（VaN3Twin）；ETSI 消息格式与所选攻击套件之内。
limitations: 仿真保真度与真实交通有差距
接收应用的决策模型为简化实现
攻击效果指标较粗（请求关联）

title: Delegating Computation with Approximate Arithmetic: Interactive Proofs for Wizards
abstract: We study interactive proofs for arithmetic circuits over the complex numbers $\mathbb{C}$ in which both the prover and the verifier compute approximately (unlike muggles, wizards can use magic, i.e., floating-point numbers). The goal is to prove that a claimed output $y$ is close to the exact output $C(x)$: for thresholds $0<\Delta_0<\Delta$, the honest prover is accepted whenever $|y-C(x)|\le\Delta_0$, and every prover is rejected with high probability whenever $|y-C(x)|>\Delta$. Existing proof systems for real-valued data verify rounded finite-field computations. Bitan et al.~[EUROCRYPT~2026] gave an approximate sum-check protocol. We extend the protocol of Goldwasser, Kalai, and Rothblum (GKR) [STOC~2008] to public-coin interactive proofs for logspace-uniform layered circuits over $\mathbb{C}$ of size $S$, depth $L$, and $n$ inputs, under public bounds on gate values and wiring coefficients. At constant soundness error, the verifier runs in time $(n+1)\mathrm{poly}(L,\log S,b)$, the communication is $\mathrm{poly}(L,\log S,b)$, and the prover runs in time $\mathrm{poly}(S,b)$, where $b$ is the bit precision. To the best of our knowledge, these are the first doubly efficient interactive proofs in which both parties compute approximately. GKR reduces two claims about a layer to one on a random line, which leaves the unit circle, where our error bounds hold. We instead label gates by complex roots of unity and combine the two claims with a random root of unity as coefficient. We choose the error thresholds backward from the input layer, so that a large output error survives the verifier's rounding at every step. The honest prover needs only $O(S \log S)$ complex operations. We also obtain zero-knowledge proofs from one-way functions, one-round arguments from private information retrieval, and interactive PCPs whose proof length is polynomial in the witness length.
title_cn: 以近似算术委托计算：给巫师的交互式证明
abstract_cn: 我们研究复数域 ℂ 上算术电路的交互式证明，其中证明者与验证者都以近似方式计算（与麻瓜不同，巫师可以使用魔法，即浮点数）。目标是证明声称的输出 y 接近精确输出 C(x)：对阈值 0<Δ₀<Δ，只要 |y−C(x)|≤Δ₀ 诚实证明者即被接受，而只要 |y−C(x)|>Δ₀ 每个证明者都以高概率被拒绝。现有实值数据证明系统验证的是舍入后的有限域计算。Bitan 等 [EUROCRYPT 2026] 给出了近似 sum-check 协议。我们把 Goldwasser、Kalai 与 Rothblum（GKR）[STOC 2008] 的协议扩展为对规模 S、深度 L、n 个输入、在公开的门值与连线系数界下的 ℂ 上对数空间一致分层电路的公共硬币交互式证明。在常数可靠性误差下，验证者运行时间 (n+1)poly(L,log S,b)、通信 poly(L,log S,b)、证明者 poly(S,b)，其中 b 为比特精度。据我们所知，这些是首个双方都以近似方式计算的 doubly-efficient 交互式证明。GKR 把一层的两个断言归约为随机直线上的一个断言，这会离开单位圆——我们的误差界在那里成立。我们改用单位根标记门，并以随机单位根为系数合并两个断言。我们从输入层反向选择误差阈值，使大的输出误差在每一步都能在验证者的舍入中幸存。诚实证明者只需 O(S log S) 次复数运算。我们还获得基于单向函数的零知识证明、基于 PIR 的一轮论证，以及证明长度为见证长度多项式的交互式 PCP。
summary_cn: 首个双方均以近似算术计算的 doubly-efficient 交互式证明：GKR 扩展到 ℂ 上电路，单位根标记门合并断言，诚实证明者 O(S log S) 复数运算，附 ZK/一轮论证/IPCP 扩展。
objective_summary: 把 GKR 协议扩展为复数域近似算术的公共硬币交互式证明：单位根门标记解决断言合并越出单位圆的问题，并给出 ZK 与一轮论证扩展。
evidence_note: 完整的复杂度刻画（验证者 (n+1)poly(L,log S,b)、证明者 O(S log S)）与多扩展（ZK/一轮论证/IPCP）；纯理论工作，证明体系完整。
novelty_note: 首个双方近似计算的 doubly-efficient 交互式证明：单位根标记 + 反向误差阈值选择是克服复数域舍入的新技术。
scope: 复数域上分层算术电路的验证；公开门值/系数界与近似阈值假设之内。
limitations: 常数为渐近复杂度，无实现常数

title: Treating the Model as an Untrusted Component: Deterministic Policy Enforcement, Human Approval and Taint Tracking Against Prompt Injection in Tool-Using Agents, with Validation on Open-Weights Models
abstract: Tool-using LLM agents act on instructions embedded in the data they read, so prompt injection is a structural rather than a prompt-wording problem. We compare in-prompt defences (hardened prompts, spotlighting, LLM detectors) with deterministic enforcement outside the model (four reference monitors of increasing strength), human approval and taint tracking, judged by one effect-based oracle independent of every defence in an executable environment of 13 tasks and 12 tools, with argument-fuzzing attackers and severity-weighted harm. In an evaluation with real open-weights models (Qwen2.5-1.5B and Qwen2.5-7B; 156 attack episodes per defence and model), the models proposed the attacker's call in 64% and 84% of attack episodes behind the task-bound monitor, which admitted 1.3% and 7.7%; guardrail effects depended on the model (a prompt guardrail moved obedience from 67% to 65% and from 86% to 55%, spotlighting plus a detector to 12% and 0%) against static attacks. Simulation with an assumed model covers what no real run did: under the assumed erosion law a persistent adaptive attacker or a compromised model drives every guardrail stack to 100.0% attack success, whereas the task-bound monitor holds severe actions at 0.0%; its residual (harm 0.69/10) falls by 62% under taint-triggered human review, and a human layer without a deterministic monitor fails against approval spamming unless each episode has a deterministic approval budget. Implementation quality matters: a naive monitor admits 18 of 33 effective attack variants, a hardened one 6 and a capability-bound one 1. The real-model evidence is limited to two open-weights models and static attacks, the human-approval and taint results are simulation-only, and the larger model's detector stack contradicts the assumed erosion law. Code, data, a two-rater oracle audit and a notebook for repeating the real-model evaluation are provided.

title_cn: 把模型当作不受信组件：工具使用智能体中针对提示注入的确定性策略执行、人工审批与污点追踪（开源权重模型验证）
abstract_cn: 工具使用 LLM 智能体会执行嵌入其读取数据中的指令，因此提示注入是结构性问题而非提示措辞问题。我们对比提示内防御（加固提示、聚光标注、LLM 检测器）与模型外的确定性执行（四个强度递增的参考监控器）、人工审批与污点追踪，用一个独立于所有防御的效应基 oracle 判定，环境为含 13 任务 12 工具的可执行环境，攻击者为参数模糊化型并按严重性加权伤害。在真实开源权重模型（Qwen2.5-1.5B 与 7B；每防御每模型 156 个攻击回合）的评估中，两模型在任务边界监控器之后仍分别以 64% 与 84% 的回合提出攻击者调用——该监控器放行 1.3% 与 7.7%；护栏效果依赖模型（一个提示护栏把服从率从 67% 移到 65%、从 86% 移到 55%，聚光+检测器移到 12% 与 0%，针对静态攻击）。使用假定模型的仿真覆盖了真实运行未覆盖的情形：在假定的侵蚀律下，持续自适应攻击者或被入侵模型会把每个护栏栈推到 100.0% 攻击成功率，而任务边界监控器把严重动作保持为 0.0%；其残余（伤害 0.69/10）在污点触发的人工审查下下降 62%，而无确定性监控的人工层除非每回合有确定性审批预算否则败于审批垃圾。实现质量重要：朴素监控器放行 33 个有效攻击变体中的 18 个，加固的放行 6 个，能力边界的放行 1 个。真实模型证据限于两个开源权重模型与静态攻击；人工审批与污点结果仅限仿真；较大模型的检测器栈与假定侵蚀律矛盾。代码、数据、双评分者 oracle 审计与复现真实模型评估的笔记本均已提供。
summary_cn: 系统性对比提示内护栏与模型外确定性执行/审批/污点追踪：真实开源权重模型 156 回合/防御评估 + 侵蚀律仿真，任务边界监控器把严重动作保持 0%。
objective_summary: 以效应基 oracle 系统比较智能体提示注入防御家族（护栏 vs 确定性监控/审批/污点），在真实开源权重模型与仿真中量化各自边界。

title: PRISM: Causal Counterfactual Minimization of Agent Tool Privileges via Information Bottleneck Role Induction
abstract: This paper shifts the object of role engineering from human users to large language model (LLM) agents, and proposes PRISM to address the over-authorization that arises when an agent obtains full tool privileges through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). PRISM formulates whether a tool is necessary for a task as an intervenable causal proposition, and applies structured interventions in a sandbox to learn a counterfactual necessity model. It then compresses trajectories into discrete latent variables through an information bottleneck, and determines the number of roles from the knee of the rate-distortion curve. Finally, it formalizes pruning as a bilevel Stackelberg game, in which a generative flow network samples diverse near-optimal solutions. On three public benchmarks, AgentDojo, $\tau$-bench and ToolEmu, PRISM compresses the number of authorized tools per role by 78.3%, attains a task success rate of 78.2%, reaches a counterfactual necessity accuracy of 88.7%, and lowers the blast radius to 15.9%.
title_cn: PRISM：经信息瓶颈角色归纳的智能体工具权限因果反事实最小化
abstract_cn: 本文把角色工程的对象从人类用户转向大语言模型（LLM）智能体，提出 PRISM 以解决智能体经模型上下文协议（MCP）获得完整工具权限时产生的过度授权。PRISM 把「工具对任务是否必要」表述为可干预的因果命题，并在沙箱中应用结构化干预学习反事实必要性模型；随后经信息瓶颈把轨迹压缩为离散潜在变量，并从率失真曲线的膝点确定角色数量；最后把剪枝形式化为双层 Stackelberg 博弈，由生成式流网络采样多样的近优解。在 AgentDojo、τ-bench 与 ToolEmu 三个公开基准上，PRISM 把每角色授权工具数压缩 78.3%，达到 78.2% 的任务成功率、88.7% 的反事实必要性准确率，并把影响半径降到 15.9%。
summary_cn: PRISM 面向 MCP 智能体过度授权：因果反事实必要性 + 信息瓶颈角色归纳 + GFlowNet Stackelberg 剪枝，三基准上工具压缩 78.3%、成功率 78.2%、影响半径 15.9%。
objective_summary: 提出把角色工程对象转为 LLM 智能体的权限最小化框架 PRISM：沙箱干预学习工具必要性、信息瓶颈归纳角色、双层博弈剪枝。
evidence_note: AgentDojo/τ-bench/ToolEmu 三公开基准的量化结果（78.3%/78.2%/88.7%/15.9%）；无统计检验与消融细节（摘要层面）。
novelty_note: 因果反事实必要性 + 信息瓶颈角色归纳 + 生成式流网络剪枝的组合为智能体权限管理提供新方法栈；思想组件各有先例。

title: On the Relative Security of Prompt Injection: Mechanised Definitions, Defences and Verdicts for LLM Agents
abstract: An LLM agent that reads untrusted content, such as an email or a web page, may follow instructions hidden in it. Noninterference is too strong for such agents, since a useful agent lets untrusted content influence what it does and may disclose the user's data by design, and declassification needs a release policy written for each task. We instead state security relative to a reference agent, which runs the same plan under the same runtime monitor with a model that never obeys untrusted content. An agent is relatively secure if every leak it has is a leak the reference already has. Our framework, PlanTERS, instantiates relative security, a notion from speculative execution, with a small agent language in which the attacker chooses how the model follows instructions, a composition with runtime monitors, and attacker models that differ in what they observe. A fence theorem shows that revoking injectable tools at the first untrusted read, and never granting them back, makes every plan relatively secure at the event level on finite runs, for every model behaviour in which each injection is a single call and the model obeys on a schedule fixed in advance; with a fairness condition, this extends to possibly infinite runs. We prove or refute relative security for agents with fences, budgets, approvals, loops and dual LLMs, in Isabelle/HOL.
title_cn: 论提示注入的相对安全性：LLM 智能体的机械化定义、防御与判定
abstract_cn: 读取不可信内容（如邮件或网页）的 LLM 智能体可能遵循其中隐藏的指令。非干涉对此类智能体过强：有用的智能体本就允许不可信内容影响其行为，并可能按设计披露用户数据；而去分类需要为每个任务编写释放策略。我们转而相对一个参考智能体陈述安全性——参考智能体在同一运行时监控下以从不服从不可信内容的模型执行同一计划。若一个智能体的每个泄露都是参考已有的泄露，则它是相对安全的。我们的框架 PlanTERS 把来自推测执行领域的相对安全概念实例化：一个小型智能体语言（攻击者选择模型如何遵循指令）、与运行时监控的组合，以及在观察能力上不同的攻击者模型。围栏定理表明：在第一次不可信读取时撤销可注入工具且永不归还，使每个计划在有限运行的事件级上对所有模型行为相对安全——只要每次注入是单次调用且模型按预定时间表服从；加公平性条件可扩展到可能无限的运行。我们在 Isabelle/HOL 中为带围栏、预算、审批、循环与双 LLM 的智能体证明或反驳相对安全性。
summary_cn: PlanTERS 把推测执行的相对安全概念移植到提示注入：以「永不服从不可信内容的参考智能体」为基线，围栏定理给出首次不可信读取即撤销工具的充分条件，Isabelle/HOL 机械化。
objective_summary: 为 LLM 智能体定义并机械化验证相对安全性：以参考智能体为泄露基线，证明工具围栏策略的相对安全定理并判定多类智能体模式。
evidence_note: Isabelle/HOL 机械化证明；围栏定理在有限与（加公平性）无限运行上成立；对围栏/预算/审批/循环/双 LLM 多模式逐一判定。
novelty_note: 把推测执行的相对安全引入提示注入是新的定义性框架，绕开非干涉过强与逐任务释放策略两难；机械化判定为防御设计提供形式依据。
scope: 小型智能体语言的抽象模型；单次调用注入与预定服从时间表的模型行为假设之内。
limitations: 抽象语言与真实智能体框架的差距

title: EVAX: Towards a Practical, Pro-active & Adaptive Architecture for High Performance & Security
abstract: This paper provides an end-to-end solution to defend against known microarchitectural attacks such as speculative execution attacks, fault-injection attacks, covert and side channel attacks, and unknown or evasive versions of these attacks. Current defenses are attack specific and can have unacceptably high performance overhead. We propose an approach that reduces the overhead of state-of-art defenses by over 95%, by applying defenses only when attacks are detected. Many current proposed mitigations are not practical for deployment; for example, InvisiSpec has 27% overhead and Fencing has 74% overhead while protecting against only Spectre attacks. Other mitigations carry similar performance penalties. We reduce the overhead for InvisiSpec to 1.26% and for Fencing to 3.45% offering performance and security for not only spectre attacks but other known transient attacks as well, including the dangerous class of LVI and Rowhammer attacks, as well as covering a large set of future evasive and zero-day attacks. Critical to our approach is an accurate detector that is not fooled by evasive attacks and that can generalize to novel zero-day attacks. We use a novel Generative framework, Evasion Vaccination (EVAX) for training ML models and engineering new security-centric performance counters. EVAX significantly increases sensitivity to detect and classify attacks in time for mitigation to be deployed with low false positives (4 FPs in every 1M instructions in our experiments). Such performance enables efficient and timely mitigations, enabling the processor to automatically switch between performance and security as needed.

title_cn: EVAX：面向高性能与安全的实用、主动与自适应架构
abstract_cn: 本文对微架构攻击提供端到端防御方案，覆盖推测执行攻击、故障注入攻击、隐蔽与侧信道攻击及其未知或规避版本。当前防御是攻击特定的且可能有不可接受的性能开销。我们提出一种方法：只在检测到攻击时应用防御，把最先进防御的开销削减超过 95%。许多已提出的缓解措施不适合部署：例如 InvisiSpec 有 27% 开销、Fencing 有 74% 开销且只防 Spectre 攻击。其他缓解措施有类似性能代价。我们把 InvisiSpec 的开销降到 1.26%、Fencing 降到 3.45%，不仅为 Spectre 攻击提供性能与安全，还覆盖其他已知瞬态攻击——包括危险的 LVI 与 Rowhammer 攻击类——以及大量未来规避与零日攻击。关键在于一个不被规避攻击愚弄、能泛化到新零日攻击的准确检测器。我们使用新颖的生成式框架「规避疫苗」（Evasion Vaccination, EVAX）训练 ML 模型并设计新的安全导向性能计数器。EVAX 显著提升及时检测与分类攻击的敏感度、误报极低（实验中每百万指令 4 个误报），使处理器能按需在性能与安全间自动切换。2022 年 IEEE/ACM 微结构国际研讨会（MICRO）作者手稿。
summary_cn: EVAX 检测到攻击才开防御：InvisiSpec 开销 27%→1.26%、Fencing 74%→3.45%，每百万指令 4 误报，覆盖 Spectre/LVI/Rowhammer 及规避变体；MICRO 2022。
objective_summary: 提出检测触发式微架构防御架构 EVAX：生成式规避-疫苗框架训练攻击检测器并设计安全性能计数器，使按需切换防御的开销大幅降低。

title: Robust and Private Swarm Learning via Zero-Knowledge Validator Admission and Consensus Aggregation
abstract: Swarm Learning improves resilience and removes the need for a single trusted coordinator by distributing model aggregation and validation across participating nodes. However, it also delegates the validation of model updates to peers whose private data may be biased, unrepresentative, or adversarial, and existing Swarm Learning protocols generally do not attest that data, leaving decentralized validation as an attack surface. We present a robust, privacy-preserving Swarm Learning framework that makes verifiable data quality the condition for admission to the learning task. A validator joins only after a zero-knowledge attestation proves, without revealing any raw sample, that a reference model ran correctly on its private data. The attested outputs also yield a label-free class profile, so the network assembles a collectively IID validator pool from individually skewed validators as accurately as an oracle with the true labels (total-variation distance to uniform 0.025, against 0.021 for the oracle and 0.21 for random selection). Admitted validators score client updates and, through a Tendermint-style Byzantine Fault Tolerant consensus, agree on a gradient mask and a quality-derived aggregation weight for each submission, replacing dataset-size weighting with a quality-aware signal. Adapting the cut-layer idea of Split Learning, a challenge-based audit lets peers re-verify that a mask was computed on the attested data without an expensive end-to-end zero-knowledge proof. Across four benchmarks under non-IID partitions the framework matches FedAvg on clean data; under a gradient-scaling attack that collapses FedAvg to random chance, it retains 94% of clean accuracy on CIFAR-100 and over 99% on FashionMNIST, where FedAvg achieves only 2.1% and 11%. The result is a private, robust, and auditable foundation for decentralized learning.
title_cn: 经零知识验证者准入与共识聚合的鲁棒私有群学习
abstract_cn: 群学习（Swarm Learning）通过把模型聚合与验证分布到参与节点提升弹性并免除单一可信协调者。但它也把模型更新的验证委托给其私有数据可能有偏、不具代表性甚至对抗性的对等节点，而现有群学习协议一般不证明这些数据，使去中心化验证成为攻击面。我们提出一个鲁棒、隐私保护的群学习框架：把可验证的数据质量作为加入学习任务的条件。验证者只有在零知识证明——不泄露任何原始样本——证明参考模型在其私有数据上正确运行后才被准入。被证明的输出还产生无标签的类轮廓，使网络能从各自偏斜的验证者中组装出与拥有真标签的 oracle 一样准确地整体 IID 的验证者池（到均匀分布的总变差距离 0.025，oracle 为 0.021，随机选择为 0.21）。获准入的验证者为客户端更新打分，并经 Tendermint 式拜占庭容错共识就每个提交的梯度掩码与质量导出的聚合权重达成一致，以质量感知信号取代数据集大小加权。借鉴 Split Learning 的切分层思想，基于挑战的审计让对等节点无需昂贵的端到端零知识证明即可重新验证掩码是在被证明的数据上计算的。在非 IID 划分下的四个基准上，框架在干净数据上匹配 FedAvg；在把 FedAvg 压至随机水平的梯度缩放攻击下，它在 CIFAR-100 上保留 94% 干净准确率、在 FashionMNIST 上超过 99%（FedAvg 仅 2.1% 与 11%）。结果是一个私有、鲁棒、可审计的去中心化学习基础。
summary_cn: 零知识准入 + BFT 共识聚合的群学习框架：梯度缩放攻击下保留 CIFAR-100 94%/FashionMNIST >99% 干净准确率（FedAvg 仅 2.1%/11%），验证者池组装精度近 oracle。
objective_summary: 提出以零知识数据质量证明为准入条件的鲁棒群学习框架：验证者池组装、质量感知聚合权重与免端到端 ZK 的挑战式审计。
evidence_note: 四基准非 IID 划分 + 梯度缩放攻击对照（94%/99% vs FedAvg 2.1%/11%）；验证者池 TV 距离与 oracle/随机选择对比（0.025/0.021/0.21）。
novelty_note: ZK 数据质量准入 + BFT 质量加权聚合 + Split Learning 式挑战审计的组合为新系统设计；各组件均有先例。
scope: 无中心协调者的群学习设定；参考模型与证明系统假设之内；图像基准任务。

title: Coding Agents Propagate Vulnerabilities in Code Bases
abstract: LLM-based coding agents are widely used to develop critical production software. Even though coding agents are known to occasionally write vulnerable code, there has not been any investigation into how code base vulnerabilities evolve over time under coding agent contributions. In this work, we close this gap by investigating whether and how vulnerabilities in existing code lead coding agents to introduce similar vulnerabilities in the code they write. We first evaluate coding agents on 96 tasks that require implementing a new backend application in a repository where other applications already exist. Second, we investigate repository-level code generation on 20 pairs of tasks in real C/C++ projects. In each task, the agent is asked to complete code critical to memory safety. We find that in both settings, insecure existing code leads to agents writing vulnerable code more often. In backend generation, insecure neighbors reduce the share of correct and secure implementations by 3.4% on average, and in C/C++ repository-level coding, the average gap between secure and insecure contexts reaches 35.4%. Prompting to follow existing code-style or to be careful about security increases, respectively decreases, how strongly agents propagate vulnerabilities, but neither stops them. When asked to explain their implementation choices, coding agents attribute them to following another code site in 76.5% of cases, even though they recognize the introduced vulnerability in 69.9% of cases. These findings show that agents use existing vulnerabilities as templates for new ones indiscriminatorily, turning each contribution into an opportunity to introduce more vulnerabilities. As such, as agents write a growing share of production code under decreasing human review, code bases can increasingly degrade in security if security vulnerabilities are not thoroughly fixed continuously.
title_cn: 编码智能体在代码库中传播漏洞
abstract_cn: 基于 LLM 的编码智能体被广泛用于开发关键生产软件。尽管已知编码智能体偶尔会写出漏洞代码，但尚无研究调查在编码智能体贡献下代码库漏洞如何随时间演化。本工作填补这一空白：调查既有代码中的漏洞是否以及如何导致编码智能体在其编写的代码中引入相似漏洞。我们首先在 96 个要求在已有其他应用的仓库中实现新后端应用的任务上评估编码智能体；其次在真实 C/C++ 项目的 20 对任务上调查仓库级代码生成——每个任务要求智能体完成对内存安全关键的代码。我们发现在两种设定中，不安全的既有代码都会导致智能体更频繁地写出漏洞代码。在后端生成中，不安全邻居平均使正确且安全实现的比例下降 3.4%；在 C/C++ 仓库级编码中，安全与不安全上下文之间的平均差距达 35.4%。提示智能体遵循既有代码风格会增加其传播漏洞的程度，提示注意安全则会减少，但都不能阻止。当被要求解释实现选择时，编码智能体在 76.5% 的情形中把选择归因于跟随另一处代码，尽管其中 69.9% 的情形它能识别所引入的漏洞。这些发现表明智能体无差别地把既有漏洞当作新漏洞的模板，把每次贡献都变成引入更多漏洞的机会。因此，随着智能体在人工审查减少的情况下编写越来越大的生产代码份额，若不持续彻底修复安全漏洞，代码库的安全性会持续退化。
summary_cn: 实证调查编码智能体复制既有漏洞模式：不安全上下文使安全实现降 3.4%（后端）/35.4% 差距（C/C++）；76.5% 归因于跟随既有代码、69.9% 自认漏洞仍照写。
objective_summary: 量化编码智能体受仓库既有不安全代码影响而复制漏洞模式的程度，并分析其风格提示与解释行为的调节作用。
evidence_note: 96 后端任务 + 20 对真实 C/C++ 项目任务的双重设定；量化 3.4%/35.4% 差距、76.5%/69.9% 的解释行为统计；控制安全/不安全上下文对照。
novelty_note: 首次系统调查「智能体贡献下代码库漏洞的演化动力学」；「无差别以漏洞为模板 + 自我认知与行为脱节」是新失败模式的刻画。
scope: LLM 编码智能体的代码生成行为；后端应用与 C/C++ 内存安全关键代码两类任务之内。
limitations: 任务集自建，生产代码库的纵向研究缺失
未测修复后的智能体行为
解释归因的自报性质

title: When Coding Agents Get Arms: Safety Risks Across the Digital-Physical Boundary
abstract: Advances in spatial understanding have enabled frontier models to power coding agents that control a real robot arm zero-shot and end-to-end, without task-specific demonstrations or retraining. This brings two new safety challenges. First, the extensive knowledge of frontier models lets these agents perform tasks that earlier VLA and WAM paradigms could not, opening the door to new forms of capability misuse. Second, coding agents can access digital resources such as web pages and emails. Threats in these resources, such as indirect prompt injection, can carry over into the physical world when the agent controls a robot. We therefore introduce ArmedAgent, the first systematic benchmark to evaluate both risks for coding agents performing zero-shot robot control. It covers robustness, malicious use, and indirect injection across 36 tasks in 5 scenarios, evaluated in simulation and validated on a physical robot arm. A distinctive portion of the tasks target harmful behaviors that earlier VLA paradigms could not perform. Testing several frontier models, including GPT-6-Astra, under widely used agent frameworks, we find substantial safety risks in current systems.
title_cn: 当编码智能体装上机械臂：跨数字-物理边界的安全风险
abstract_cn: 空间理解的进步使前沿模型能够零样本、端到端地驱动真实机器人机械臂的编码智能体，无需任务特定示教或重训。这带来两个新的安全挑战。第一，前沿模型的广泛知识让这些智能体能执行早期 VLA 与 WAM 范式无法完成的任务，为新型能力滥用打开大门。第二，编码智能体可访问网页与邮件等数字资源；这些资源中的威胁（如间接提示注入）会在智能体控制机器人时带入物理世界。因此我们提出 ArmedAgent，首个系统评估编码智能体执行零样本机器人控制时两类风险的基准：覆盖鲁棒性、恶意使用与间接注入，共 5 个场景 36 个任务，在仿真中评估并在真实机械臂上验证。任务的独特部分针对早期 VLA 范式无法执行的有害行为。在广泛使用的智能体框架下测试包括 GPT-6-Astra 在内的多个前沿模型，我们发现当前系统存在重大安全风险。技术报告，进行中的工作。
summary_cn: ArmedAgent 首个编码智能体机械臂控制安全基准：36 任务/5 场景覆盖鲁棒性、恶意使用与间接注入，仿真评估 + 真实机械臂验证，前沿模型风险显著。
objective_summary: 构建评估编码智能体零样本机器人控制安全性的基准 ArmedAgent，跨数字-物理边界测量鲁棒性、恶意使用与间接注入风险。
evidence_note: 36 任务 × 5 场景，仿真评估 + 物理机械臂验证，多前沿模型（含 GPT-6-Astra）与主流框架；技术报告进行中，无量化风险数字（摘要层面）。
novelty_note: 首个把「编码智能体 + 真实机械臂」作为安全评测对象、并针对早期 VLA 无法执行的有害行为设计任务的基准；数字-物理威胁传递是新问题设定。
scope: 零样本机械臂控制的编码智能体；仿真 + 单一物理平台验证；任务集之内。
limitations: 技术报告状态，指标与结论可能变动
物理验证限于单一机械臂平台
现实家庭/工业环境的干扰未覆盖

title: RoCoMark: Robust Code Watermarking Against LLM-Based Functionality-Preserving Rewriting Attacks
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) present significant challenges to source tracing of generated code, as LLM rewriting can substantially alter the syntactic and structural characteristics of watermarked code. However, existing watermarking methods often suffer severe performance degradation under LLM-based functionality-preserving rewriting attacks. We attribute this vulnerability not merely to the intensity of rewriting, but to a fundamental distribution mismatch between the perturbations encountered during watermark training and the global, non-deterministic rewriting behaviors induced by LLMs. In order to deal with this challenge, we propose RoCoMark, a Robust Code waterMarking framework that explicitly learns and adapts to LLM rewriting behaviors. RoCoMark is a multi-round minimax game between the watermark embedder and LLM rewriter. In each round, the embedder first learns threat profiling from LLM-rewritten code by optimizing the watermark encoder through contrastive learning and knowledge distillation while mitigating catastrophic representation drift. Then the embedder improves strategies by optimizing the watermark encoder and extractor simultaneously. Finally, an adaptive attack-evolution mechanism based on Reflexion and short- and long-term memory pools is applied, enabling continuous interaction between the watermark embedder and evolving rewriting strategies. This iterative attacker-defender process progressively improves the robustness of the watermark against diverse and previously unseen LLM rewriting behaviors. Extensive experiments on four typical benchmarks, under attacks generated by five LLMs, show the effectiveness of RoCoMark. RoCoMark achieves an average detection AUROC of 74.2% and a Rewrite BitACC of 75.3%, while maintaining a code functionality pass rate above 99.7%.
title_cn: RoCoMark：抗 LLM 功能保持重写攻击的鲁棒代码水印
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）给生成代码的源追踪带来重大挑战，因为 LLM 重写可以大幅改变被水印代码的句法与结构特征。然而现有水印方法在基于 LLM 的功能保持重写攻击下常遭遇严重性能退化。我们把这一脆弱性不仅归因于重写强度，更归因于水印训练时遭遇的扰动与 LLM 引发的全局、非确定性重写行为之间的根本分布不匹配。为应对这一挑战，我们提出 RoCoMark，一个显式学习并适应 LLM 重写行为的鲁棒代码水印框架。RoCoMark 是水印嵌入者与 LLM 重写者之间的多轮 minimax 博弈：每轮嵌入者先通过优化水印编码器（以对比学习与知识蒸馏缓解灾难性表示漂移）从 LLM 重写代码中学习威胁画像；然后嵌入者同时优化水印编码器与提取器以改进策略；最后应用基于 Reflexion 与短期/长期记忆池的自适应攻击演化机制，使水印嵌入者与演化重写策略持续交互。这一攻防迭代过程逐步提升水印对多样且此前未见的 LLM 重写行为的鲁棒性。在四个典型基准、五种 LLM 生成的攻击下的大量实验显示其有效性：RoCoMark 达到平均检测 AUROC 74.2% 与重写位准确率 75.3%，同时保持代码功能通过率高于 99.7%。
summary_cn: RoCoMark 以嵌入者-重写者多轮 minimax 博弈对抗 LLM 重写：四基准五 LLM 攻击下检测 AUROC 74.2%、位准确率 75.3%，功能通过率 >99.7%。
objective_summary: 提出显式适应 LLM 重写行为的代码水印框架：多轮 minimax 博弈 + 对比学习威胁画像 + Reflexion 驱动的攻击演化机制。
evidence_note: 四基准 × 五 LLM 攻击的量化对比（AUROC 74.2%、位准确率 75.3%、功能 >99.7%）；无统计检验与绝对性能水平的横向说明。
novelty_note: 把水印鲁棒性建模为与 LLM 重写者的持续博弈并引入 Reflexion 攻击演化是新的训练范式；检测绝对水平仍中等。
scope: 代码来源追踪水印在 LLM 功能保持重写下的鲁棒性；所选基准与攻击模型之内。
limitations: AUROC 74.2% 的检测水平仍有限
博弈训练成本高
对非重写类攻击（编译/混淆）覆盖未述

title: Self-Healing by design: Immune-system inspired autonomous cyber resilience
abstract: Digital innovations have strongly improved ship capabilities, including command, control & communication, navigation and combat management. In the wake of digitisation and geopolitical stress, resilience against cyber-attacks has become a key challenge. Autonomous Cyber Resilience (ACR) methods, inspired by features of the human immune system, provide a promising perspective. Proofs of concept of autonomous self-healing and self-protecting software have been realised in cloud environments using containerisation, monitoring and deployment technology. However, developing a suitable "cyber immune system" for more complex digital systems is still an intricate challenge. In this paper, we share insights on how ACR methods can be combined with resilience mechanisms present in critical naval and aeronautical manoeuvring systems. Using TNO's "OpPic" application, we show how TNO's Self-Healing for Cyber Security software can provide autonomous mission- and threat-adaptive resilience. On this basis, six guidelines for the design of autonomous cyber resilient systems are derived. The ultimate goal is to enable operators to oversee and control their system's "cyber immune response", to be able to continuously adapt to evolving threats and mission priorities.
comment: The content of this paper was presented at MAST Australia 2024, 19-21 November in Adelaide. The presentation was accepted after review of the abstract that is published on this https URL
title_cn: 设计即自愈：免疫系统启发的自主网络弹性
abstract_cn: 数字创新极大提升了舰船能力，包括指挥、控制与通信、导航与作战管理。在数字化与地缘政治压力之下，对网络攻击的弹性成为关键挑战。受人体免疫系统特征启发的自主网络弹性（ACR）方法提供了有前景的视角。基于容器化、监控与部署技术的自主自愈与自保护软件概念验证已在云环境中实现。然而为更复杂的数字系统开发合适的「网络免疫系统」仍是一个复杂的挑战。本文分享如何把 ACR 方法与关键舰船及航空操纵系统中已有的弹性机制相结合的洞见。借助 TNO 的「OpPic」应用，我们展示 TNO 的 Self-Healing for Cyber Security 软件如何提供自主的、任务与威胁自适应的弹性。在此基础上推导出自主网络弹性系统设计的六条指南。最终目标是使操作者能够监督并控制系统的「网络免疫反应」，以持续适应演化的威胁与任务优先级。内容曾于 2024 年 11 月 19–21 日在阿德莱德 MAST Australia 2024 报告。
summary_cn: 免疫系统启发的舰船/航空系统网络弹性：以 OpPic 演示自主任务与威胁自适应自愈，给出六条设计指南，属经验性立场工作。
objective_summary: 结合自主网络弹性方法与舰船/航空操纵系统的弹性机制，以 OpPic 应用演示自愈能力并推导六条设计指南。
evidence_note: OpPic 应用演示与既有概念验证经验；曾以摘要评审形式在 MAST Australia 2024 报告；无系统评估数据。
novelty_note: 免疫系统启发的 ACR 概念已有文献；贡献是把指南适配到舰船/航空操纵系统的领域经验整理。
scope: 关键操纵系统（舰船/航空）的网络弹性设计；概念验证演示之内。
limitations: 无量化弹性评估
六条指南的适用边界未验证
「免疫反应」的可控性仍是开放问题

title: Attacking Slide Puzzle CAPTCHAs Based on Time and Space Generative Adversarial Networks
abstract: CAPTCHAs can protect websites from malicious attacks. As a typical representative of behavior CAPTCHAs, slide puzzle CAPTCHAs have become increasingly popular in recent years due to their user-friendliness and high security. Previous attack methods on slide puzzle CAPTCHA mainly face challenges in the following four aspects. (1) The defense mechanisms of previous slide puzzle CAPTCHAs were relatively simple. The current slide puzzle CAPTCHAs have added complex interferences, detected slide trajectory features in the two-dimensional space, and added other defense mechanisms. (2) The previous notch detection methods were difficult to accurately locate the notch positions. (3) Previous attack trajectories were limited to the horizontal dimension, making them impossible to pass the existing detection. (4) The previous attack trajectories were generated by fitting functions, which were relatively simple and could not well simulate the slide characteristics of human users. In response to the above challenges, firstly, we systematically analyze the defense strategies of six most popular slide puzzle CAPTCHAs: Capy, Dingxiang, Geetest, Kyger, Shumei and Tencent. Secondly, for each type of CAPTCHA, we construct a notch detection dataset and a slide trajectory dataset separately. Thirdly, we use advanced YOLOv11 to detect the notch positions and train generative adversarial networks (GAN) to generate attack trajectories. As far as we know, we are the first to generate attack trajectories by directly learning human slide trajectory characteristic. According to the experimental results, this method cracked six most popular slide puzzle CAPTCHAs with success rates of over 90\%, and the attack time is only about 5 seconds, indicating that the security of existing slide puzzle CAPTCHAs is facing challenge. At the same time, we propose various methods to enhance the security of slide puzzle CAPTCHAs.
title_cn: 基于时空生成对抗网络的滑块拼图验证码攻击
abstract_cn: 验证码可以保护网站免受恶意攻击。作为行为验证码的典型代表，滑块拼图验证码因其用户友好性与高安全性近年日益流行。先前对滑块拼图验证码的攻击方法主要面临四方面挑战：(1) 旧验证码防御机制较简单，现有滑块拼图验证码已加入复杂干扰、在二维空间检测滑动轨迹特征并增加其他防御机制；(2) 旧缺口检测方法难以精确定位缺口位置；(3) 旧攻击轨迹局限于水平维度，无法通过现有检测；(4) 旧攻击轨迹由拟合函数生成，相对简单，无法很好模拟人类用户的滑动特征。针对上述挑战，首先我们系统分析六款最流行的滑块拼图验证码（Capy、顶象、极验、Kyger、数美与腾讯）的防御策略；其次为每类验证码分别构建缺口检测数据集与滑动轨迹数据集；第三，用先进的 YOLOv11 检测缺口位置并训练生成对抗网络（GAN）生成攻击轨迹。据我们所知，我们是首个通过直接学习人类滑动轨迹特征来生成攻击轨迹的工作。实验结果显示该方法破解六款最流行滑块拼图验证码的成功率均超过 90%，攻击时间仅约 5 秒，表明现有滑块拼图验证码的安全正面临挑战。同时我们提出多种增强滑块拼图验证码安全性的方法。
summary_cn: YOLOv11 缺口检测 + GAN 学习人类轨迹攻击六款主流滑块验证码：成功率均超 90%、单次约 5 秒，并给出防御增强建议。
objective_summary: 系统分析六款滑块拼图验证码防御，构建缺口与轨迹数据集，以 YOLOv11 检测缺口、时空 GAN 生成人类化攻击轨迹并评估成功率。
evidence_note: 六款真实商用验证码的成功率（均 >90%）与攻击耗时（约 5 秒）量化；自建缺口与轨迹数据集；无统计检验说明。
novelty_note: 首个直接学习人类滑动轨迹特征生成二维攻击轨迹的工作；时空 GAN 相比拟合函数能模拟人类滑动特征并通过轨迹检测。
scope: 滑块拼图类行为验证码；六款所测产品与其当前防御机制之内。
limitations: 验证码厂商持续更新使结果有时效性
人类轨迹数据集的来源与规模未详述
对更严格设备指纹风控的组合攻击未评估

title: Agentic Attribution of Cloud Resource Ownership
abstract: Security tools raise findings across cloud environments, and AI agents now investigate and prioritize them. A finding is still resolved by people: it has to reach the people responsible for fixing it and accountable for the resource it concerns. Ownership is the organizational context that decides who that is. Where recorded, it is declared by hand in configuration management databases or owner tags and goes stale unless kept current; accounts are shared, and automation creates much of the infrastructure. The knowledge sits in work records, code history, audit logs and identity directories, encoded in each organization's own conventions. Recovering it poses four challenges: the signal is scattered across sources, none of them authoritative; the conventions that carry it differ between organizations; reaching an owner takes multi-hop links; and those related to a resource differ in the strength of their relation. We define ownership as a set of entities, people or teams, each related to the resource by one of five patterns ordered by strength. We present a reference architecture for agentic ownership attribution that derives ownership from these records instead of declaring it: it profiles an organization offline into tested signal procedures and an ownership playbook, then attributes each resource with a coordinator agent and parallel investigators, with confidence computed by rules. On 100 resources of 50 Amazon Web Services (AWS) resource types in one organization, we pool the architecture's candidates with those of an unprimed general-purpose agent and verify every evidence piece against the records. The architecture reaches 92.1% weighted recall and 86.6% weighted precision, against 54.8% and 77.4%, at 0.55 times the agent's cost per unit of coverage. The difference lies in people who build and change resources without an explicit owner, found through work records and code history.
title_cn: 云资源所有权的智能体归因
abstract_cn: 安全工具跨云环境产生发现，AI 智能体现在调查并排序它们。但发现仍由人来解决：它必须到达负责修复并对资源负责的人。所有权是决定这个人的组织上下文。在有记录之处，它在配置管理数据库或所有者标签中手工声明，且除非持续维护否则会过期；账户共享，自动化创建了大部分基础设施。这些知识散布在工作记录、代码历史、审计日志与身份目录中，以每个组织自己的约定编码。恢复它面临四个挑战：信号分散在多个非权威来源；承载它的约定因组织而异；触达所有者需要多跳链接；与资源相关者的关系强度不同。我们把所有权定义为按强度排序的五种模式之一关联到资源的实体（人或团队）集合。我们提出智能体所有权归因的参考架构：从这些记录推导所有权而非声明它——离线把组织画像为经测试的信号程序与所有权手册，然后用协调者智能体与并行调查者为每个资源归因，置信度由规则计算。在一个组织的 100 个资源（50 种 AWS 资源类型）上，我们把架构候选者与未预置的通用智能体候选者合并并对照记录核验每条证据。架构达到 92.1% 加权召回与 86.6% 加权精度（对照 54.8% 与 77.4%），单位覆盖成本为该智能体的 0.55 倍。差距在于通过工作记录与代码历史发现的、构建和变更资源却没有显式所有者的人。
summary_cn: 智能体所有权归因架构：五强度模式定义所有权，单组织 100 AWS 资源上加权召回 92.1%/精度 86.6%（通用智能体 54.8%/77.4%），成本 0.55×。
objective_summary: 把云资源所有权归因形式化为五强度关联模式，提出离线画像 + 协调者/调查者智能体的参考架构并在真实组织数据上对照核验。

title: SkillCODER: Towards Auditing and Attribution of Copyright Infringement in LLM Agent Skills
abstract: Agent skills package reusable workflows and task-specific procedures into deployable natural-language artifacts for LLM agents. Their scale and readability make them valuable but vulnerable to unauthorized redistribution and repackaging. Existing prompt copyright auditing methods struggle with long skills and introduce token-level perturbations that compromise readability. We propose SkillCODER for copyright auditing and buyer attribution in a black-box, content-only setting. During embedding, SkillCODER parses a skill into a section-aware intermediate representation, SkillIR, to identify structural anchors. It distributes conditional instructions across these anchors to form an Artifact-Gated Capsule, designed to activate under verification queries and remain dormant otherwise. Controlled-Vocabulary Error-Correcting Codes encode buyer-specific fingerprints through controlled lexical choices within the capsule. During verification, the defender issues paired positive and negative probes, extracts capsule evidence, and recovers ownership and buyer identity through error-correcting decoding. Across three domains, six models, and three agent frameworks, SkillCODER achieves 99.2% owner verification and 99.3% buyer Top-1 attribution accuracy while preserving task fidelity, substantially outperforming prompt-level baselines. Embedded signals remain robust under paraphrase, compression, clause deletion, and reorganization. Under five adaptive attacks, including a method-aware LLM sanitizer and multi-buyer collusion, ownership evidence remains reliably detectable while buyer attribution degrades gracefully.
comment: 29 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at ACM CCS 2026. Code: this https URL
title_cn: SkillCODER：面向 LLM 智能体技能版权侵权的审计与归因
abstract_cn: 智能体技能把可复用工作流与任务特定流程打包成可部署的自然语言工件。其规模与可读性使其有价值但易受未授权再分发与重打包。现有提示版权审计方法难以处理长技能，且引入损害可读性的 token 级扰动。我们提出 SkillCODER，在黑盒、仅内容设定下做版权审计与买家归因。嵌入阶段，SkillCODER 把技能解析为节感知的中间表示 SkillIR 以识别结构锚点，把条件指令分布到这些锚点形成工件门控胶囊（Artifact-Gated Capsule）——设计为在验证查询下激活、否则休眠。受控词表纠错编码（Controlled-Vocabulary Error-Correcting Codes）经胶囊内的受控词汇选择编码买家特定指纹。验证阶段，防守者发出配对的正负探针、提取胶囊证据并经纠错解码恢复所有权与买家身份。跨三个域、六个模型与三个智能体框架，SkillCODER 达到 99.2% 属主验证与 99.3% 买家 Top-1 归因精度，同时保持任务保真度，大幅优于提示级基线。嵌入信号在改写、压缩、条款删除与重组下保持鲁棒。在五种自适应攻击（含方法感知的 LLM 消毒器与多买家合谋）下，所有权证据仍可可靠检测，买家归因优雅退化。ACM CCS 2026 录用，代码公开。
summary_cn: SkillCODER 为智能体技能做版权审计与买家归因：SkillIR 锚点 + 工件门控胶囊 + 纠错编码指纹，三域六模型上 99.2% 属主验证/99.3% 买家归因，CCS 2026。
objective_summary: 提出黑盒内容-only 的技能版权水印框架 SkillCODER：结构锚点分布条件指令、纠错编码买家指纹，配对探针验证并抗五种自适应攻击。
evidence_note: 三域 × 六模型 × 三框架的评估（99.2%/99.3%）+ 四类内容变换鲁棒性 + 五种自适应攻击（含方法感知消毒器与合谋）；CCS 2026 录用、代码公开。
novelty_note: 把版权审计从提示层提升到技能工件层：工件门控胶囊（验证时激活、平时休眠）与受控词表纠错码是指纹机制的实质新设计。
scope: 自然语言技能工件的版权审计；黑盒、仅内容访问设定；所测模型/框架之内。
limitations: 买家归因在合谋与强消毒下退化（设计如此）
依赖技能具备可解析的结构锚点
对非自然语言工件未覆盖

title: Least-Privilege Auditing of Agent Tool Calls with Intent Graphs and Reasoning-Guided Escalation
abstract: LLM agents that call tools are exposed to indirect prompt injection: instructions hidden in tool outputs can steer an agent into calls the user never asked for. We present a runtime audit that derives an executable intent graph from the user's objective and the deployment's tool catalog with one LLM call per task, and checks every tool call against it with a deterministic loop that makes no LLM call (median 5.7 microseconds per call). Two further mechanisms recover utility. Lookups of the user's own state bypass the audit, because the harm of an attack lies in its write or outward step. The calls that remain flagged are escalated to a reasoning guardian, in the spirit of tool-integrated reasoning models such as START: a reasoning model that sees only the objective, the plan, the call history without tool outputs, and the flagged call, and can verify facts with a restricted Python-expression tool. A current agent showed no baseline attack success, so end-to-end validation remains open.
title_cn: 以意图图与推理引导升级对智能体工具调用的最小权限审计
abstract_cn: 调用工具的 LLM 智能体暴露于间接提示注入：隐藏在工具输出中的指令可把智能体引向用户从未要求的调用。我们提出一个运行时审计：从用户目标与部署的工具目录以每任务一次 LLM 调用导出可执行意图图，并用一个不做任何 LLM 调用的确定性循环对照它检查每个工具调用（每调用中位 5.7 微秒）。两个进一步机制恢复效用。对用户自身状态的查找绕过审计，因为攻击的危害在于写入或外发步骤。仍被标记的调用升级给推理监护者——精神上类似 START 等工具整合推理模型：一个只看到目标、计划、不含工具输出的调用历史与被标记调用的推理模型，可用受限的 Python 表达式工具核验事实。当前智能体未显示基线攻击成功，因此端到端验证仍待完成。
summary_cn: 意图图运行时审计工具调用：每任务一次 LLM 建图 + 确定性检查（中位 5.7 µs/调用），自状态查询豁免、可疑调用升级推理监护者；端到端验证待完成。
objective_summary: 提出以可执行意图图为基准的确定性工具调用审计，配自状态豁免与推理监护者升级两级机制以恢复效用。
evidence_note: 给出确定性检查延迟（中位 5.7 µs）与机制设计；作者明示当前智能体基线攻击成功率为零，端到端防御效果未验证。
novelty_note: 意图图 + 零 LLM 确定性检查 + 写/外发敏感豁免的分层审计是新的机制组合；推理监护者只看无输出历史的调用是新颖设计。
scope: 工具调用智能体的运行时最小权限审计；意图图可从工具目录导出的部署形态。
limitations: 端到端攻击防御效果未验证
意图图的完备性依赖任务表述质量
监护者升级的延迟与误升级率未量化

title: ErosionBench: Probing Alignment Decay in Enterprise Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: As enterprises delegate consequential work to multi-agent LLM systems, benign-looking requests can escalate into unsafe actions as they propagate across sessions through poisoned shared state, long-context documents, and trusted peer messages: no single message is malicious, yet the assembled tool action is. Prior benchmarks isolate a single agent under prompt injection or score multi-agent attacks by their final output, leaving cross-session erosion of shared state out of scope. We introduce ErosionBench, an environment-grounded benchmark that executes such attacks and verifies alignment decay at the process level, scoring the realized tool call against authorized intent and provenance with deterministic contracts, not output text. Each scenario is authored as a deterministic state graph before any prose is rendered, so every state change traces to a known cause. It spans four enterprise domains and four decay mechanisms across 1,728 scenarios with matched benign controls, labeled against the OWASP Top-10 for LLM Applications, plus 198 image-based attacks, each paired with a text equivalent, so a defense must survive the same attack in either channel. Perimeter defenses suppress attacks only by over-refusing 54-92% of legitimate work, so a low attack-success rate can conceal severe over-refusal. As a reference defense, we propose a calibrated Meta-Auditor pairing synchronous state checks with asynchronous trajectory monitoring; on a family-disjoint 906-scenario held-out split it reaches 98.5% recall at a 2.9% false-positive rate. Since it monitors trajectory, not surface content, its detection is channel-invariant: the strongest auditor flags image-delivered attacks about as reliably as their text equivalents (recall gap $\leq$2 points per model). Across GPT, Gemini, and Claude auditors, calibration keeps false positives low while recall tracks model capability, strongest for Claude.
title_cn: ErosionBench：探测企业多智能体系统中的对齐衰减
abstract_cn: 当企业把有后果的工作委托给多智能体 LLM 系统，看似良性的请求会随其在会话间经被投毒的共享状态、长上下文文档与受信任对等消息传播而升级为不安全动作：没有任何单一消息是恶意的，但组装出的工具动作是。先前基准要么在提示注入下隔离单一智能体，要么按最终输出为多智能体攻击打分，把跨会话的共享状态侵蚀排除在外。我们提出 ErosionBench，一个环境锚定的基准：执行此类攻击并在过程级验证对齐衰减——用确定性契约而非输出文本，把实际工具调用对照授权意图与来源打分。每个场景在任何散文渲染前都先被编写为确定性状态图，因此每次状态变化都可追溯到已知原因。基准横跨四个企业域与四种衰减机制共 1,728 个场景并配对良性对照，按 OWASP LLM 应用 Top-10 标注，另含 198 个图像攻击（各配文本等价），使防御必须在两种信道下经受同一攻击。周边防御只有通过对 54–92% 的合法工作过度拒绝才能压制攻击，因此低攻击成功率可能掩盖严重的过度拒绝。作为参考防御，我们提出经校准的元审计者（Meta-Auditor），把同步状态检查与异步轨迹监测配对：在家族无关的 906 场景留出切分上以 2.9% 误报率达到 98.5% 召回。由于监测轨迹而非表面内容，其检测是信道不变的：最强审计者对图像传递攻击的标记与其文本等价相当可靠（每模型召回差距 ≤2 分）。跨 GPT、Gemini 与 Claude 审计者，校准保持低误报而召回跟随模型能力，以 Claude 最强。
summary_cn: ErosionBench 首个跨会话状态侵蚀基准：1,728 场景 + 198 图像攻击过程级验证对齐衰减；周边防御靠 54–92% 过度拒绝对换安全，Meta-Auditor 参考防御 98.5% 召回 @ 2.9% 误报。
objective_summary: 构建以确定性状态图执行的跨会话对齐衰减基准，在过程级（实际工具调用 vs 授权意图）量化攻击与过度拒绝，并提供轨迹级 Meta-Auditor 参考防御。
evidence_note: 1,728 场景 + 198 配对图像攻击、四域四机制、确定性状态图可追溯、906 场景留出切分与三审计者模型的量化对比；OWASP 映射提供外部锚定。
novelty_note: 「跨会话共享状态侵蚀」这一攻击形态此前基准未覆盖；过程级确定性契约打分 + 图像/文本双信道不变性检验是实质新的评测设计。
scope: 企业多智能体系统的共享状态与信任传播场景；确定性状态图可编码的攻击形态之内。
limitations: 场景由作者合成，真实企业工作流覆盖未知
参考防御依赖状态检查的部署位置
图像攻击集合相对较小（198）

title: Chatter Attack: Resource Consumption Attack for Large Language Models
abstract: LLMs are powerful but incur substantial inference cost, which can be exploited by malicious users to induce overly long outputs, increasing latency and operational expense. Prior resource consumption attacks either coerce repetition or suppress the end-of-sequence token by lowering its logit value. However, with autoregressive, sampling-based generation, the search space grows exponentially with length and small deviations or unstable trajectories can derail optimization, limiting attack effectiveness and stability. To address this issue, we introduce Chatter Attack, a novel class of resource consumption attacks that optimize adversarial prompts to induce predefined short target phrases, thereby avoiding search-space explosion while still eliciting long responses. Specifically, Chatter Attack triggers self-doubt using short doubt-inducing phrases as the target, and sustains this state throughout generation via inference attention loss and global entropy loss. To extend to black-box settings, we further propose a novel Bayesian Prompt Optimization (BPO) method, which models the objective function globally by constructing a discrete token kernel, efficiently exploring the entire search space using prior information. Extensive experiments across multiple models and datasets show that our method outperforms baselines, with maximum response length increases to 31.5$\times$, and revealing practical resource-depletion risks for real-world LLM inference services.
title_cn: Chatter Attack：针对大语言模型的资源消耗攻击
abstract_cn: LLM 强大但推理成本高昂，恶意用户可利用其诱导超长输出，增加延迟与运营开支。先前的资源消耗攻击要么强迫重复、要么通过压低序列结束 token 的 logit 值来抑制其触发。然而在自回归、基于采样的生成中，搜索空间随长度指数增长，微小偏差或不稳定轨迹会使优化脱轨，限制攻击的效力与稳定性。为解决这一问题，我们引入 Chatter Attack，一类新的资源消耗攻击：优化对抗性提示以诱导预定义的短目标短语，从而避免搜索空间爆炸的同时仍引发长回复。具体而言，Chatter Attack 用短的、引发怀疑的短语作为目标触发自我怀疑，并经推理注意力损失与全局熵损失在整个生成过程中维持这一状态。为扩展到黑盒设定，我们进一步提出新颖的贝叶斯提示优化（BPO）方法：通过构建离散 token 核全局建模目标函数，利用先验信息高效探索整个搜索空间。跨多模型与多数据集的大量实验显示本方法优于基线，响应长度最大增至 31.5 倍，揭示了现实 LLM 推理服务面临的实际资源耗尽风险。NeurIPS 2026。
summary_cn: Chatter Attack 以短「自我怀疑」短语为目标避免搜索爆炸并经注意力/熵损失维持长输出：响应长度最大增至 31.5×，黑盒下用贝叶斯提示优化，NeurIPS 2026。
objective_summary: 提出面向 LLM 推理资源的消耗攻击 Chatter Attack：以短目标短语优化对抗提示并维持自我怀疑状态，黑盒场景配贝叶斯提示优化。
evidence_note: 多模型多数据集实验并以 31.5× 长度增幅对比基线；NeurIPS 2026 录用；摘要未说明统计检验与真实服务验证。
novelty_note: 以短目标短语规避指数搜索空间是资源消耗攻击的新机制变体；注意力/熵双损失维持状态与 BPO 黑盒扩展为有效配套。
scope: 自回归采样式 LLM 生成服务；白盒梯度可得与黑盒查询两设定。
limitations: 依赖服务端按输出长度计费/排序的行为
对推理服务端缓解（长度上限）仅部分有效
真实生产系统验证未报告

title: Do Benign-Trained Hidden-State Probes Detect Tool Errors Under Adversarial Conditions?
abstract: Although hidden-state probes efficiently monitor model operation, it remains unclear whether probes trained on benign tool use remain useful for detecting incorrect actions under adversarial conditions. In this research, we assess this problem from the perspective of operational tool-action correct- ness. we use four AgentDojo suites, four conditions, and three models: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, and GLM- 4.6V-Flash (9B). We perform a five-fold, task-grouped out-of-fold (OOF) evaluation for each model. We train step-specific logistic- regression probes only on benign and non-defended trajectories and evaluate them on held-out trajectories for benign, prompt- injection, system-override, and tool-poisoning conditions. We compare our hidden-state probe to mean tool-call-token entropy, negative mean tool-call-token log-probability, and self-consistency uncertainty. The paired tests highlight six significant differences after Holm correction. All of the tests involve Qwen2.5-14B- Instruct under the system-override condition, with all three scalar uncertainty metrics obtaining higher area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) and average precision (AP) than the hidden-state probe. These results suggest that benign-trained hidden-state probes should not be assumed to reliably detect operational tool-action errors under adversarial conditions.
title_cn: 良性训练的隐状态探针能在对抗条件下检测工具错误吗？
abstract_cn: 尽管隐状态探针能高效监控模型运行，但仅在良性工具使用上训练的探针在对抗条件下是否仍能检测错误动作仍不清楚。我们从操作性工具动作正确性的角度评估这一问题：使用四个 AgentDojo 套件、四种条件与三个模型（Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct 与 GLM-4.6V-Flash 9B），对每个模型做五折任务分组的折外（OOF）评估。我们仅在良性且无防御的轨迹上训练步级逻辑回归探针，并在良性、提示注入、系统覆盖与工具投毒四种条件的留出轨迹上评估。我们把隐状态探针与平均工具调用 token 熵、负平均工具调用 token 对数概率及自洽性不确定性比较。配对检验经 Holm 校正后凸显六处显著差异：全部涉及系统覆盖条件下的 Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct，且三种标量不确定性指标的 ROC AUC 与平均精度（AP）均高于隐状态探针。这些结果表明不应假设良性训练的隐状态探针能在对抗条件下可靠检测操作性工具动作错误。
summary_cn: 良性轨迹训练的隐状态探针在对抗条件下检测工具错误不可靠：Holm 校正后仅有的六处显著差异中，标量不确定性指标全部优于探针。
objective_summary: 在四套件 × 四条件 × 三模型上以折外评估对比隐状态探针与三类标量不确定性指标对工具动作错误的检测能力。
evidence_note: 五折任务分组 OOF + Holm 校正的配对检验；显著差异集中在单一模型/条件（Qwen2.5-14B 系统覆盖），泛化结论受限但设计严谨。
novelty_note: 诊断性负面结果：探针的对抗鲁棒性不应被假设；结论范围窄（显著结果集中于一个模型/条件），增量贡献。
scope: 步级逻辑回归探针与三类标量不确定性指标；三个开源模型、四种对抗条件之内。
limitations: 显著结果集中在单一模型与条件
仅逻辑回归探针族
AgentDojo 套件的工具多样性有限

title: Tracing MCP Security Vulnerabilities: Constructing and Analyzing an MCP Security Vulnerability Dataset
abstract: As a core protocol for integrating large language models (LLMs) with external data sources and tools, the Model Context Protocol (MCP) has quickly become a key interface in emerging AI agent systems. As the MCP ecosystem expands, reported vulnerabilities have also increased, creating a growing software-security attack surface. However, MCP vulnerability information remains scattered, noisy, and difficult to study systematically. This paper addresses that gap by constructing a curated MCP vulnerability dataset from CVE disclosures. Starting from 119 MCP-related records retrieved through February 2026, we filter unrelated cases out and obtain a validated snapshot of 24 MCP vulnerabilities. Our filtering methodology explicitly addresses acronym ambiguity and achieves 96.7% inter-rater agreement on a sampled exclusion audit while retaining all known high-severity MCP cases identified in public advisories. Using this initial dataset snapshot, we find that 87.5% of validated vulnerabilities are Critical or High severity, and that injection and path traversal vulnerabilities account for 66.7% of cases. We further identify recurring issues involving insufficient input validation, inadequate access control, and protocol-level security gaps. Through six representative case studies, we illustrate common exploitation patterns and map them to practical defenses. We release the dataset, reproducibility tooling, and a sustainable maintenance workflow as a foundation for future MCP security measurement, benchmarking, and defense research.

title_cn: 追踪 MCP 安全漏洞：MCP 安全漏洞数据集的构建与分析
abstract_cn: 作为把大语言模型（LLM）与外部数据源及工具集成的核心协议，模型上下文协议（MCP）已迅速成为新兴 AI 智能体系统的关键接口。随着 MCP 生态扩张，报告的漏洞也在增加，形成不断增长的软件安全攻击面。然而 MCP 漏洞信息仍然分散、嘈杂且难以系统研究。本文通过从 CVE 披露构建策展的 MCP 漏洞数据集来填补这一空白。从截至 2026 年 2 月检索到的 119 条 MCP 相关记录出发，我们过滤无关案例，得到 24 个 MCP 漏洞的验证快照。过滤方法明确处理缩写歧义，在抽样排除审计上达到 96.7% 的评分者间一致性，同时保留公开公告中已知的全部高严重性 MCP 案例。利用这一初始数据集快照，我们发现 87.5% 的已验证漏洞为 Critical 或 High 严重性，注入与路径遍历漏洞占 66.7%。我们进一步识别涉及输入验证不足、访问控制不当与协议级安全缺口的反复出现的问题。通过六个代表性案例研究，我们展示常见利用模式并将其映射到实用防御。我们发布数据集、可复现工具与可持续维护工作流，作为未来 MCP 安全测量、基准与防御研究的基础。IEEE SPW 2026 Data4SoftSec 发表。
summary_cn: 首个策展 MCP 漏洞数据集：119 条记录过滤为 24 个验证漏洞（排除审计一致性 96.7%），87.5% 为 Critical/High，注入与路径遍历占 66.7%。
objective_summary: 从 CVE 披露构建 MCP 漏洞策展数据集，量化严重性分布与漏洞类型构成，并以案例研究映射利用模式与防御。
evidence_note: 缩写歧义过滤方法明确、抽样排除审计一致性 96.7%、保留全部已知高严重案例；样本量小（24 条）且为快照；IEEE SPW 2026 研讨会发表。
novelty_note: 首个针对 MCP 漏洞的系统化数据集；对快速扩张协议的安全测量是及时贡献，规模尚小。
scope: MCP 生态的公开 CVE 披露；截至 2026 年 2 月的快照。
limitations: 仅 24 个验证漏洞
依赖 CVE 披露的滞后与完整性
协议外生态（非 MCP 工具）未覆盖

title: Beyond AUROC: Deployment-Aware Evaluation of Model-Internal Jailbreak Detectors
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in user-facing systems, where jailbreak attacks can bypass safety controls and induce harmful and policy-violating outputs. Recent model-internal detectors use hidden representations, gradients, or internal signals to identify such prompts, but their practical security value depends critically on behavior at low false-positive operating points rather than on area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) alone. We study two data dependencies that shape this behavior: calibration data, which determine the detection threshold, and reference data, which can influence detector scores. Across four model-internal detectors, four LLMs, and twelve jailbreak families, thresholds calibrated on curated benign prompts frequently fail to preserve their false-positive rate (FPR) budgets on real-user traffic. Recalibration improves false-positive control but reveals substantial family-level coverage gaps, including cases with high AUROC but low true-positive rate (TPR). Causal reference-set interventions show that changing reference composition can substantially alter family-level detection and that improving coverage of one attack family can reduce coverage of others. These findings show that calibration and reference data are part of a detector's security behavior. We therefore recommend evaluating model-internal jailbreak defenses using realized FPR on deployment-like traffic and per-family TPR at explicit low-FPR operating points, with AUROC used as a complementary ranking metric rather than the primary security measure.

title_cn: 超越 AUROC：模型内部越狱检测器的部署感知评估
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）日益部署于面向用户的系统，越狱攻击可绕过安全控制并诱发有害与违反政策的输出。近期模型内部检测器使用隐藏表示、梯度或内部信号识别此类提示，但其实际安全价值关键取决于低误报工作点上的行为，而非仅 ROC 曲线下面积（AUROC）。我们研究塑造这一行为的两类数据依赖：确定检测阈值的校准数据，以及可能影响检测器分数的参考数据。跨四个模型内部检测器、四个 LLM 与十二个越狱家族，在策展良性提示上校准的阈值经常无法在真实用户流量上保持其误报率（FPR）预算。重新校准改善误报控制但暴露大量家族级覆盖缺口，包括高 AUROC 但低真阳性率（TPR）的情形。因果参考集干预显示改变参考组成可显著改变家族级检测，且提升一个攻击家族的覆盖会降低其他家族的覆盖。这些发现表明校准与参考数据是检测器安全行为的一部分。我们因此建议在部署类流量上以实现的 FPR、以及在显式低 FPR 工作点上按家族的 TPR 评估模型内部越狱防御，AUROC 仅作辅助排序指标而非主要安全度量。IEEE BigData 2026 PSBD 研讨会录用。
summary_cn: 四检测器 × 四 LLM × 十二越狱族：策展数据校准的阈值在真实流量上常失守 FPR 预算；建议以实现 FPR + 按家族低 FPR TPR 评估，AUROC 仅辅助。
objective_summary: 系统研究模型内部越狱检测器的校准数据与参考数据两类依赖，量化低误报工作点上的覆盖缺口并提出部署感知评估建议。
evidence_note: 4 检测器 × 4 LLM × 12 家族的系统评估 + 因果参考集干预；研讨会录用（IEEE BigData 2026 PSBD）；无统计检验说明。
novelty_note: 把评估焦点从 AUROC 移到部署类低 FPR 工作点并量化校准/参考集依赖，是对检测器评估实践有诊断价值的修正。
scope: 模型内部越狱检测器（隐藏表示/梯度/内部信号）的安全评估；所测四检测器与十二越狱族之内。
limitations: 结论依赖所选检测器实现
部署类流量的代表性有限
参考集干预的长期漂移未追踪

title: PQC-Corpus: A Dataset of Linked Development Histories for Post-Quantum Cryptography
abstract: As post-quantum cryptography (PQC) standards evolve, developers must adapt implementations, tests, and protocols. Studying this work requires connecting code changes to problem reports and developer reviews. We present PQC-Corpus, a dataset of linked development histories from 179 public GitHub repositories, spanning cryptographic libraries and general-purpose projects. It connects issues and closing pull requests to commits and full patches, with comments and reviews. We combine Git histories with GitHub threads, reconstruct 23 pull-request commit lists truncated at 250 entries, and check file integrity, schemas, and links. Two annotators independently assessed sampled commits and issues ($\kappa=0.86$ and $0.93$), labeling about seven in ten commits and two in three issues PQC-related within these samples. We provide full and filtered views with removal ledgers, and quantify how filtering reduces links from issues to commits. A patch-free view supports inspection before downloading patches, while traversal scripts follow issues to code changes. We make the dataset and collector publicly available for studies of specification changes, hybrid interoperability, cryptographic review, and migration assistance.
title_cn: PQC-Corpus：后量子密码的关联开发史数据集
abstract_cn: 随着后量子密码（PQC）标准演化，开发者必须调整实现、测试与协议。研究这些工作需要把代码变更与问题报告、开发者评审连接起来。我们提出 PQC-Corpus，一个来自 179 个公开 GitHub 仓库的关联开发史数据集，涵盖密码库与通用项目。它把议题与关闭它们的 pull request 连接到提交与完整补丁，并附评论与评审。我们结合 Git 历史与 GitHub 讨论串，重构 23 个在 250 条目处截断的 PR 提交列表，并校验文件完整性、模式与链接。两名标注者独立评估抽样提交与议题（κ=0.86 与 0.93），在这些样本中约七成提交与三分之二议题被标为 PQC 相关。我们提供带移除账本的全量与过滤视图，并量化过滤如何减少议题到提交的链接。免补丁视图支持在下载补丁前检查，遍历脚本沿议题追踪到代码变更。我们把数据集与采集器公开，用于规范变更、混合互操作、密码评审与迁移辅助研究。
summary_cn: PQC-Corpus：179 个 GitHub 仓库的关联开发史（议题-PR-提交-补丁），双标注 κ=0.86/0.93，约七成抽样提交为 PQC 相关，附过滤账本与遍历脚本。
objective_summary: 构建连接问题报告、PR、提交与补丁的后量子密码开发史数据集，含完整性校验、双标注一致性与过滤视图。
evidence_note: 179 仓库、链接完整性校验、双标注 κ=0.86/0.93、截断重构与移除账本的可追溯设计；数据规模与质量保证均具体。
novelty_note: 首个面向 PQC 迁移研究的多仓库关联开发史语料；对规范变更/混合互操作等研究场景的支撑是新的。
scope: 公开 GitHub 仓库中的密码与 PQC 相关开发活动；抽样标注之外的全量标签未人工验证。
limitations: PQC 相关性标注仅抽样验证
PR 截断在 250 条目
GitHub 之外的开发渠道未覆盖

title: Interpretable Cyber-Physical Attack Detection in Smart Grids: A Leakage-Controlled Multi-Testbed Evaluation of Fusion, Robustness, and Observability Limits
abstract: Cyber-physical smart-grid detectors are typically treated as black boxes and validated exclusively on clean, temporally shuffled datasets, which risk overly optimistic performance claims. This work presents a multi-testbed evaluation study built around an interpretable, time-windowed fusion Random Forest, adopting the pessimistic result whenever evaluation protocols disagree. (i) On a public paired cyber-physical dataset, shuffled cross-validation is optimistic: macro-F1 falls from 0.96 to 0.88 +/- 0.06 under rolling-origin temporal evaluation. A topology-free graph convolutional network (GCN) serving as a control confirms that this lightweight model is competitive on these splits. (ii) The adaptive and adaptive-joint feature-space attacks, which are infeasible as realistic grid manipulations, degrade macro-F1 to 0.67 and 0.34, respectively. Adversarial training and randomized smoothing partially restore performance, and a physics-constrained evolution-strategy evasion on the IEEE 14-Bus testbed shows the same vulnerability pattern. (iii) On real IEC-104 traffic, the cyber view reliably catches structural attacks (recall of 0.87 to 0.98) but largely fails on semantic value manipulation (recall of 0.11 to 0.35). An observability taxonomy on the IEEE 14-Bus system reveals that stealthy false data injection defeats all three observation views. (iv) On a full AC weighted least-squares state-estimation testbed, a forecasting-aided temporal test is evaded by slow ramps precisely where a rate-invariant physics-manifold test sustains detection at a common 5% false-alarm target. A full end-to-end evaluation on IEEE 118-Bus confirms the ordering but bounds its strength: the manifold test detects every trial down to 0.05 degree/step and 0.48 at 0.02 degree/step, against 0.14 for the temporal test. All code and benchmarks are released.
title_cn: 智能电网网络-物理攻击的可解释检测：泄漏控制的多测试床融合、鲁棒性与可观测性极限评估
abstract_cn: 网络-物理智能电网检测器通常被视为黑盒并只在干净、时间打乱的数据集上验证，带来过于乐观的性能声明风险。本工作提出一个围绕可解释、时间窗融合随机森林的多测试床评估研究，在评估协议不一致时采纳悲观结果。(i) 在公开配对网络-物理数据集上，打乱交叉验证是乐观的：滚动起源时间评估下宏 F1 从 0.96 降至 0.88±0.06；作为对照的无拓扑图卷积网络（GCN）确认该轻量模型在这些划分上有竞争力。(ii) 作为现实电网操纵不可行的自适应与自适应联合特征空间攻击分别把宏 F1 降到 0.67 与 0.34；对抗训练与随机平滑部分恢复性能，IEEE 14-Bus 测试床上的物理约束进化策略规避显示相同脆弱模式。(iii) 在真实 IEC-104 流量上，网络视图可靠捕获结构性攻击（召回 0.87–0.98），但在语义值操纵上基本失败（召回 0.11–0.35）；IEEE 14-Bus 系统的可观测性分类显示隐蔽假数据注入击败全部三个观测视图。(iv) 在完整交流加权最小二乘状态估计测试床上，预测辅助时序检验被慢爬坡规避，而速率不变的物理流形检验在共同 5% 虚警目标下维持检测；IEEE 118-Bus 端到端评估确认该排序但限定其强度：流形检验对 0.05 度/步全检出、0.02 度/步检出 0.48，时序检验仅 0.14。全部代码与基准公开。
summary_cn: 泄漏控制的多测试床智能电网检测评估：时序评估宏 F1 0.96→0.88；真实 IEC-104 上结构性攻击召回 0.87–0.98 但语义操纵仅 0.11–0.35；物理流形检验对慢爬坡持续检出。
objective_summary: 以悲观协议优先的多测试床评估量化智能电网攻击检测的真实效能：时间泄漏控制、自适应攻击、真实 IEC-104 流量与可观测性极限分析。
evidence_note: 多测试床（公开数据集 + IEEE 14/118-Bus + 真实 IEC-104）、泄漏控制协议与悲观结果采纳、对抗训练对照与代码公开；置信区间以标准误差形式给出。
novelty_note: 评估方法学贡献（泄漏控制 + 悲观采纳）与可观测性分类是核心；物理流形检验对慢爬坡的鲁棒性为有用机制发现。
scope: 输电/配电网状态估计与流量检测场景；IEEE 14/118-Bus 与所选数据集之内。
limitations: 融合模型简单（随机森林）
真实 IEC-104 流量窗口有限
隐蔽 FDI 在三视图下均未被检测

title: Validating AI-Discovered Cloud Threats on Live Infrastructure: A Multi-Model, Multi-Cloud Study
abstract: Cloud infrastructure threat modeling lacks empirical validation of AI-discovered threats. We present a three-phase methodology of multi-agent threat discovery, automated exploit synthesis, and non-destructive live validation, and apply it to three commercial foundation models on two cloud architectures, validating each threat natively on the cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure) it was discovered against. Of 233 AI-discovered threats, 103 were confirmed and 34 refuted (75.2\% precision, 95\% CI [67.3, 81.7]); 44 were conditional (the named mechanism refuted but an equivalent impact shown through another path) and 52 indeterminate. Multi-model discovery helped through breadth, not agreement: the three models together found 2.2$\times$ the confirmed threats of the best single model at comparable precision, while threats reported by several models were confirmed no more often than single-model ones. False positives were not architecture-specific: they asserted access or system state the deployment did not have. Threats coded in advance as observable configuration resolved cleanly more often than multi-step behavioral threats (72.5\% vs.\ 51.6\%), which were more often conditional, suggesting that models more often misidentify the exploitation mechanism than the underlying weakness. AI-assisted discovery is a practical input to security workflows when paired with empirical validation.
title_cn: 在真实基础设施上验证 AI 发现的云威胁：多模型、多云研究
abstract_cn: 云基础设施威胁建模缺少对 AI 发现威胁的实证验证。我们提出三阶段方法论：多智能体威胁发现、自动利用合成与非破坏性在线验证，并将其应用于三个商业基础模型与两种云架构，把每个威胁在其被发现的原生云（AWS、GCP 或 Azure）上原生验证。在 233 个 AI 发现的威胁中，103 个被确认、34 个被反驳（精度 75.2%，95% CI [67.3, 81.7]）；44 个为条件性（所述机制被反驳但经另一路径展示了等效影响）、52 个不确定。多模型发现通过广度而非一致性起作用：三个模型合计发现的确认威胁是最佳单模型的 2.2 倍、精度相当，而由多个模型共同报告的威胁并不比单模型的更常被确认。误报不特定于架构：它们断言部署并不具备的访问或系统状态。预先编码为可观察配置的威胁比多步行为威胁更常被干净地确认（72.5% vs 51.6%）——后者更常为条件性，提示模型更常误判利用机制而非底层弱点。配合实证验证时，AI 辅助发现是安全工作流的实用输入。CSTA 2026。
summary_cn: 233 个 AI 发现云威胁的原生云实证验证：精度 75.2%（95% CI [67.3,81.7]）；三模型合计确认数为最佳单模型 2.2 倍，行为类威胁确认率仅 51.6%。
objective_summary: 以「多智能体发现→利用合成→非破坏性在线验证」三阶段方法论量化 AI 云威胁发现的真实有效性，并分析误报与条件性确认的成因结构。
evidence_note: 233 威胁 × 3 模型 × 2 云架构的原生验证，报告精度置信区间 [67.3, 81.7] 与分类确认结果；验证协议非破坏性、每条威胁独立核验。
novelty_note: 对 AI 发现威胁做系统性在线验证的研究较少；「广度而非一致性」「误判机制而非弱点」的发现有方法论价值。
scope: AWS/GCP/Azure 两云架构上的 AI 威胁发现验证；三个商业基础模型之内。
limitations: 云架构仅两种
52 个不确定结果留有解释空间
利用合成的深度未与人工红队对照

title: Agents of Chaos: A Systematization of Knowledge (SoK) on Malicious Attacks on Agentic AI Systems
abstract: Agentic AI systems extend large language models with tools, memory, retrieval, browser or computer-use interfaces, code execution, external services, and multi-agent coordination. Although these capabilities enable agents to act beyond text generation and perform tasks, they also create attack paths through which adversaries can exploit untrusted content, deceptive metadata, poisoned state, compromised skills, mutable dependencies, or malicious code. Such attacks can manipulate planning and tool use, corrupt memory, abuse code-execution environments, and trigger harmful downstream effects. In this paper, we present a systematic review of malicious attacks targeting agentic AI systems. We screened 186 candidate sources and retained 98. Following independent coding and resolver adjudication, we identified 284 atomic attacks, 452 atomic safeguards, and 660 explicit attack--safeguard relationships. We organize attacks into eight causal-mechanism classes while retaining insertion points, activation conditions, abused capabilities, objectives, impacts, persistence, and evidence as orthogonal dimensions. Our analysis shows that tool, MCP, and action-layer attacks account for the largest share of atomic attacks, while the prompt-injection and action-hijacking class has the broadest paper coverage. We identify distinct class-specific activation patterns and separation between insertion and later activation. Safeguard coverage remains uneven: only 278 of 660 relationships are directly assessed, and strong coverage is uncommon. These findings support lifecycle-aware threat modeling, agent evaluation, tool governance, and defense-in-depth security for agentic AI systems.
comment: Accepted at the Workshop on Agentic AI in Offensive and Defensive Cyber Operations (AIDC 2026), co-located with ACSAC 2026
title_cn: 混沌智能体：智能体 AI 系统恶意攻击的系统化知识（SoK）
abstract_cn: 智能体 AI 系统为大语言模型扩展了工具、记忆、检索、浏览器或计算机使用接口、代码执行、外部服务与多智能体协调。这些能力使智能体超越文本生成执行任务，但也创造攻击路径：对手可利用不可信内容、欺骗性元数据、被投毒状态、被入侵技能、可变依赖或恶意代码，操纵规划与工具使用、破坏记忆、滥用代码执行环境并触发有害下游效应。本文对针对智能体 AI 系统的恶意攻击做系统综述：筛选 186 个候选来源并保留 98 个；经独立编码与仲裁裁决，识别出 284 个原子攻击、452 个原子防御措施与 660 条显式攻击-防御关系。我们把攻击组织为八个因果机制类，同时把插入点、激活条件、被滥用能力、目标、影响、持久性与证据保留为正交维度。分析显示工具、MCP 与动作层攻击占原子攻击的最大份额，而提示注入与动作劫持类的论文覆盖最广。我们识别出类特有的激活模式以及插入与后续激活的分离。防御覆盖仍不均衡：660 条关系中仅 278 条被直接评估，强覆盖并不常见。这些发现支持面向智能体 AI 系统的生命周期感知威胁建模、智能体评估、工具治理与纵深防御。AIDC@ACSAC 2026 录用。
summary_cn: SoK 智能体 AI 攻击系统综述：98 源/284 原子攻击/452 防御/660 关系，八类因果机制组织；工具与 MCP 层攻击占比最大，仅 278 条关系被直接评估。
objective_summary: 系统综述智能体 AI 恶意攻击：按八类因果机制组织 284 个原子攻击并以正交维度刻画，量化攻击-防御关系的评估覆盖缺口。
evidence_note: 两阶段筛选（186→98 源）、独立编码与仲裁裁决的系统性方法学；284/452/660 的量化整理；AIDC@ACSAC 2026 研讨会录用。
novelty_note: 因果机制类组织 + 正交维度保留的分类法是对快速增长文献的系统化贡献；「仅 278/660 关系被直接评估」的覆盖缺口量化有指导价值。
