title_cn: CipherFlow：面向高效密码学安全推理的 AI 程序编译器
abstract_cn: 密码学安全推理面临两个实际挑战：让安全编程对 AI 开发者与数据科学家可及，以及在部署环境间实现高效执行。开发者必须正确组合密码学原语，而性能取决于硬件、网络与演化的密文状态。我们提出 CipherFlow，一个编译器框架：输入高层 AI 计算图、可用密码学原语与目标硬件及网络配置，生成可执行的、延迟优化的安全推理程序。CipherFlow 通过三项技术自动化密码学执行决策：MicroBench 剖析部署特定的原语成本；状态扩展规划在密码学状态约束下联合优化同态加密（HE）与安全多方计算（MPC）的放置、转换与密文维护；BlockFold 概括分支区域使规划可扩展到 Transformer 图。用实测 HE/MPC 后端成本在 CPU/GPU 与网络设置上的评估显示，与静态混合放置基线相比，BERT-base 上提速至 16.5 倍、ViT 上超过 22 倍。CipherFlow 把模型编程与密码学执行决策分离，使开发者能表达 AI 计算而由编译器构造高效安全程序。
summary_cn: 提出安全推理编译器 CipherFlow：MicroBench 剖析成本+状态扩展规划联合优化 HE/MPC 放置与密文维护+BlockFold 处理分支，BERT-base 提速至 16.5×、ViT 超 22×。
objective_summary: 构建把 AI 计算图编译为延迟优化安全推理程序的框架：成本剖析、密码学状态约束下的 HE/MPC 联合规划与分支概括三技术，并用实测后端成本评估多种模型与部署配置。
evidence_note: NeurIPS 2026 录用；基于实测 HE/MPC 后端成本的 CPU/GPU 与多网络设置评估，BERT-base/ViT 等模型对静态混合放置基线量化提速（16.5×/22×）；代码与交互式 demo 公开。
novelty_note: 把「密码学执行决策」（原语选择、放置、转换、密文维护）自动化为编译器规划问题并引入状态约束建模，是混合 HE/MPC 编译的系统化新组合。
scope: 结论适用于所支持的 AI 计算图（含 Transformer 分支结构）与被剖析的 HE/MPC 后端配置；对未经剖析的新后端与训练任务未覆盖。
limitations: 规划质量依赖 MicroBench 剖析的代表性；分支概括对极端分支密度可能退化；与更多端到端安全推理框架的对比有限。

title: J-Anchor: Defending Against Prefill Attacks via J-Space Selective Refusal Restoration
abstract: Prefill jailbreaks can cause safety-aligned language models to continue an unsafe assistant prefix even when they would refuse the same request under normal decoding. We study how the model's internal harmfulness and refusal signals evolve along this attacker-controlled trajectory. Using the Jacobian lens, we track vocabulary-grounded harmfulness and refusal signals from the assistant header through prefilling and subsequent generation. We identify a characteristic phenomenon, which we call refusal-state erosion: both the refusal signal and the harmfulness signal weaken as the prefill progresses, but the refusal signal progressively declines to the benign baseline by the end of the prefill, while the harmfulness signal remains above its benign baseline and detectable during subsequent generation. Motivated by this observation, we introduce J-Anchor, a training-free inference-time defense that uses the model's pre-attack harmfulness and refusal signals as a request-specific anchor and selectively restores weakened refusal in J-space during prefilling and decoding. J-Anchor substantially reduces attack success under both fixed and deep prefill attacks across different model families. J-Anchor largely preserves benign behavior and reasoning ability, and ablations highlight the importance of targeted restoration in the J-space refusal subspace. Our results suggest that preserving latent refusal dynamics offers a promising route to robust defense against prefill jailbreaks.
title_cn: J-Anchor：用 J 空间选择性拒绝恢复防御预填充攻击
abstract_cn: 预填充越狱能让安全对齐的语言模型继续不安全的助手前缀，即使在正常解码下它会拒绝同一请求。我们研究模型内部的有害性与拒绝信号如何沿这条攻击者控制的轨迹演化。用雅可比透镜，我们从助手头经预填充到后续生成追踪词汇表锚定的有害性与拒绝信号。我们识别出一个特征现象，称为拒绝状态侵蚀：随着预填充推进，拒绝信号与有害性信号都减弱，但拒绝信号在预填充结束时渐进降到良性基线，而有害性信号在后续生成期间保持高于良性基线且可检测。受该观察启发，我们提出 J-Anchor，一种免训练的推理时防御：用模型受攻击前的有害性与拒绝信号作为请求特定的锚，在预填充与解码期间选择性恢复 J 空间中被削弱的拒绝。J-Anchor 在不同模型家族的固定与深度预填充攻击下大幅降低攻击成功率，基本保持良性行为与推理能力，消融突出 J 空间拒绝子空间中定向恢复的重要性。结果表明保持潜在拒绝动态是抵御预填充越狱的可行路线。
summary_cn: 发现预填充过程中的「拒绝状态侵蚀」：拒绝信号在预填充末段降到良性基线而有害信号仍可检测；据此提出免训练防御 J-Anchor，在固定与深度预填充攻击下大幅降 ASR 且保持良性能力。
objective_summary: 用雅可比透镜刻画预填充越狱中有害/拒绝信号的演化并命名「拒绝状态侵蚀」，提出以攻击前信号为锚、在 J 空间选择性恢复拒绝的免训练防御并做消融。
evidence_note: 多模型家族、固定与深度两类预填充攻击的系统评估与消融，报告攻击成功率降低与良性保持；摘要未给具体数字，无统计检验；22 页 5 图。
novelty_note: 新机制组合：把拒绝状态侵蚀现象观察转化为「请求特定锚+J 空间选择性恢复」的推理时干预，区别于系统提示加固与输出过滤类防御。
scope: 结论适用于开放权重、可访问内部激活的 LLM 的预填充越狱防御；对闭源 API、多轮自适应攻击与预填充之外越狱路径未覆盖。
limitations: 需要白盒访问与 Jacobian 计算，部署成本未量化；对适应性攻击者绕过锚机制的鲁棒性未评估；恢复强度阈值调节依赖经验。

title: Bilinear Hulls for Support Splitting: Characterization, Optimization, and Applications
abstract: Sendrier's Support Splitting Algorithm (SSA) is the standard solver for the Permutation Equivalence Problem (PEP); its cost is dominated by a term that grows exponentially in the hull dimension. We study, mathematically, how much this cost can be lowered by replacing the standard inner product, on which the hull is defined, with an alternative bilinear form. Two structural results give a complete answer: only a narrow two-parameter family of bilinear forms produces a hull on which SSA can still operate, namely those whose matrix in the standard basis is a linear combination of the identity and the all-ones matrix; and even within this family the hull dimension drops by at most one (with the reduction achieved on every self-dual code whose length is coprime to the field characteristic). Together, these results give a tight upper bound: since SSA on a code with hull dimension $h$ has cost dominated by $q^h$, replacing the standard hull with $\mathrm{Hull}_M$ lowers this dominant term from $q^h$ to at best $q^{h-1}$, so no bilinear-form generalization of the inner product can reduce the SSA cost by more than a factor of $q$, the field size. Going beyond this requires invariants outside the bilinear framework. As an application, we verify that PEP-based SPECK admits the factor-$q$ cost reduction, while LEP-based LESS and PKP-based PERK lie outside our framework. A SageMath implementation of the bilinear-hull preprocessing confirms feasibility at SPECK's recommended length $n = 252$.
comment: 25 pages. Accepted to SAC 2026; to appear in Lecture Notes in Computer Science (Springer). Author's accepted manuscript
title_cn: 支持分裂算法的双线性壳：刻画、优化与应用
abstract_cn: Sendrier 的支持分裂算法（SSA）是置换等价问题（PEP）的标准求解器，其成本由一个随壳维度指数增长的项主导。我们从数学上研究：用替代双线性形式替换定义壳的标准内积，能把这个成本降低多少。两个结构性结果给出完整回答：只有狭窄的两参数族双线性形式能产生 SSA 仍可操作的壳——其标准基下矩阵为单位阵与全一阵的线性组合；且即使在该族内，壳维度至多降 1（该缩减在每个长度与域特征互素的自对偶码上取得）。合起来，这些结果给出紧的上界：由于壳维度 h 的码上 SSA 成本由 q^h 主导，用 Hull_M 替换标准壳至多把主导项从 q^h 降到 q^{h-1}，因此任何双线性形式泛化都不能把 SSA 成本降低超过域大小 q 的因子。超越这一点需要双线性框架之外的不变量。作为应用，我们验证基于 PEP 的 SPECK 享有该 q 因子成本缩减，而基于 LEP 的 LESS 与基于 PKP 的 PERK 在框架之外。双线性壳预处理的 SageMath 实现确认了在 SPECK 推荐长度 n=252 下的可行性。
summary_cn: 完整刻画可用于支持分裂算法的双线性壳：仅「单位阵+全1阵」两参数族有效且壳维至多降 1，SSA 成本 q^h 至多降到 q^{h-1}；验证 SPECK 享该因子，LESS/PERK 在框架外。
objective_summary: 数学刻画用双线性形式泛化内积时 SSA 壳的结构：给出可用形式的两参数族刻画与维数缩减上界，并以 SPECK/LESS/PERK 三个方案验证理论边界，附 SageMath 预处理实现。
evidence_note: 完整的结构刻画与紧界证明（SAC 2026 录用、Springer LNCS），并有 SageMath 实现确认 SPECK 推荐参数下可行；为分析性结果、无实验统计。
novelty_note: 给出「双线性泛化最多省因子 q」的紧上界并完整分类可用形式：对该方向的优化空间给出定论式回答，兼具否定性（LESS/PERK 需框架外不变量）与构造性（SPECK 可行）结论。
scope: 结论适用于基于置换等价/支持分裂攻击面的编码方案（如签名与身份识别）安全分析；对壳攻击的双线性框架之外路线未覆盖。
limitations: 仅覆盖双线性形式族；维数缩减取得的条件（自对偶码、长度与特征互素）有前提；对非交换或更一般形式的推广未讨论。

title: When Benign Is Unverified: Label-Signal Mismatch and Abstention-First Triage in Graph-Based Memory Forensics
abstract: Machine-learning triage for memory forensics is usually validated on corpora whose benign class is asserted by provenance and never verified. We report a validation study of a graph-based triage pipeline for Windows memory images: Volatility 3 output is compiled into typed heterogeneous graphs and scored by a temperature-scaled GINE classifier and two one-class encoders, fused with rule risk under an abstention gate. On MalVol-25 a transparent rule layer contradicts the benign label on every control (15/15 and 18/18 flagged; at least 11 of 15 paired controls rated HIGH or CRITICAL), and mean injection and command-and-control counts run higher on controls than on infected captures. We call this rule-label discordance label-signal mismatch; it shows the benign class is unverified, not compromised. Leave-one-family-out AUROC over matched pairs is provably three-valued, so a reported mean and standard deviation identify the fold composition. The learned model (0.786 +- 0.311; 9/4/1, scored in-sample by a frozen checkpoint) equals a logistic model over rule-derived attributes (0.786 +- 0.410; 11/0/3) in mean only, and its significance rests on dropping four saturated ties. The fusion path sends 97.7% of snapshots to analyst review, 95.3% with every gate disabled. Two public feature-level corpora show the same defect: on CIC-MalMem-2022 every benign row carries injected regions and one host-population feature reaches AUROC 0.997 under leave-one-family-out validation; on the Sihwail et al. (2021) sample the injection indicator fires on 53% of benign rows. We close with seven reporting artefacts for learned triage on corpora whose ground truth is asserted.
title_cn: 当良性未被核实：基于图内存取证的标签-信号失配与先弃权分诊
abstract_cn: 面向内存取证的机器学习分诊通常在良性类仅由来源断言、从未被核实的语料上验证。我们报告对 Windows 内存镜像图分诊管线的验证研究：Volatility 3 输出被编译为类型化异构图，由温度缩放的 GINE 分类器与两个单类编码器评分，并在弃权门下与规则风险融合。在 MalVol-25 上，透明规则层在每个对照上都与良性标签矛盾（15/15 与 18/18 被标记；至少 11/15 配对对照被评为 HIGH 或 CRITICAL），且对照样本的平均注入与命令控制计数高于感染样本。我们把这种规则-标签失谐称为标签-信号失配：它表明良性类是未核实的，而非被破坏。匹配对的留族 AUROC 可证明只有三个取值，因此报告的均值与标准差足以识别折的构成。学习模型（0.786 ± 0.311；9/4/1，由冻结检查点在样本内评分）仅在均值上等于规则属性的逻辑模型（0.786 ± 0.410；11/0/3），其显著性依赖丢弃四个饱和平局。融合路径把 97.7% 的快照送交分析师复查（全部门禁禁用时为 95.3%）。两个公开特征级语料显示同样缺陷：CIC-MalMem-2022 的每个良性行都携带注入区域，一个宿主总体特征在留族验证下达 AUROC 0.997；在 Sihwail 等（2021）样本上注入指标在 53% 的良性行触发。我们以七项针对「真值仅为断言」语料的学习分诊报告规范收尾。
summary_cn: 验证研究揭示内存取证 ML 语料的「标签-信号失配」：MalVol-25 规则层标记全部对照（15/15、18/18），CIC-MalMem-2022 良性行均含注入区域（单特征 LOAO AUROC 0.997），良性类只是未核实。
objective_summary: 对图基内存取证分诊管线做验证研究，用透明规则层核查「良性」标签的可靠性，量化规则-标签失配并审计两个公开语料的注入残留，提出先弃权分诊与七项报告规范。
evidence_note: 多个语料交叉验证（MalVol-25、CIC-MalMem-2022、Sihwail 2021），对照实验、配对统计与 AUROC 数值完整，对三值 AUROC 的性质给出形式化说明；结论为诊断性而非方法性能提升。
novelty_note: 命名并系统记录「标签-信号失配」这一内存取证 ML 评估的结构性缺陷：既有基准的良性类由来源断言而非核实，附七项报告规范具有方法学价值。
scope: 结论适用于以「来源断言良性」为真值的内存/恶意软件分诊基准评估；对经人工核实的良性语料与非 Windows 平台未覆盖。
limitations: 规则层自身覆盖有限，可能误标真正良性样本；验证依赖规则与注入指标这两个代理信号；弃权机制的实际工作量影响未量化。

title: Optimal Conversion from Zero-Concentrated to Gaussian Differential Privacy
abstract: Gaussian differential privacy (GDP) and zero-concentrated differential privacy (zCDP) are two competing privacy accounting frameworks, but they share similar minimax lower bounds in various estimation problems. Moreover, it is known that a mechanism satisfying $\mu$-GDP satisfies $(\mu^2/2)$-zCDP, whereas the converse fails to hold at the same calibration. In this paper, we establish the optimal reverse conversion, showing that every $\rho$-zCDP mechanism satisfies $\mu_{\mathrm{zCDP}}(\rho)$-GDP, where $\mu_{\mathrm{zCDP}}(\rho)=2\Phi^{-1}((1+e^{-t_\rho})^{-1})$ and $t_\rho$ uniquely solves the equation $\rho=t_\rho\tanh(t_\rho/2)$. We also obtain simplified bounds $\sqrt{\pi\rho}\leq\mu_{\mathrm{zCDP}}(\rho)\leq\sqrt{8\rho}$, with sharp constants, which imply equivalence of the two frameworks up to constants. This explains why their minimax risks agree up to a constant rescaling of the privacy budget. We show that the squared conversion is strictly convex, which implies that converting zCDP to GDP before applying composition or group privacy yields a tighter GDP guarantee than converting afterward. We also derive the sharp conversion from bounded-range and logistic DP mechanisms (e.g., exponential mechanism) to GDP, where converting before composition but after group privacy gives the tighter guarantee.
title_cn: 从零集中差分隐私到高斯差分隐私的最优转换
abstract_cn: 高斯差分隐私（GDP）与零集中差分隐私（zCDP）是两个相互竞争的隐私记账框架，但它们在多种估计问题上共享相近的极小极大下界。已知 μ-GDP 机制满足 (μ²/2)-zCDP，而反向在同一校准下不成立。本文建立最优的反向转换：每个 ρ-zCDP 机制满足 μ_zCDP(ρ)-GDP，其中 μ_zCDP(ρ)=2Φ⁻¹((1+e^{-t_ρ})⁻¹)，t_ρ 是方程 ρ=t·tanh(t/2) 的唯一解。我们还得到简化界 √(πρ) ≤ μ_zCDP(ρ) ≤ √(8ρ)，常数是尖锐的，意味着两个框架至常数等价。这解释了为何它们的极小极大风险在隐私预算常数重缩放下一致。我们证明平方转换严格凸，意味着在组合或群隐私之前先做 zCDP→GDP 转换比之后转换得到更紧的 GDP 保证。我们还推导了有界范围与 logistic DP 机制（如指数机制）到 GDP 的尖锐转换，其中在组合之前、群隐私之后转换给出最紧保证。
summary_cn: 建立最优 ρ-zCDP→μ-GDP 转换（μ=2Φ⁻¹((1+e^{-t})⁻¹)、ρ=t·tanh(t/2)），给出 √(πρ)≤μ≤√(8ρ) 紧界，解释两框架极小极大风险至常数等价，并证明先转换再组合更紧。
objective_summary: 刻画 zCDP 与 GDP 之间的最优反向转换函数及其尖锐常数界，证明转换凸性并据此给出组合/群隐私顺序的最优使用建议。
evidence_note: 给出显式最优转换（隐式定义+简化闭式界）、凸性与顺序建议等完整分析性结果；为纯理论工作，结论的最优性声明未附数值实验，按证明完整性计 3。
novelty_note: 补上 zCDP→GDP 方向长期缺失的最优转换：定量解释两框架极小极大风险等价之谜，并把「先转换再组合」从经验规则变为严格结论。
scope: 结论适用于 zCDP/GDP 框架下的机制隐私记账与组合分析；对 f-DP 全谱、非凸损失或其他隐私定义的推广未覆盖。
limitations: 最优转换以隐式方程定义，使用需数值求解；对有界范围/logistic 机制的转换依赖相应假设；未讨论计算层面的影响。

title: A Large-Scale Evaluation of Cookie Notice Privacy and Accessibility for Blind and Low Vision Users
abstract: We present the first large-scale privacy and accessibility evaluation of cookie notices across 2,061 domains for blind and low vision (BLV) users. Using a Playwright-based crawler, a custom NVDA screen reader add-on, and the Lighthouse and WAVE accessibility tools, we measure UK GDPR/PECR compliance, tracker activity across pre-interaction, post-accept, and post-reject phases, and cookie notice accessibility for screen reader users. We find that 51 % of sites display a cookie notice, of which (at least) 50 % violate UK GDPR/PECR requirements. Accepting a notice produces a mean five-fold increase in tracker activity, and degrades page landmark structure on one in five sites. While 95 % of notices are readable by a screen reader, only 37 % carry a meaningful title, 39 % are announced immediately on page load, and 42 % use descriptive button labels. We reveal a systemic correlation: cookie notices failing legal privacy requirements disproportionately exhibit the weakest screen reader accessibility. This compounding privacy burden on BLV users demands urgent intervention from developers, regulators, and standards bodies.
title_cn: 面向盲人与低视力用户的大规模 Cookie 通知隐私与无障碍评估
abstract_cn: 我们对 2,061 个域名的 Cookie 通知进行首个大规模隐私与无障碍评估，面向盲人与低视力（BLV）用户。使用基于 Playwright 的爬虫、定制 NVDA 读屏插件以及 Lighthouse 与 WAVE 无障碍工具，我们测量 UK GDPR/PECR 合规性、交互前/接受后/拒绝后三阶段的追踪器活动，以及 Cookie 通知对读屏用户的可访问性。我们发现 51% 的站点显示 Cookie 通知，其中（至少）50% 违反 UK GDPR/PECR 要求。接受通知使追踪器活动平均增加五倍，并在五分之一的站点上破坏页面地标结构。虽然 95% 的通知可被读屏器朗读，但仅 37% 带有有意义的标题、39% 在页面加载时立即播报、42% 使用描述性按钮标签。我们揭示一个系统性关联：未通过法律隐私要求的 Cookie 通知在读屏无障碍性上也最弱。这种叠加在 BLV 用户身上的隐私负担需要开发者、监管者与标准机构的紧急干预。
summary_cn: 对 2,061 个域名做首个 Cookie 通知隐私-无障碍联合评估：51% 弹通知、其中至少 50% 违反 UK GDPR/PECR，接受后追踪活动平均增五倍，且违法通知的读屏无障碍性系统性更差。
objective_summary: 用定制爬虫+读屏插件+无障碍工具测量 2,061 个域名 Cookie 通知的合规性、三阶段追踪活动与读屏可访问性，并分析合规性与无障碍性的相关结构。
evidence_note: 首个该主题大规模评估（2,061 域名），多工具交叉测量（Playwright+NVDA 插件+Lighthouse/WAVE），覆盖三阶段追踪行为并给出具体合规/无障碍比例与相关结论。
novelty_note: 首次把隐私合规与读屏无障碍联合测量：揭示「违规通知普遍无障碍性更差」的系统性叠加负担，为既有 Cookie 通知测量研究补充残障用户视角。
scope: 结论适用于英国法域（UK GDPR/PECR）的 Cookie 通知与英文站点生态；对其他法域、移动端通知横幅与 BLV 用户的真实交互行为（用户研究）未覆盖。
limitations: 自动化测量无法完全代替真实读屏用户测试；合规判定依赖规则化检查；追踪器识别依赖既有列表。

title: SHield: Watermarking 4D Gaussian Splatting via Spherical Harmonic Coefficient Perturbation
abstract: 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) models are computationally expensive to train but distributed as easily copied parameter files. Existing watermarks protect these assets by fine-tuning the scene against a neural decoder to extract bit strings from rendered video, a heavy process vulnerable to the temporal dynamics of dynamic scenes. However, if the threat model targets the redistributed file itself, verification can be vastly simplified. Because the canonical Spherical-Harmonic (SH) coefficients of 4DGS are time- and view-invariant, parameter-space perturbations can be recovered via deterministic arithmetic. We propose **SHield**, the first non-blind, decoder-free watermarking approach that natively embeds full-resolution RGB images into 4DGS files. SHield tiles a zero-mean payload across the SH coefficients of a key-selected Gaussian subset, applying a brief anchored optimization to preserve visual fidelity. To verify ownership, it geometrically re-associates the key using canonical Gaussian centres to survive file tampering and recovers the payload in closed form. Across 30 scenes (D-NeRF, HyperNeRF, DyNeRF), SHield guarantees near-perfect payload recovery (Pearson $r \geq 0.991$) on all 150 tested models with a mean rendering penalty of $\leq 0.13$~dB. Held-out evaluation yields perfect detection on 400 true trials and zero false positives across $1{,}600$ wrong-subset null trials. We also strictly bound the method's robustness: SHield survives INT8 quantization and $30\%$ opacity pruning for the image payload, and on aggressive SH-degree-1 truncation bit payloads are still decodable.
title_cn: SHield：通过球谐系数扰动为 4D 高斯泼溅加水印
abstract_cn: 4D 高斯泼溅（4DGS）模型训练成本高，却以易复制的参数文件分发。现有水印通过把场景针对神经解码器微调、从渲染视频提取比特串来保护这些资产，过程繁重且易受动态场景时序影响。然而若威胁模型针对再分发的文件本身，验证可以大幅简化。由于 4DGS 的规范球谐（SH）系数具有时间与视角不变性，参数空间扰动可通过确定性算术恢复。我们提出 SHield，首个非盲、无解码器的 4DGS 水印方法，原生地把全分辨率 RGB 图像嵌入 4DGS 文件。SHield 把零均值载荷平铺到关键选中的高斯子集的 SH 系数上，用短暂的锚定优化保持视觉保真度；验证所有权时，利用规范高斯中心做几何重关联以在文件篡改后幸存，并以闭式形式恢复载荷。跨 30 个场景（D-NeRF、HyperNeRF、DyNeRF），SHield 在全部 150 个测试模型上保证近完美载荷恢复（Pearson r ≥ 0.991），平均渲染惩罚 ≤0.13 dB。留出评估在 400 个真试验中完美检测，并在 1,600 个错误子集空试验中零误报。我们还严格界定了方法的鲁棒性：图像载荷可幸存 INT8 量化与 30% 不透明度剪枝；激进 SH 一阶截断下比特载荷仍可解码。
summary_cn: 提出 SHield：首个非盲无解码器 4DGS 参数空间水印，把全分辨率 RGB 嵌入球谐系数并闭式恢复；30 场景 150 模型 r≥0.991、渲染损失 ≤0.13dB，扛 INT8 量化与 30% 剪枝。
objective_summary: 针对 4DGS 文件再分发的所有权验证设计参数空间水印：零均值载荷平铺进关键高斯的球谐系数，闭式恢复并做几何重关联抗篡改，量化恢复精度、渲染损失与鲁棒边界。
evidence_note: 30 个公开场景、150 个模型、400 真试验+1,600 空试验零误报、量化渲染惩罚与鲁棒边界（INT8、30% 剪枝、SH 截断）；评估系统但未与现有水印基线直接对比、无统计检验。
novelty_note: 首个非盲、无解码器、把全分辨率图像直接嵌入 4DGS 参数的水印：利用 SH 系数的时空不变性把繁重的神经解码验证简化为闭式算术，属该方向首个端到端方案。
scope: 结论适用于 4DGS 参数文件的确定性所有权验证（非盲设定，验证者持有密钥）；对盲检测、白屏/重渲染等强攻击与再训练蒸馏未覆盖。
limitations: 非盲假设限制了使用场景；鲁棒性严格限于所述扰动（量化/剪枝/截断），对更强的几何或时序攻击不保证；锚定优化对视觉质量的长期影响未评估。

title: Enhancing Edge AI System Security with a Stacked Hardware Security Controller for Robust and Energy-Efficient Anomaly Detectio
abstract: In recent years, the growing adoption of Edge AI systems has been accompanied by a surge in security threats. Edge AI deployments face an rapidly evolving spectrum of security threats, from side-channel information leakage to ad- versarial model manipulation and physical device tampering. Conventional security mechanisms such as malware scanners and resource-intensive firewall solutions are unsuitable due to edge AIs typically limited computational resources, strict energy budgets and thermal constraints especially in battery-powered and field-deployed environments. This paper proposes a stacked, hardware-based security mechanism that enables low-overhead, continuous detection of anomalous execution patterns. Anomaly detection utilizing hard- ware performance counters and physical sensors outperforms software-based alternatives by providing key capabilities such as tamper-resistant root-of-trust isolation, negligible runtime overhead, and resilience against compromised operating systems. Experimental analysis shows that adversarial or malicious ap- plications produce observable deviations in sensor and thermal readings on Edge AI systems and hardware-based anomaly detection provides effective and low-overhead anomaly detection.
title_cn: 用堆叠式硬件安全控制器增强边缘 AI 系统安全的鲁棒高能效异常检测
abstract_cn: 近年来边缘 AI 系统的普及伴随着安全威胁的激增。边缘 AI 部署面临快速演化的威胁谱：从侧信道信息泄漏到对抗性模型操纵与物理设备篡改。恶意软件扫描器与资源密集型防火墙等传统安全机制因边缘 AI 有限的计算资源、严格的能耗与散热约束（尤其是电池供电与野外部署环境）而不适用。本文提出一种堆叠式、基于硬件的安全机制，实现对异常执行模式的低开销持续检测。利用硬件性能计数器与物理传感器的异常检测，在防篡改信任根隔离、可忽略运行时开销与对被攻破操作系统的韧性方面优于软件方案。实验分析显示，对抗性或恶意应用在边缘 AI 系统的传感器与热学读数上产生可观测偏差，且基于硬件的异常检测提供有效且低开销的异常检测。
summary_cn: 提出边缘 AI 上的堆叠式硬件安全机制：以性能计数器+物理/热传感器做低开销持续异常检测，提供防篡改信任根与抗系统失陷能力，实验显示恶意应用产生可观测传感偏差。
objective_summary: 设计堆叠式硬件安全控制器，用性能计数器与物理/热传感器做运行时异常执行检测，并实验观察对抗/恶意应用在传感读数上的偏差。
evidence_note: 摘要只给出定性实验结论（「可观测偏差」「有效且低开销」），无具体检测率、开销数字、攻击类型规模或数据集；IEEE 3DIC 会议论文。
novelty_note: 性能计数器+传感器异常检测为已确立思路，本文贡献在堆叠集成与边缘 AI 场景的低开销工程化，属增量改进。
scope: 结论适用于资源受限边缘 AI 设备的运行时异常检测场景；对具体攻击覆盖面、检测阈值设定与误报率未量化。
limitations: 无定量检测性能数据；传感器读数偏差可能受环境噪声干扰；堆叠集成对成本与散热的影响未报告。

title: Side-Channel Attack Prevention for Post Quantum Cryptography Algorithms: A 3D-Shield Approach
abstract: Despite their theoretical quantum attack resistance, practical implementations of post-quantum cryptography (PQC) algorithms remain susceptible to side-channel attacks. This includes all standard algorithms selected the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) such as Kyber/ML-KEM, Dilithium/ML-DSA, Falcon/FN-DSA and SPHINCS+/SLH-DSA. This paper proposes an alternative defense for side-channel resilience based on 3D integration that uses 3D hardware to shield the underlying cryptographic activity by introducing decoy keys and physical shielding through stacking. The proposed approach can complement other security measures (such as masking and shuffling) on protecting Number Theoretic Transform (NTT) that move computation to dedicated NTT chips. We outline the construction of our approach and validate the effectiveness on a generic attack targeting intermediate computation inside an NTT butterfly.
title_cn: 后量子密码算法的侧信道攻击防护：3D-Shield 方法
abstract_cn: 尽管后量子密码（PQC）算法在理论上抗量子攻击，但其实际实现仍然易受侧信道攻击，包括 NIST 选定的全部标准算法：Kyber/ML-KEM、Dilithium/ML-DSA、Falcon/FN-DSA 与 SPHINCS+/SLH-DSA。本文提出一种基于 3D 集成的侧信道韧性替代防御：利用 3D 硬件通过引入诱饵密钥与堆叠物理屏蔽来保护底层密码活动。该方法可与掩码、乱序等其他安全措施互补，保护迁移到专用 NTT 芯片上的数论变换（NTT）计算。我们概述方法的构造，并针对一个瞄准 NTT 蝶形运算内部计算的通用攻击验证其有效性。
summary_cn: 提出基于 3D 集成的 PQC 侧信道防护 3D-Shield：以诱饵密钥+物理堆叠屏蔽保护迁移到专用 NTT 芯片的计算，可与掩码/乱序互补，并针对 NTT 蝶形通用攻击做了验证。
objective_summary: 提出用 3D 堆叠硬件（诱饵密钥+物理屏蔽+专用 NTT 芯片）防护 PQC 实现侧信道的架构方案，并针对 NTT 蝶形内部计算的通用攻击验证有效性。
evidence_note: 以构造概述+单一通用攻击场景验证为主（IEEE 3DIC 会议论文），未给出量化攻击成功率对比、多种攻击模型或完整实现开销评估。
novelty_note: 把 3D 集成（物理堆叠屏蔽+诱饵密钥）作为 PQC 侧信道防御的替代路线是与掩码/乱序正交的新组合；对专用 NTT 硬件化的安全论证有新意。
scope: 结论适用于 PQC（NTT 类算法为主）实现的硬件级侧信道防护架构设计；对具体工艺可行性、成本与自适应攻击的鲁棒性未覆盖。
limitations: 验证仅针对单一通用攻击与 NTT 蝶形场景；诱饵密钥机制对高阶攻击（如统计区分诱饵与真值）的抵抗力未分析；无完整芯片实现。

title: What Must Be Done Here? Using a Bounded Application-Security Ontology at the Point of Change
abstract: The security guidance that bears on code is real but scattered. It lives across secure-development frameworks, verification standards, controls catalogues, threat taxonomies, and, increasingly, normative regimes such as the EU's NIS2 -- and most of it is written for readers other than the engineer, or the AI assistant, at a point of change. Existing cybersecurity ontologies largely model attacks, indicators, and risk for detection and analysis, not the engineering-practice substance one must act on. This paper presents a use case for an existing bounded application-security ontology, AppSec Core, whose construction and validation are reported separately. We show how it is used. It makes the engineering-actionable fraction of those authorities addressable as a typed working set: the control objectives that apply, the practices that realize them, the mechanisms that implement them, and the evidence artifacts they expect, each traceable to the sources that justify it. We reach that working set from two entry points that recur in practice. Forward, from a code change: a change to authentication middleware scopes to its governing domain slice and returns the obligations the change must satisfy. Inverse, from a normative obligation: "make this NIS2-compliant" resolves a generic legal duty into the concrete engineering obligations it implies across slices, surfacing precisely the fraction of a mostly-governance regulation that lands in code. The same working set is what a human engineer reads and what an LLM-grounded assistant is handed as grounding. The use turns "read every applicable authority" into "satisfy this typed working set", for a code change or a compliance duty alike. The contribution is the demonstrated use; the artefact, its validation, and its governance are companion work.
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at Semantic Shields 3: the 3rd International Workshop on Modeling for Cybersecurity, co-located with JOWO 2026 / FOIS 2026, Vitória, Brazil, September 2026. To appear in the JOWO 2026 proceedings (CEUR-WS)
title_cn: 这里必须做什么？在变更点使用有界应用安全本体
abstract_cn: 与代码相关的安全指导是真实存在的，但高度分散。它散布在安全开发框架、验证标准、控制目录、威胁分类体系，以及日益增多的规范制度（如欧盟 NIS2）之中，且大多写给工程师或变更点上的 AI 助手以外的读者。现有网络安全本体主要建模攻击、指标与风险，用于检测与分析，而非可据以行动的工程实践内容。本文展示既有有界应用安全本体 AppSec Core 的用例，其构建与验证另行报告。我们展示它如何被使用：它把这些权威文件中可工程执行的部分变成一个类型化的工作集——适用的控制目标、实现它们的实践、落实它们的机制以及它们期望的证据工件，每一项都可追溯到支持它的来源。我们用两个实践中反复出现的入口到达该工作集。正向，从代码变更出发：对认证中间件的变更划定其所属领域切片并返回该变更必须满足的义务。反向，从规范义务出发：「让这里符合 NIS2」把通用法律义务解析为跨切片的具体工程义务，精确呈现一部以治理为主的法规中落入代码的部分。同一个工作集既是人类工程师阅读的内容，也是交给基于 LLM 的助手作为接地材料的内容。这种用法把「读完所有适用权威文件」变成「满足这个类型化工作集」，对代码变更与合规义务都成立。贡献在于所演示的用法；工件、其验证与治理是配套工作。
summary_cn: 演示 AppSec Core 本体的用法：从代码变更或 NIS2 义务解析出类型化的工程义务工作集（控制目标-实践-机制-证据），供工程师与 LLM 助手共同使用。
objective_summary: 展示应用安全本体 AppSec Core 的两个使用入口（代码变更正向、规范义务反向）如何产出可追溯的类型化义务工作集，供人类工程师与 LLM 助手使用；本体本身与验证为配套工作。
evidence_note: 以两个用例（认证中间件变更、NIS2 义务解析）演示可行性，无定量评估；本体构建与验证明确声明为配套论文；workshop 论文（JOWO 2026/FOIS 2026）。
novelty_note: 贡献是用例演示而非新本体或新方法：把既有本体用于「变更点义务解析」属工程实践组织方式的应用展示。
scope: 结论适用于应用安全知识与合规义务到工程义务的映射使用场景；本体覆盖面与映射质量取决于配套工作的验证结果。
limitations: 无量化评估（未测映射覆盖率/准确率）；依赖配套本体的成熟度；对动态演进的法规更新维护未讨论。

title: The Blind Spots of Detection: Adversarial Perturbation Attacks against Watchdogs in Distributed LLM Inference
abstract: Decentralizing large language model (LLM) inference across untrusted Web nodes requires robust verification to ensure computational integrity. Existing activation-based verification and detection mechanisms validate intermediate outputs against reference values, permitting bounded numerical deviations to accommodate benign cross-hardware discrepancies. However, a critical security question remains: what can a malicious worker achieve while operating within these tolerance bounds? In this work, we introduce Hush-Up, a stealthy availability attack against distributed LLM inference, where a single malicious worker halts generation while evading attribution. The attacker first profiles its local execution to model an empirical bound of benign hardware errors. Using this error bound as a feasibility constraint, the attacker optimizes an adversarial perturbation on its output activations to maximize the final-layer probability of the end-of-sequence (EOS) token, i.e., to hush up the model. Across diverse models and benchmarks, Hush-Up effectively forces premature generation termination and collapses model capabilities. Furthermore, the attack hushes up the watchdogs themselves: existing defenses often fail to detect the sabotage entirely or falsely attribute the amplified downstream anomalies to honest workers. Our findings expose a fundamental gap between local numerical verification and end-to-end accountability: perturbations too small to indict a worker locally can nevertheless be powerful enough to break distributed inference globally.
title_cn: 检测的盲区：针对分布式 LLM 推理看门狗的对抗扰动攻击
abstract_cn: 把大语言模型（LLM）推理去中心化到不受信的 Web 节点需要稳健的验证以保证计算完整性。现有的基于激活的验证与检测机制把中间输出与参考值比对，允许有界的数值偏差以容纳良性的跨硬件差异。然而一个关键安全问题仍然存在：恶意工作节点在容忍界内能达成什么？我们提出 Hush-Up，一种针对分布式 LLM 推理的隐蔽可用性攻击：单个恶意工作节点使生成停止，同时逃避归因。攻击者先剖析本地执行以建模良性硬件误差的经验界；再以该误差界为可行性约束，对输出激活优化对抗扰动，最大化最终层序列结束（EOS）词元概率，即让模型「闭嘴」。跨多样模型与基准，Hush-Up 有效迫使生成提前终止并使模型能力崩溃。攻击还会让看门狗本身失明：现有防御常常完全无法检测破坏，或把放大的下游异常错误归因于诚实节点。我们的发现暴露了局部数值验证与端到端问责之间的根本缺口：小到不足以在局部定罪某个节点的扰动，却足以在全球范围内破坏分布式推理。
summary_cn: 提出 Hush-Up 隐蔽可用性攻击：恶意推理节点以良性硬件误差界为约束优化激活、放大 EOS 概率使生成提前终止，且能躲过看门狗并把异常归咎于诚实节点。
objective_summary: 提出在激活容忍界内约束优化的隐蔽攻击 Hush-Up：以误差界为可行性约束放大 EOS 概率终止生成，并系统评估其对基于激活的看门狗与异常归因的逃逸能力。
evidence_note: 跨多样模型与基准的实验证实生成提前终止与能力崩溃，并展示现有防御的检测失败/错误归因；无统计检验与真实去中心化网络部署。
novelty_note: 新攻击面：利用验证机制自身的容忍界作为攻击可行性约束（「在界内作恶」），并揭示局部数值验证与全局问责的结构性缺口，区别于既有拜占庭/投毒攻击设定。
scope: 结论适用于基于激活参考值+数值容忍界的分布式 LLM 推理验证架构；对完全重执行验证、密码学承诺等替代机制未覆盖。
limitations: 攻击为最优化的白盒设定（需本地剖析）；未提出修复容忍界设计的防御；实验限于模拟的分布式验证环境。

title: Pop Goes the Verifier: Phoneme-Targeted Data Poisoning of Voice Liveness Detection
abstract: Many Automated Speaker Verification Systems (ASVs) commonly employ liveliness detection techniques, such as VoicePop, which identify genuine speech by analyzing low- frequency pop bursts from plosive phonemes using Gammatone Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (GFCC) and an SVM classifier. While effective against traditional replay attacks, such systems are vulnerable to data poisoning techniques. Prior work shows that broadly applied SyntheticPop attacks can collapse model to accuracy to as low as 14.01% using only 20% poisoned samples, but the resulting artifacts are easily detectable when visualizing the waveform energies. This paper introduces Pop Goes the Verifier, a stealthier phoneme injection poisoning attack. By leveraging FastSpeech 2 (FS2) with a modified HiFi-GAN vocoder, we inject localized pop bursts at plosive phoneme locations and overlay subtle Gaussian noise to reduce the visibility of injected artifacts in waveform and spectrogram analysis. Using the ASVSpoof 2019 as the dataset, we observe that the approach achieves a moderate poisoning attack while providing greater resistance to signal-level inspection than the original SyntheticPop attack.
comment: Accepted at IEEE International Joint Conference on Biometrics (IJCB) 2026
title_cn: 验证器的爆音：针对语音活体检测的音素定向数据投毒
abstract_cn: 许多自动说话人验证系统（ASV）采用活体检测技术，如 VoicePop：利用Gammatone 频率倒谱系数（GFCC）与 SVM 分类器分析来自爆破音的低频爆音来识别真实语音。此类系统虽对传统重放攻击有效，但易受数据投毒攻击。已有工作表明，广泛应用的 SyntheticPop 攻击仅用 20% 投毒样本即可把模型精度压到低至 14.01%，但其产生的伪影在波形能量可视化中容易被检测。本文提出更隐蔽的音素注入投毒攻击「Pop Goes the Verifier」：利用 FastSpeech 2（FS2）与改造的 HiFi-GAN 声码器在爆破音位置注入局部爆音，并叠加微弱高斯噪声以降低注入伪影在波形与语谱图分析中的可见性。在 ASVSpoof 2019 数据集上，该方法实现中等强度的投毒攻击，同时对信号级检查的抵抗力显著高于原始 SyntheticPop 攻击。
summary_cn: 提出比 SyntheticPop 更隐蔽的音素定向投毒：用 FastSpeech 2+改造 HiFi-GAN 在爆破音位置注入局部爆音并叠加微弱噪声，在 ASVSpoof 2019 上取得中等攻击效果且更抗信号级检查。
objective_summary: 针对 VoicePop 活体检测设计音素定向投毒：以 TTS+vocoder 在爆破音位置注入局部爆音并叠加噪声掩蔽伪影，在 ASVSpoof 2019 上与 SyntheticPop 对比攻击效果与可检测性。
evidence_note: 单一数据集（ASVSpoof 2019）、单一目标系统（VoicePop 类 GFCC+SVM）上的投毒实验；「更隐蔽」以波形/语谱图人工检查为参照，未给出系统化隐蔽性指标与统计检验；IJCB 2026 录用。
novelty_note: 把既有 SyntheticPop 从全域注入改为音素定向局部注入并用噪声掩蔽，显著提升对信号级检查的抵抗力；为已知攻击的实质性机制改进。
scope: 结论适用于基于爆音特征与浅层分类器的语音活体检测系统；对深度学习活体模型、自适应防御与真实部署管线未覆盖。
limitations: 攻击效果为「中等」，未达到原始 SyntheticPop 的崩溃程度；隐蔽性评估以人工可视化为主；仅在单一数据集与系统上验证。

title: VeilFL: Two-Stage Accountability for Anonymous Federated Learning
abstract: Anonymous credentials can hide which registered client participates in federated learning, but their unlinkability also makes repeated misconduct difficult to associate. We present VeilFL, a two-aggregator protocol that adds staged accountability to PINE (USENIX Security '24). Each submission binds two private PINE messages, a round-specific pseudonym, and a tracing pair to the same hidden credential secret. This design enables detection of duplicate submissions within a round without introducing a persistent identifier for normal participation. VeilFL implements accountability in two stages. After a confirmed duplicate or joint PINE rejection, a threshold tracing committee reveals a stable handle that links faults associated with the same credential. The client's registered identity is recoverable only after the public log records the requisite number of linked faults and a separate threshold committee authorizes identification. Accepted and unopened submissions remain unlinkable under the stated assumptions. This work establishes submission binding and duplicate detection, anonymity, fault non-frameability, controlled two-stage opening, and preservation of PINE's privacy and validity guarantees. In the prototype implementation, creating a submission requires a median of 2.11 ms, while verification requires 3.01 ms. Batch verification reduces the cost to 1.86 ms per submission for a batch of 1,000. The public part of each submission is 608 bytes, with 1,248 bytes of additional VeilFL protocol data across the two aggregator submissions. Each opening stage completes within 4.3 ms for the different committee configurations.
title_cn: VeilFL：匿名联邦学习的两阶段问责
abstract_cn: 匿名凭证可以隐藏哪些注册客户端参与联邦学习，但其不可链接性也使重复不当行为难以关联。我们提出 VeilFL，一个为 PINE（USENIX Security '24）增加分阶段问责的双聚合器协议。每次提交把两条私有 PINE 消息、轮次特定假名与追踪对绑定到同一隐藏凭证密钥上。该设计可在不引入持久标识的情况下检测一轮内的重复提交。VeilFL 分两阶段实现问责：在确认重复或联合 PINE 拒绝后，阈值追踪委员会揭示把同凭证故障关联起来的稳定句柄；只有当公开日志记录了足够数量的关联故障且单独的阈值委员会授权身份揭示时，客户端的注册身份才可恢复。在被陈述的假设下，被接受且未开启的提交保持不可链接。本工作确立了提交绑定与重复检测、匿名性、故障不可陷害性、受控两阶段开启以及对 PINE 隐私与有效性保证的保持。在原型实现中，创建提交的中位耗时 2.11 毫秒，验证 3.01 毫秒；对 1,000 个提交的批量验证把成本降到每提交 1.86 毫秒。每次提交的公开部分为 608 字节，两个聚合器提交共额外 1,248 字节 VeilFL 协议数据。不同委员会配置下每个开启阶段在 4.3 毫秒内完成。
summary_cn: 提出双聚合器协议 VeilFL，在 PINE 匿名联邦学习上加入两阶段问责：阈值委员会揭示关联故障的句柄、独立委员会授权身份揭示；提交中位 2.11ms、验证 3.01ms，正常参与保持不可链接。
objective_summary: 设计在匿名凭证联邦学习中加入分阶段问责的协议：重复提交检测、阈值追踪委员会揭示句柄、独立委员会授权身份揭示，并给出性质定义与原型性能测量。
evidence_note: 给出协议性质列表（绑定、匿名、不可陷害、受控开启）与原型实现的具体性能（2.11ms 提交、3.01ms 验证、批量 1.86ms、608 字节公开部分）；无安全形式化证明细节与大规模部署评估。
novelty_note: 在已有匿名 FL（PINE）上首次给出「两阶段受控问责」扩展：把重复检测与身份揭示解耦为两个独立阈值委员会决策，兼顾不可链接性与可追责。
scope: 结论适用于基于匿名凭证的联邦学习参与隐私保护场景；假设双聚合器与阈值委员会部分诚实；对委员会合谋超出阈值假设的情形未覆盖。
limitations: 问责依赖故障「数量达标」才可开启身份，对小规模持续滥用响应较慢；原型性能测量规模有限；与 PINE 的集成正确性依赖其安全假设。

title: Trouble With Time: Compile Timestamps and First-Seen Date Regression in EMBER2024
abstract: Reliable first-seen dates are important for constructing temporal malware evaluation splits, but this information often comes from external services that are not equally accessible to all researchers. We investigate whether machine learning can instead estimate an executable's first-seen date or determine when its PE/COFF compilation timestamp is unreliable. Using EMBER2024, we evaluate feature-based and raw-byte models across classification, regression, ranking, and latent-reliability formulations. Direct first-seen regression produces errors comparable to a substantial portion of the dataset's collection window, and none of the evaluated scores provides a useful chronological ordering of files. Current models therefore cannot replace externally sourced first-seen metadata. In contrast, classifiers can identify timestamps that fall within specified tolerances of first seen and can detect clearly implausible timestamps with high discrimination. We also find substantial timestamp disagreement among both benign and malicious executables, indicating that unreliable timestamps are not exclusively a product of malicious manipulation. These results establish baselines and identify timestamp reliability as a distinct direction for future security-ML research.
comment: To appear in the Conference on Applied Machine Learning for Information Security (CAMLIS) 2026
title_cn: 时间的麻烦：EMBER2024 中的编译时间戳与首见日期回归
abstract_cn: 可靠的首见日期对构建恶意软件时间评估划分很重要，但该信息通常来自并非所有研究者都能平等访问的外部服务。我们研究机器学习能否改为估计可执行文件的首见日期，或判断其 PE/COFF 编译时间戳何时不可靠。使用 EMBER2024，我们在分类、回归、排序与潜在可靠性四种形式下评估特征模型与原始字节模型。直接首见回归产生的误差与数据集收集窗口的相当一部分相当，且没有任何被评估分数能提供有用的文件时间排序。因此当前模型不能替代外部来源的首见元数据。相比之下，分类器能够识别落在首见日期指定容差内的时间戳，并能以高判别力检测明显不可信的时间戳。我们还发现良性与恶意可执行文件中都存在大量时间戳分歧，表明不可靠时间戳并非恶意操纵的专属产物。这些结果建立了基线，并把时间戳可靠性确立为未来安全机器学习研究的一个独立方向。
summary_cn: 在 EMBER2024 上评估 ML 估计首见日期：直接回归误差与收集窗口相当、无法替代外部元数据；但分类器可高判别地识别不可信 PE 时间戳，且良性样本同样大量时间戳分歧。
objective_summary: 在 EMBER2024 上以分类/回归/排序/可靠性四种形式系统评估从可执行文件估计首见日期与检测不可信编译时间戳的可行性，并量化良性与恶意样本的时间戳分歧。
evidence_note: 基于公开 EMBER2024 数据集，覆盖特征模型与原始字节模型、四种任务形式并给出误差量化；负结果（回归不可用）与正结果（不可信检测高判别）均有报告；CAMLIS 2026 录用。
novelty_note: 有诊断价值：首次系统量化「时间戳/首见日期可否从文件本身推断」，给出明确的否定性回归结论与肯定性可靠性检测结论，并揭示时间戳分歧跨良性样本普遍存在。
scope: 结论适用于 PE/COFF Windows 可执行文件（EMBER2024 覆盖范围）的时间元数据推断；对非 Windows 平台与外部威胁情报源融合未覆盖。
limitations: 回归目标本身高度噪声（时间戳操纵+采集偏差）；容差检测依赖预设容差选择；结论绑定 EMBER2024 单一语料。

title: E-UDE: A Scientific Machine Learning Model for Malware Propagation Dynamics
abstract: Understanding the malware propagation dynamics over the Internet is crucial for effectively controlling its spread. Existing mechanistic and data-driven models in the context of malware propagation dynamics, have some issues with either interpretability or predictive accuracy. This study presents an Enhanced Universal Differential Equation (E-UDE) framework that explicitly incorporates more detailed key factors that influence malware propagation. Evaluation on real-world malware propagation data shows that the E-UDE achieves the best overall performance, attaining an overall RMSE of 783.70 and MAE of 421.65. Compared with the Classical ODE and the UDE models, the proposed approach reduces RMSE by approximately 66 percent and 39 percent, respectively. Its robustness to predictive capability is further evaluated. In this experiment, the E-UDE achieves a Test RMSE of 634.6, a Test MAE of 419.3, and a Test Correlation of 0.964. The E-UDE maintains relatively stable prediction performance as the noise level increases, showing limited degradation compared with the baseline models. Furthermore, this E-UDE model enables us to perform several scenario analyses under different cybersecurity scenarios, providing a useful framework for better understanding the effective control factors. To study the wide applicability of the E-UDE framework, the model performance is assessed by two different datasets, namely, Code Red dataset and Witty Worm dataset.
title_cn: E-UDE：面向恶意软件传播动力学的科学机器学习模型
abstract_cn: 理解恶意软件在互联网上的传播动态对有效控制其扩散至关重要。现有的机理模型与数据驱动模型在可解释性或预测精度上各有不足。本研究提出增强型通用微分方程（E-UDE）框架，显式纳入影响恶意软件传播的更细致关键因素。在真实恶意软件传播数据上的评估显示，E-UDE 取得最佳整体性能，整体 RMSE 783.70、MAE 421.65；相比经典 ODE 与 UDE 模型，分别降低 RMSE 约 66% 与 39%。其预测能力的鲁棒性也被评估：该实验中 E-UDE 达到测试 RMSE 634.6、测试 MAE 419.3 与测试相关系数 0.964；随噪声水平升高，E-UDE 保持相对稳定的预测性能，退化有限。E-UDE 模型还支持在不同网络安全场景下的多项情景分析，为理解有效控制因素提供有用框架。为研究 E-UDE 框架的广泛适用性，模型性能还在 Code Red 与 Witty Worm 两个数据集上评估。
summary_cn: 提出增强型通用微分方程框架 E-UDE 建模恶意软件传播：真实数据上 RMSE 783.70，比经典 ODE/UDE 分别降约 66%/39%，并在 Code Red 与 Witty Worm 数据集上验证。
objective_summary: 把增强型通用微分方程（机理+数据混合建模）应用于恶意软件传播动态预测，纳入更多传播影响因子并在真实传播数据与两个经典蠕虫数据集上对比基线。
evidence_note: 在真实传播数据与 Code Red/Witty Worm 两个历史数据集上给出 RMSE/MAE/相关系数并对比 ODE/UDE 基线；数据集年代久远（2001/2004）、规模有限、无统计检验。
novelty_note: 把 UDE 框架增强后应用于恶意软件传播建模属成熟技术的领域迁移；机理项与数据项的组合方式为增量改进。
scope: 结论适用于恶意软件传播动态的时间序列预测与控制因素情景分析；对现代大规模僵尸网络传播与现代网络拓扑的适用性未验证。
limitations: 依赖两个 20 年前的蠕虫数据集，传播环境已显著变化；与更多数据驱动基线的对比缺失；控制因素分析的因果解释有限。

title: Illusion: Safeguarding Topology Confidentiality in LLM Multi-Agent Systems via Behavior-Preserving Obfuscation
abstract: The communication topology of Large Language Model Multi-Agent Systems (LLM-MASs) governs how information propagates among agents and encodes critical domain knowledge and expert workflow design. It is valuable intellectual property and plays a decisive role in system utility and safety, yet remains vulnerable to inference attacks that stealthily reconstruct it from agent outputs. Existing defenses detect or mitigate such attacks but do not proactively conceal the topology itself. We propose \textit{Illusion}, a proactive topology obfuscation defense for LLM-MAS. \textit{Illusion} injects fake edges and fake messages to present attackers with a deceptive topology, while selecting low-impact candidates that preserve output-distribution equivalence and task-accuracy non-inferiority. The resulting fake edges are designed to be indistinguishable from genuine messages under black-box observation. Extensive experiments show that \textit{Illusion} reduces edge-level F1 from over 0.87 to 0.62 and graph similarity from over 0.94 to 0.71. It also largely preserves output distributions and task performance, and its fake edges resist both similarity-based and LLM-judge filtering, even under adaptive pruning.
title_cn: Illusion：通过保持行为的混淆保护 LLM 多智能体系统拓扑机密性
abstract_cn: 大语言模型多智能体系统（LLM-MAS）的通信拓扑决定信息如何在智能体间传播，编码了关键的领域知识与专家工作流设计。它是有价值的知识产权，对系统效用与安全起决定性作用，却容易受到从智能体输出隐蔽重建拓扑的推理攻击。现有防御检测或缓解此类攻击，但不主动隐藏拓扑本身。我们提出 Illusion，一种面向 LLM-MAS 的主动拓扑混淆防御。Illusion 注入假边与假消息向攻击者呈现欺骗性拓扑，同时选择保持输出分布等价与任务精度不劣化的低影响候选。所得假边在黑盒观测下被设计为与真实消息不可区分。大量实验显示，Illusion 把边级 F1 从 0.87 以上降到 0.62、图相似度从 0.94 以上降到 0.71；它基本保持输出分布与任务性能，其假边即使在对抗性剪枝下也能抵抗基于相似度与 LLM 评审的过滤。
summary_cn: 提出 LLM 多智能体系统主动拓扑混淆 Illusion：注入低影响假边/假消息，把攻击者边级 F1 从 0.87+ 降到 0.62、图相似度从 0.94+ 降到 0.71，同时保持输出分布与任务性能。
objective_summary: 针对 LLM-MAS 拓扑推理攻击提出主动混淆防御：注入保持输出分布等价的假边与假消息，并在多个攻击者过滤策略下量化防御效果与任务效用保持。
evidence_note: 大量实验给出防御前后量化指标（边级 F1 0.87+→0.62、图相似度 0.94+→0.71）及对抗性剪枝下的鲁棒性；未报告统计检验，实验设置细节见正文。
novelty_note: 拓扑保护思路从「检测攻击」转向「主动欺骗式混淆」并要求输出分布等价，是该问题上的首个主动防御设计；假边不可区分性通过候选筛选实现。
scope: 结论适用于以文本消息通信、可被黑盒观测的 LLM-MAS 拓扑保护；对拥有白盒访问或长期跨会话观测的攻击者未覆盖。
limitations: 假边候选依赖低影响筛选，任务类型变化时需重新选择；对自适应攻击者的多轮推断博弈评估有限；通信开销增加未详细量化。

title: Intent-Bound Authorization for Cryptocurrency Withdrawals Under Backend Compromise
abstract: Binance's preliminary account of its October 2026 attack raises a custody question that key protection alone cannot answer: how can a provider prevent unauthorized withdrawals when an attacker controls a service permitted to request signatures? We propose the Intent-Bound Withdrawal Authorization Protocol (IWAP). Before signing, independent enforcement checks customer intent, exact transaction effects, fresh workload evidence, and a committed single-use spending reservation. Administrative actions use a separate authorization path. We specify the protocol's trust assumptions and give conditional arguments for intent preservation, replay resistance, and a fixed-epoch exposure bound. A Python reference monitor authenticates synthetic records with Ed25519 and serializes reservations with SQLite. It rejects 1,200 negative requests, accepts 3,000 valid synthetic requests, and preserves a 100-unit budget under 64 concurrent attempts in each of 20 trials. When the intent authority is deliberately compromised, malicious requests pass, but the independent budget still limits admitted exposure. The study evaluates a normalized policy model, not Binance's infrastructure or a deployed custody platform. Its contribution is an explicit authorization boundary and reproducible tests of that boundary.
title_cn: 后端被攻破场景下的意图绑定加密货币提款授权
abstract_cn: Binance 对其 2026 年 10 月攻击的初步说明提出了一个仅靠密钥保护无法回答的托管问题：当攻击者控制一个被允许请求签名的服务时，提供商如何阻止未经授权的提款？我们提出意图绑定提款授权协议（IWAP）。在签名之前，独立执行方校验客户意图、确切的交易效果、新鲜的工作负载证据与已承诺的一次性支出预留。管理操作使用单独的授权路径。我们规定协议的信任假设，并给出意图保持、抗重放与固定纪元敞口界的条件性论证。一个 Python 参考监控器用 Ed25519 认证合成记录、用 SQLite 序列化预留。它拒绝了 1,200 个恶意请求、接受了 3,000 个有效合成请求，并在 20 次试验的每一次中在 64 个并发尝试下保持 100 单位预算。当意图权限被故意攻破时，恶意请求可以通过，但独立预算仍限制已承认的敞口。本研究评估的是归一化的策略模型，而非 Binance 的基础设施或已部署的托管平台。其贡献是一个显式的授权边界与该边界的可复现测试。
summary_cn: 提出 IWAP 提款授权协议：签名前由独立执行方校验意图/交易效果/新鲜证据/一次性支出预留，给出意图保持与抗重放等条件论证；参考监视器拒绝 1,200 恶意请求并在 64 并发下守住预算。
objective_summary: 针对后端签名服务被攻破的威胁模型设计 IWAP 协议：意图绑定+一次性支出预留+独立管理路径，给出条件性安全论证与 Python 参考实现及合成测试。
evidence_note: 以 Python 参考监视器+合成记录做功能测试（拒 1,200/收 3,000、20×64 并发预算保持），安全论证为条件性而非完整形式化证明；未在真实托管系统评估。
novelty_note: 结合 2026 年 10 月真实托管事件提出「意图绑定+独立预算」授权边界：把「谁可以请求签名」与「签出什么」解耦，是托管提款授权的新场景组合。
scope: 结论适用于归一化的提款授权策略模型与参考实现；对真实交易所基础设施、密钥管理实现缺陷与意图权限本身被攻破后的敞口上限依赖预算机制。
limitations: 安全论证为条件性、未做完整形式化验证；评估全部基于合成请求；对协议在真实运营负载与合规约束下的适用性未讨论。

title: Cross-Evidence Authorization State Learning for Runtime Detection of Broken Object-Level Authorization in Black-Box Web Applications
abstract: Broken object-level authorization (BOLA) remains difficult to detect in black-box Web applications because external runtime monitors generally lack access to source code, authorization policies, and object-ownership records. This paper proposes a cross-evidence authorization-state learning method that reconstructs subject--resource--object--action relations from request--response transactions. The method represents authorization relations with confidence-aware states, aggregates positive and negative evidence while accounting for provenance independence, and applies contamination-gated promotion, evidence quarantine and rollback, expiration, and revocation. A Python prototype is evaluated using a deterministic synthetic benchmark comprising 64,400 requests across five independent random seeds. In this benchmark, the proposed method achieves 100.00% recall, an F1-score of 56.63%, and a false-positive rate of 33.65%, while the measured unauthorized-relation pollution rate is 0.00%. Ablation experiments show that removing provenance independence or evidence quarantine increases the pollution rate to 100.00%. The experiments provide an initial evaluation under controlled synthetic conditions.
title_cn: 面向黑盒 Web 应用越权对象级授权运行时检测的跨证据授权状态学习
abstract_cn: 越权对象级授权（BOLA）在黑盒 Web 应用中难以检测，因为外部运行时监控通常无法访问源代码、授权策略与对象所有权记录。本文提出跨证据授权状态学习方法，从请求-响应事务重建主体-资源-对象-动作关系。该方法用带置信度的状态表示授权关系，在考虑出处独立性的同时聚合正负证据，并应用污染门控晋升、证据隔离与回滚、过期与撤销机制。一个 Python 原型在由 64,400 个请求、五个独立随机种子构成的确定性合成基准上评估。在该基准上，该方法达到 100.00% 召回率、F1 56.63% 与 33.65% 假阳性率，同时测得的未授权关系污染率为 0.00%。消融实验显示，移除出处独立性或证据隔离会把污染率推高到 100.00%。实验提供了受控合成条件下的初步评估。
summary_cn: 提出从请求-响应重建授权关系的运行时 BOLA 检测：合成基准 64,400 请求上召回 100%、F1 56.63%、误报率 33.65%；消融显示移除证据隔离会使污染率升至 100%。
objective_summary: 设计从请求-响应事务重建授权关系并做置信度加权证据聚合的运行时 BOLA 检测方法，配套污染门控、隔离回滚与撤销机制，并在确定性合成基准上评估与消融。
evidence_note: 仅在一个确定性合成基准（64,400 请求、5 种子）上评估，作者自述为「受控合成条件下的初步评估」；误报率 33.65% 偏高，无真实应用验证。
novelty_note: 把授权关系重建形式化为置信度感知状态机并引入污染门控/隔离回滚机制，是黑盒 BOLA 检测中可辩护证据聚合的新组合。
scope: 结论适用于黑盒部署下基于请求-响应观测的 BOLA 运行时检测；结论绑定自建确定性合成基准，对真实 Web 应用的泛化未验证。
limitations: F1 56.63%、误报 33.65% 距实用有明显距离；仅在合成基准评估；对象所有权等真值的构造方式可能与真实应用有差距。

title: AgentCap: Capability-Based Runtime Authorization for Secure LLM Agent Execution
abstract: Language-model agents commonly collapse two decisions that security systems separate: selecting an action and determining whether that action is authorized. When a model exercises standing authority, indirect prompt injection can convert influence over its reasoning into unauthorized effects. We present AgentCap, a runtime authorization layer that externalizes this decision from the model and mediates every tool invocation through an MCP wrapper. Each request declares an intent, and AgentCap evaluates policy constraints over trust, workflow prerequisites, mutually exclusive authority, and the provenance of security-sensitive arguments. Authorized requests receive short-lived, budget-bounded capability tokens that are validated at the tool boundary. Delegation is restricted to session-bound parent-child chains that preserve action and resource while budget and lifetime can only be attenuated, preventing authority from being expanded or reused across unrelated agent sessions. A declarative policy language provides a common representation for runtime enforcement and predeployment analysis. Across AgentDojo and InjecAgent, AgentCap reduces attack success in every evaluated model-benchmark setting, including zero attack success with GPT-5.4 on both benchmarks. Controlled adversarial scenarios further show that AgentCap blocks every attempted unauthorized execution (ASR 0%) while preserving all legitimate operations exercised. These results demonstrate that agent security requires authorization of model-proposed effects at the tool boundary, independently of the model's reasoning.
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Accepted at the Third Workshop on Agents in the Wild, NeurIPS 2026 (non-archival)
title_cn: AgentCap：面向 LLM 智能体安全执行的基于能力运行时授权
abstract_cn: 语言模型智能体常把安全系统中分离的两个决定合并：选择动作与判断该动作是否被授权。当模型行使常设权限时，间接提示注入可以把对模型推理的影响转化为未经授权的效果。我们提出 AgentCap，一个把该决定从模型中外置的运行时授权层，通过 MCP 包装器中介每次工具调用。每个请求声明意图，AgentCap 对信任、工作流前置条件、互斥权限以及安全敏感参数的来源等策略约束进行评估。被授权的请求获得在工具边界校验的短生命周期、有预算上限的能力令牌。委托被限制在保持动作与资源的会话绑定父子链内，预算与生命周期只能衰减，防止权限被扩展或在无关智能体会话间复用。声明式策略语言为运行时执行与部署前分析提供统一表示。在 AgentDojo 与 InjecAgent 上，AgentCap 在每个被评估的模型-基准设置中降低攻击成功率，包括 GPT-5.4 在两个基准上零攻击成功。受控对抗场景进一步显示 AgentCap 阻止了所有尝试的未授权执行（ASR 0%），同时保持所有被行使的合法操作。这些结果表明，智能体安全需要在工具边界对模型提议的效果做授权，独立于模型自身的推理。
summary_cn: 提出 AgentCap 运行时授权层：经 MCP 包装器声明意图并校验信任/前置条件/互斥权限/参数来源，发放短期能力令牌；AgentDojo/InjecAgent 各设置降低 ASR，GPT-5.4 上零攻击成功。
objective_summary: 设计运行时授权层 AgentCap：把动作选择与授权判断分离，通过 MCP 包装器以意图声明+策略评估+短期能力令牌中介工具调用，并在 AgentDojo/InjecAgent 与受控对抗场景评估。
evidence_note: 在 AgentDojo 与 InjecAgent 两个标准基准、多模型设置下系统评估并给出 ASR 数值（GPT-5.4 两个基准 0%）；另有受控对抗场景；NeurIPS 2026 workshop（非存档），无统计检验。
novelty_note: 把经典能力令牌/最小权限/互斥职责组合为智能体工具边界的运行时授权模型，并形式化委托链的衰减约束；核心机制为已有安全组件的系统性新组合。
scope: 结论适用于经 MCP 暴露工具调用的 LLM 智能体在间接提示注入下的授权控制；策略语言的表达力边界与高对抗自适应攻击未覆盖。
limitations: 策略编写成本与覆盖完整性依赖人工；对注入与授权边界之外的攻击面（如工具实现漏洞）不设防；workshop 论文未经完整评审。

title: Constructing Budgeted KGW Evasion through Token-Event Evidence Replacement
abstract: KGW watermarks bias sampling to accumulate keyed detection evidence. We construct budgeted evasion through token-event evidence replacement using ordinary phrase rewrites. Our construction jointly selects compositions of LLM-proposed alternatives from an independent model and measures global token-edit distance on complete outputs. At the largest attainable cost within the budget, exact coverage search maximizes removal of original scored token pairs. It uses a known tokenizer without the key, detector feedback or queries to the watermarked model. Exact accounting separates source evidence removed, evidence created and length effects, with initial strength setting the required reduction. Separate signed-event analysis found that mean suppression arose mainly from removing watermark-enriched source events. In controlled, occurrence-counted, one-token-context KGW tests on short passages, 39 of 82 qualified, initially detected sources yielded rewrites with terminal detector score Z < 4 that passed blinded source-relative model review, at a mean actual token-edit cost of 16.0% under a 20% allowance. To examine whether this initial requirement can be inferred, a separate historical 95-passage study estimated initial detector score Z0 from generation traces with correlation 0.793 and an in-sample association beyond length. This aggregate information did not establish improved allocation, and the separate no-trace stopping test did not reliably exploit cheaper reviewed crossings in the candidate bank. Comparisons did not establish an advantage over simpler selection and ordinary constrained rewriting. The construction makes budgeted evidence replacement executable while exposing limits in signed reduction and recognition of sufficient editing.
title_cn: 通过词元-事件证据替换构造预算内 KGW 水印逃逸
abstract_cn: KGW 水印通过偏置采样积累带密钥的检测证据。我们用普通短语改写构造预算受控的逃逸：联合选择来自独立模型的 LLM 候选改写组合，并度量完整输出上的全局词元编辑距离。在预算内以最大可达成本做精确覆盖搜索，最大化移除原始被计分的词元对；仅使用已知分词器，无需密钥、检测器反馈或对水印模型的查询。精确核算分离被移除的源证据、新产生的证据与长度效应，初始强度设定所需削减量。分开的带符号事件分析发现平均抑制主要来自移除水印增强的源事件。在受控、按出现次数计数、单词元上下文的 KGW 短文测试中，82 个合格且初始可检测的来源中 39 个产生了终止检测分 Z<4 的改写并通过盲的源相对模型评审，在 20% 预算下平均实际词元编辑代价 16.0%。为考察该初始要求能否被推断，另一项 95 篇的历史研究从生成轨迹估计初始检测分 Z0（相关性 0.793，且在样本内超出长度的关联）。但该聚合信息未确立更好的分配，单独的无轨迹停止测试也未能可靠利用候选库中更廉价的已评审穿越。比较未能确立相对更简单选择与普通受限改写的优势。该构造使预算化证据替换可执行，同时暴露了带符号削减与充分编辑识别上的限制。
summary_cn: 用短语改写做预算内 KGW 水印证据替换：82 个初始可检测来源中 39 个改写后 Z<4（平均词元编辑 16.0%、预算 20%），但未证明优于更简单的选择与改写。
objective_summary: 构造预算受控的 KGW 水印逃逸：以独立模型候选+精确覆盖搜索替换被计分词元对，量化证据移除/新增/长度效应，并检验初始检测分可推断性与相对简单方法的增益。
evidence_note: 受控小规模实验：82 个短文来源、单词元上下文 KGW 设定、39 个成功改写（Z<4），另有 95 篇历史研究（相关性 0.793）；作者明确指出未确立对简单基线的优势，无统计检验。
novelty_note: 把已知「改写逃逸」形式化为预算化证据替换并给出精确核算框架，属已有攻击思路的增量形式化；对基线的优势未确立。
scope: 结论适用于单词元上下文绿名单（KGW）水印在短文本与 20% 编辑预算下的逃逸可行性与代价；对其他水印方案、长文本与自适应检测未覆盖。
limitations: 仅在受控单词元上下文设定验证；39/82 的成功率并非普遍有效；停止策略与分配算法未显示优于简单方法；短文测试外推性有限。

title: The Long Con on the Web: Earn-then-Exploit Fraud Attacks against Coding Agents
abstract: Coding agents increasingly operate with web access and high privileges, creating a new attack surface where web fraud can directly target autonomous agents. Existing studies mainly focus on malicious links, prompt injection, and interface deception, while content-level web fraud against agents and the amplification of attacks through agent trust remain underexplored. In this paper, we present EtE (Earn-then-Exploit), a web fraud attack framework against coding agents, in which a malicious website first provides multiple rounds of genuinely verifiable assistance to establish trust and then introduces task-related instructions that cross intended operational boundaries. To systematically evaluate its effectiveness, we construct 56 organizational environments (8 task contexts x 7 attack consequences) and evaluate three representative coding agents. EtE achieves an average scene-level attack success rate of 71.4%, including 85.7% on Codex-GPT-5.5, 67.9% on ZCode-GLM-5.3-Flash, and 60.7% on QwenCode-Qwen3.7-Plus, significantly outperforming all injection-based baselines. More importantly, our experiments reveal that coding agents exhibit trust-like behavioral reliance on previously helpful Web sources, and that such accumulated credibility significantly increases their susceptibility to subsequent malicious instructions. Based on this finding, we propose action-authorization separation (AAS), which prevents web content from directly authorizing privileged actions and reduces the attack success rate to 0% while preserving 100% task completion, outperforming all evaluated defense baselines.
title_cn: 网络上的长线骗局：针对编码智能体的先赚后骗欺诈攻击
abstract_cn: 编码智能体日益以网页访问权与高权限运行，创造了一个网页欺诈可直接针对自主智能体的新攻击面。现有研究主要关注恶意链接、提示注入与界面欺骗，而针对智能体的内容级网页欺诈以及通过智能体信任放大攻击的方向仍欠探索。本文提出针对编码智能体的网页欺诈攻击框架 EtE（Earn-then-Exploit）：恶意网站先提供多轮真实可验证的协助以建立信任，再引入跨越预期操作边界的任务相关指令。为系统评估其有效性，我们构建 56 个组织环境（8 个任务上下文×7 种攻击后果）并评估三个代表性编码智能体：EtE 达到平均场景级攻击成功率 71.4%，其中 Codex-GPT-5.5 为 85.7%、ZCode-GLM-5.3-Flash 为 67.9%、QwenCode-Qwen3.7-Plus 为 60.7%，显著超过所有基于注入的基线。更重要的是，实验揭示编码智能体对先前有帮助的网页来源表现出类似信任的行为依赖，且这种积累的信誉显著提高其对后续恶意指令的易感性。基于该发现，我们提出动作授权分离（AAS）：阻止网页内容直接授权特权动作，把攻击成功率降到 0%，同时保持 100% 任务完成率，优于所有被评估的防御基线。
summary_cn: 提出 EtE 网页欺诈框架：恶意网站先多轮真实协助建立信任再越界下指令，56 个环境对三个编码智能体平均成功率 71.4%（Codex 85.7%）；动作授权分离防御把成功率降到 0% 且任务完成率保持 100%。
objective_summary: 定义并实现「先赚后骗」内容级欺诈攻击：用多轮可验证协助积累智能体信任后注入越界指令，在 56 个组织环境中量化三个智能体的成功率，并评估动作授权分离防御。
evidence_note: 8×7 共 56 个组织环境的系统场景矩阵、三个智能体对比与多个注入基线比较；防御评估报告 0% ASR 与 100% 任务完成；场景为自建合成环境，无统计检验。
novelty_note: 新攻击类别：多轮「先赚后骗」信任积累型内容欺诈，区别于单轮注入/界面欺骗；并首次实证编码智能体对帮助性来源的类信任依赖这一行为机制。
scope: 结论适用于具备网页访问与高权限的编码智能体在内容级欺诈下的风险评估；覆盖三个智能体与 8 种任务上下文，对多轮防御博弈与真实生产环境未覆盖。
limitations: 评估环境为合成组织场景，与真实企业配置存在差距；智能体版本时效性强；AAS 的策略制定成本与误拦截未详细量化。

title: Adversarial Robustness Is Not Zero-Day Generalization: A Controlled Evaluation of Flow-Based Intrusion Detectors on Corrected CIC-IDS2017
abstract: Synthetic variants of known attacks, including feature-space adversarial perturbations, are sometimes used as stand-ins for unseen ("zero-day") attacks when evaluating machine-learning network intrusion detection systems (NIDS). We test whether this proxy holds. On the corrected CIC-IDS2017 release we train Random Forest, XGBoost, a 1D-CNN and an FT-Transformer and compare, at a fixed 1% false-positive rate over five seeds, detection under constrained perturbations of known attacks (gradient-based and black-box attacks on 42 attacker-controllable features) with leave-one-attack-family-out (LOAO) detection, where an entire family is absent from training. Detection under the strongest perturbation we tested, with budgets of at most 0.2, stays between 90.9% and 99.7%, yet mean detection of held-out families falls to 76.2% (RF), 40.2% (XGBoost), 25.8% (1D-CNN) and 22.8% (FT-Transformer). Robustness exceeds LOAO detection for every model (gaps of 24 to 72 percentage points, 23 to 66 when robustness is also averaged over families; Holm-adjusted p $\le$ 0.00096), and the two measures agree at most on a coarse ranking of the models. An exact mixed-integer evasion search confirms the tree ensembles' scores. Benign-only anomaly detectors and a simple multi-class open-set baseline do not close the gap. A temporal split on 5 seeds (3 of the 4 models) leaves the gap in place. On CSE-CIC-IDS2018 the gap recurs for every model (16 to 68 points). On these benchmarks and under this threat model, a robustness score should not be read as a zero-day score, and the two should be reported separately. Code and per-seed results are publicly available.
